To find the optimal sensor activation policy for diagnosis problem of numerical costs, a structure of most permissive observer is introduced to be a basic model to apply the reinforcement learning technique and a brief algorithm is also proposed to realized the method. The scalability and feasibility of our approach can be verified through simulation examples.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal control of a steam reformer solid oxide fuel cell system
abstract: Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) system that utilizes hydrocarbon fuel, such as natural gas, methane, is a promising distributed generator in the future. Designing an efficient system control strategy to realize the stability, high efficiency and long life of SOFC system is an urgent issue for its application currently. In this paper, an optimal control strategy is proposed for steam reformer SOFC system to achieve multiple objectives of load following, thermal safety and high efficiency, based on a validated high-fidelity system model that coincide with a real prototype system. Firstly, the dynamic and static thermo-electrical coupling characteristics and control issues of the steam reformer SOFC system are detailed analyzed, and then the controller based on generalized predictive control (GPC) algorithm is developed satisfying the multi-constraint, strong coupling and large time delay characteristics. In addition, based on a Hardware-in-loop experimental test platform, the application feasibility of the controller is verified on the embedded system. The results show that the controller can not only control the system to track the target power quickly, but also ensure multiple temperature constraints and effectively improve the system efficiency, which provides the basis for further system physical experiment test.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Distribution Network Operation State Based on Spark Parallel Computing
abstract: The distribution network is an important part of the power system. Timely and accurately assessing the operation state of the distribution network is the basis for ensuring the safe and stable operation of the distribution network. The characteristics of the distribution network, including wide geographical distribution, a great variety of equipment, complex network connections, the application of information and smart technologies in the distribution network, have promoted the exponential increase of various operation monitoring data from the distribution network. It brings difficulty to the dynamic evaluation of the operation state of the distribution network. This paper proposes to evaluate the operation state of the distribution network by using the analytic hierarchy process and the Delphi method together, meanwhile calculating the indicator of static data and dynamic operating data of the distribution network based on the Spark distributed parallel computing framework. As well as the distribution network operation state evaluation software system is developed to show the operation state of the distribution network in multiple granularities. The results have verified the flexibility, continuity and practicability of the system.

articleTitle: Direct Interpolation Algorithm Based on Corresponding Points in Rotary Scanning Serial Ultrasound Image
abstract: The rotating scanning imaging method leads to the result that the spatial resolution of the pixels in the fault is greater than that between the faults, which seriously affects the quality of 3D reconstruction. In this paper, we compared several interpolation methods and proposes an improved method based on the law of similar gray value of fault-related voxels, i.e. the characters of the approximate continuous distribution of gray information in three-dimensional space. The neighborhood window is taken on the two-dimensional image where the two adjacent points are located, and the average gray value of all the pixels in the window is used to replace the two. The point gray value method is used for interpolation, and the random irregular sampling ultrasonic image sequence with angular difference is converted into parallel image sequences. The experimental results show that the method can obtain clear regular volume data, realize the standardization of image data and lay a good foundation for 3D reconstruction of ultrasound images.

articleTitle: Particle Filter with improved MSV Resample for Manoeuvring Target Tracking
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional resampling method in particle filtering, such as unstable filter performance, which is greatly affected by simulation parameters and lack of particles, the paper proposes an improved MSV resampling particle filter algorithm and applies it to the tracking problem of maneuvering targets under flicker noise for the first time. Compared with the traditional resampling, the improved MSV resampling is based on the same distribution characteristics for sampling, and the resampling loses less information, which can improve the stability and accuracy of filtering and improve the phenomenon of particle scarcity. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm overcomes the shortcomings of traditional resampling without reducing computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Prevention and Control Strategy for Multi-group Epidemics Based on Delay and Isolation Control
abstract: Aiming at the prevention and control of multi-group epidemics, the dynamic model of disease transmission is established, and an optimal delay and isolation strategy is proposed. The control variables in the model represent the strength of various measures taken to block and isolate contact between groups. The optimal control problem is solved by Pontryagin maximum principle and the corresponding numerical iterative algorithm is given. The results show that the delay and isolation control strategy can effectively control the epidemic of infectious diseases while minimizing the cost of infectious diseases. The outbreak of the COVID-19 in 2020 is a serious threat to people's lives and health. It is because of the timely adoption of delay and isolation control strategy of "early detection and early isolation" and "joint-prevention and joint-control", China took the lead in the fight against the epidemic situation and made an example for the whole world.

articleTitle: Design of A Real-time Three-electrode Cylindrical Conductivity Sensor
abstract: In this paper, we designed a real-time three-electrode cylindrical conductivity sensor for special working conditions. Compared with traditional conductivity sensors, the three-electrode design balances the relationship between measurement accuracy and structural complexity. The cylindrical electrode core can adapt to some complex working environments that traditional intrusive electrodes cannot. The CoOS real-time operating system adopted by the measurement software has the characteristics of a small kernel and low requirement for computing resources. It can well meet the demand for online measurement of conductivity sensor. The amplitude and frequency of the excitation signal can be adjusted by the measurement software, avoiding the invariance of the signal by hardware adjustment. Since the error is greatly affected by temperature, the sensor can effectively reduce the error by compensating for temperature. All electronic components of the sensor are designed with low power consumption, which can extend the working time while ensuring normal operation.

articleTitle: Design of Combined Cooling Heating and Power System Based on Solar Photothermal
abstract: This paper designs a Combined Cooling Heating and Power (CCHP) system that integrates solar collector system and internal combustion generator. The system can generate electricity through internal combustion engine, and simultaneously use high temperature flue gas, cylinder jacket hot water and solar hot water in internal combustion engine, cooling and heating. The system is operated in the teaching area of Weifang Institute of Technology. It can achieve good comfort by completely utilizing solar energy and power generation heat/heating. No additional energy is needed, and the annual energy contribution rate of solar energy exceeds 50%.

Author Keywords: single-double-effect lithium bromide absorption refrigeration integrated unit

articleTitle: Research On A Fast Location Algorithm For Human Eye Center Used In Automatic Optometry Unit
abstract: Fast, accurate, and locating the pupil center on low-cost hardware is the goal followed by developing the automatic optometry unit. In this paper, we propose a double-filtered pupil center location algorithm tackle with the goal followed. First, the collected image is processed into a binary image. Second, we double-filter all connected components in the binarized image by the pixel number and relative position of the target connected component. Third, we use the spatial moment algorithm to locate the center of the target connected components. Finally, the center point of the target connected components are fitted into an ellipse by using a least-squares ellipse-fitting algorithm, and the center of the ellipse is the center of the pupil. This paper uses simulated eyes to experiment with the designed algorithm on Raspberry Pi 4B. The experimental results show that: Compared with the traditional location algorithm in the same experimental environment, the designed algorithm improves the running speed and anti-interference ability while ensuring the accuracy of the center locating. Therefore, the designed algorithm can fully meet to carry out on low-cost hardware real-time identification and location.

articleTitle: Non-contact heart rate detection based on pixel time series classification
abstract: Non-contact heart rate (HR) detection is a new technique developed in recent years, which uses face videos captured by ordinary cameras for heart rate signal estimation, and the implementation of this technique can be divided into two major parts: signal extraction and signal analysis. This paper classifies each pixel timing by using a simplified nearest neighbor classifier and optimizes the signal extraction results by morphological filtering. In the signal analysis stage, this paper uses principal component analysis (PCA) to pre-process the extracted signal set to select the three principal elements that are most likely to contain the heart rate signal, and then uses independent component analysis (ICA) to separate the three principal elements blindly, and then determines the final heart rate signal by fast Fourier transform (FFT). In this paper, the heart rate signal obtained from the above method using the laptop's own camera is compared with that of a finger clip pulse oximeter, and it is found that the algorithm used in this paper is used for non-contact heart rate detection in the presence of ambient noise and slight motion effects.

articleTitle: Study on Vessel Grounding Alert Based on Threat Assessment Technology
abstract: Decision level information fusion is an important scientific issue for vessel intelligent navigation. This paper intends to consider vessel grounding as the research object and the multi-source vessel navigation information as the base, from the viewpoint of system theory, using the threat assessment techniques of the decision level multi-source information fusion to carry out the research on vessel grounding risk algorithms. The research mainly focuses on vessel navigation threat real-time assessment method. Some key points need to be studied: 1) Heterogeneous multi-source navigation information fusion at higher level to assistant deck offices to make fast and correct vessel grounding avoidance decision; 2) Objective and scientific weight distribution of multi-attribute index. The approach is verified in Zhanjiang port area. This paper has the important theoretical significance and practical value for the implementation of maritime traffic system informatisation and intelligentization and the guarantee of maritime navigation safety.

articleTitle: An Active Damping Based Predictive Control Strategy for Single-Phase Converter in Weak Grid
abstract: In distributed generation systems, the converter will experience a critical challenge of stability working in weak grid, as the parasitic impedance of grid is not constant and the voltage of point of common coupling is not stiff. High-order voltage harmonics excited from parasitic impedance will distort grid voltage, which will deteriorate the controller output accuracy. Varying parasitic impedance will cause trouble for filter resonance suppression. In order to solve this issue, an improved predictive control strategy based on an active damping is proposed. In such strategy, the LCL filter and grid impedance are considered as two-stage cascaded models, and the mechanism of filter resonance and voltage distortion are analyzed. Filter resonance is repressed by virtual impedance and the voltage distortion is restrained by a suppression scheme. The virtual impedance and suppression scheme are based on second-order generalized integrator. Then, a PQ predictive control strategy based on virtual vector is established. Finally, a simulation model is established to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Value Iteration Based Continuous-time Nonlinear Constrained Optimal Tracking Controller Design
abstract: The value iteration mechanism is introduced to design the constrained optimal tracking controller for continuous-time nonlinear system in this paper. Unlike most studies were developed by policy iteration, the proposed VI algorithm is designed to be started with arbitrary semi-definite positive function, and thus no restriction is in the initial condition. The iterative property of the proposed algorithm is discussed and the optimality of the iterated results are obtained. To verify the effectiveness, a nonlinear case is simulated.

articleTitle: Research on Angular Momentum Management in Touchless Attitude Control of Spacecraft
abstract: In order to solve the problem of angular momentum saturation caused by the geomagnetic field in the electromagnetic control process, this paper carried out research on the angular momentum management method. Considering the working ability of the electromagnetic coils carried by the target spacecraft, it is divided into two situations: underactuated and full-equipped. Both situations are discussed and analyzed separately, numerical simulation results verify the theoretical derivation. It shows that the angular momentum management method is feasible, and has potential application to on-orbit touchless electromagnetic control.

articleTitle: CWGAN: A Graph Vector Based Traffic Missing Data Adversarial Generation Approach
abstract: Traffic speed prediction is an important and basic application in intelligent transportation system. But due to the equipment failure, the sampled time-series data are often corrupted, which induces data missing problems and creates difficulties in traffic speed prediction. In this paper, To solve a special data missing case, successive long-term data missing, we propose a novel approach combining graph vectorization algorithm and conditional Wasserstein generative adversarial nets (CWGAN). Different from traditional generative adversarial nets, CWGAN introduces graph vectors generating from graph vectorization algorithm as its extra conditional input. Apart from this, we implement enough experiments based on various deep learning methods to compare performances. Finally, we find that CWGAN performs better than other comparative methods when data missing is serious.

articleTitle: Solving the ED problem with ACO algorithm modified by mRMR and local search method
abstract: This paper presents an efficient Max-Relevance and Min-Redundancy (mRMR) based ant colony algorithm (ACO) method, called mACO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R</inf>, for solving the economic dispatch (ED) problem. The mRMR algorithms are applied to reduce the redundancy among units in the power system and improve the ability of solving large-scale optimizations. And a random hill-climbing algorithm is employed to improve local search ability and avoid falling into local optima. Two objectives, the total coal consumption and the amount of pollution, were assigned different weights to transform the bi-objective problem to single objective problem. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated in the case study of 15 units, which plays better performance compared with the existing ACO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R</inf> and PSO methods.

articleTitle: Quaternion-Based Adaptive Iterative Learning Control for Attitude Tracking of Spacecraft
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive control scheme via iterative learning is developed to refine the attitude tracking performance of spacecraft operating repeatedly over a finite period of time, despite unmodeled dynamics and external disturbances. The problem of interest is: how can we overcome the time-iteration-varying uncertainties in the finite time to achieve perfect attitude tracking? On the basis of parameterization, the adaptive parametric learning law is proposed to compensate the uncertainties along the iteration axis. The convergence analysis is derived based on the composite energy function methodology. It is shown that the proposed control scheme via iterative learning works well for attitude tracking system with time-iteration-varying uncertainties. Also, simulation validates the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive control scheme.

articleTitle: DV-Hop Underground Positioning Algorithm Based on Parameter Disturbance WOA
abstract: For reducing the error of the Distance Vector-Hop (DV-Hop) positioning algorithm in the hop-distance and estimation coordinates and enhance the localization accuracy of the underground mine, a novel method that introduces the modified whale optimization algorithm (WOA) to optimize the DV-Hop is proposed. Firstly, adopt the average distance per hop is used to amend the hop-distance from the node to be located and each beacon node to minimal the error of the estimation distance. Then, employ the information entropy to disturbance the parameters of WOA, which can make the individual of whales evenly distributed and escape from getting into local optimum when searching the optimal solution. Finally, the simulation shows that the improved means is able to reduce the node location error rate by 15.07% compared to no modified algorithm, and the positioning accuracy of DV-Hop algorithm is enhanced without adding other hardware devices.

articleTitle: Relaxation Iterative Algorithm Based on Two-Scenario Set
abstract: In this paper, the single machine scheduling problem with uncertain processing time described by the scenario is discussed. In order to consider the robustness and positivity of the scheduling, the two-scenario set model which can take more scenarios into account than the traditional worst-case model is established. Then the two-scenario set model is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model which is easier to solve. And an accurate algorithm relaxation iterative algorithm is designed for the MILP model. A large number of experimental data show that the relaxation iterative algorithm greatly saves the solution time and computer storage space, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control Design for Variable Pitch of Wind Generation with Simulation
abstract: With the exhaustion of energy and more and more stringent requirements on the ecological environment, more and more people attach importance to new energy. Wi5nd energy is favored all over the world because of its pollution-free and huge capacity. However, the wind speed and direction of the natural wind change at all times, which brings great difficulties to stabilize the rotation speed and power of the wind wheel. In this paper, a variable pitch system is designed based on active disturbance rejection control (ADRC), and then the mathematical modeling of wind turbine is carried out by MATLAB/SIMULINK software. The changes of wind turbine speed and pitch Angle are discussed in high wind speed. Through the simulation of step wind and random wind at high wind speed, the simulation situation is closer to the actual natural situation. In view of the difficulty in parameter setting of ADRC, on the one hand, the empirical method is used to set parameters, and on the other hand, particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used to self-tune parameters of ADRC.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Miniaturized Fiber Ring Based on PM-IFOG Optical Path Physical Model
abstract: Fiber optic ring is one of the key factors that determine the performance of interferometric fiber optic gyroscopes. To realize miniaturization of interferometric fiber optic gyroscopes, it is necessary to optimize the design of fiber optic ring in terms of volume and length according to performance requirements. At present, the production of small interferometric fiber optic gyroscopes is relatively rough in the selection of fiber optic ring length and has not been optimized. Based on the physical model of PM-IFOG optical path, this paper compares the effects of different lengths of fiber loops on the performance of small interferometric fiber optic gyroscopes, and adopts the methods of fiber loop performance simulation and length optimization design to improve the performance of small interferometric fiber optic gyroscopes. On the basis of miniaturization of fiber optic gyroscope, the length of 180m fiber optic loop is optimally designed to 290m. Through theoretical analysis and estimation, the accuracy of the gyroscope is improved by [0.259 (°)/h, 1σ)], and the zero bias stability is improved by 0.274 (°)/h. The results show that the application adaptability of interferometric fiber optic gyroscopes can be improved by reasonably designing the fiber optic ring length of small fiber optic gyroscopes. The research provides a certain reference value for miniaturization design of optical path of fiber optic gyroscope.

articleTitle: Economical Efficiency Analysis for the Alternative Strategy of Regional Jets Based on System Dynamics
abstract: With the development of urbanization in China, the demands of air travel increase rapidly in the western regions and third-tier and fourth-tier cities. Airlines usually use 150-180 seats mainline jets to meet such demands, but either economic efficiency of airlines or service level of customer is not high because of low passenger load factor and insufficient flight frequency. To solve the contradiction between supply and demand, the alternative strategy of using domestic regional jet to replace the mainline jet with low economical efficiency is proposed. However, the airlines still hesitate to take such strategy because of no quantitative measurement on its efficiency. To solve these problems, a system dynamic model of alternative strategy is established hereto and validated by comparing simulation results with practical data from one typical airline. Then the sequent oscillation characteristics of stochastic customer behavior, different ownership mode and key cost drivers are analyzed. Based on these principles, it is concluded that suitable scope of the alternative strategy and cost reduction measures should be performed to promote the economical efficiency of regional jets.

articleTitle: Online Trajectory Planning of RLV Terminal Area Energy Management Phase
abstract: The terminal area energy management (TAEM) phase of the reusable launch vehicle (RLV) determines whether it can reach the landing window safely and accurately. Compared with offline trajectory planning, online trajectory planning is more robust to the uncertainties of actual flight. This paper investigates the online trajectory planning algorithm of TAEM phase. Firstly, the trajectory profile design method based on fixed range-to-go is proposed, and the non-linear least squares optimization algorithm is used to automatically design a trajectory profile that satisfies the fixed range-to-go. Secondly, in order to adapt to high-speed and high-sinking flight, according to the approximate linear characteristics of the dynamic pressure transition point with the fixed range-to-go, a dual optimization algorithm is used to quickly find the dynamic pressure transition point with the shortest time and satisfying the range-to-go. By establishing the trim data table, the planning time is less than 1s, which fully meets the real-time requirements of the online planning. The simulation results show that the online planning algorithm is simple, efficient and robust.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction for Energy Module in Laser Equipment based on the Analysis of Current Residual Characteristics
abstract: In this paper, a fault prediction method based on the residual analysis of xenon lamp working current and nonlinear autoregressive network is proposed to solve the problem of gradual fault prediction caused by degradation of energy module of laser device. The prediction principle, prediction model and training method are given. Through the test of simulation data, this method can accurately predict the actual characteristic parameters and the degradation trend of time dimension of electronic components in the working state, and give the fault early warning in advance through the threshold method.

articleTitle: Visual-based Robotic Grasping under Unstructed Environment
abstract: Robot grasping under unstructured environment is a research hotspot in the realization of human-computer interaction and automation. To solve the problem of grasping efficiency and grasping of multiple object scales under unstructured environment, we propose modified GG-CNN model, a fast and efficient robotic grasping method. The proposed modified GG-CNN model uses RGB-D image as input to obtain features by convolutional layers and then reshape them back to the original size by transposed convolutional layers to estimate grasp quality and angle. The resulting grasp pose is chosen to have largest grasp quality. To achieve better robustness, background plane is estimated by the Least Square Method and used as workspace frame so that the height value of background plane remains zero. The modified model is trained and evaluated based on the Cornell Grasp Dataset and the accuracy rate is 96.63%. The proposed method is used to grasp household objects and fruits, including some challenging small objects, and the grasp success rates are 94.5% and 98.0% respectively. Experimental results show that our method can perform real-time robotic grasping under unstructured environment.

articleTitle: Least Angle Regression Adaptive Incremental Broad Learning System
abstract: Broad Learning System (BLS) is a latest proposed flat network, which has an effective and efficient learning capability. Due to excellent performance, BLS has been applied to many fields. However, there is little attention on the structure simplification of BLS network. In this paper, drawing lessons from application of Least Angle Regression (LARS) in feature selection, we propose Least Angle Regression Adaptive Incremental Broad Learning System (LARS-BLS). Begin with a network with complex structure, LARS-BLS firstly ranks all nodes, then, the nodes are added to the empty network in turn according to the contribution rate from high to low. Then, the adaptive coefficient is calculated according to the accuracy change rate of the model to adjust the number of nodes added to the model accordingly. When the modeling requirements are met, stop adding nodes. Finally, a sparse BLS model without redundant nodes is constructed. The proposed method is applied to a real-world application and some common data sets. The results show that our proposed algorithm is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Boundary localization method of ingot metal combining template matching and symmetric straight line segmentation
abstract: To solve the problem of multi-objective localization of non-ferrous metal ingots and the shadow interference caused by specular reflection on the boundary localization of metal solution, a boundary detection method combining template matching and symmetric linear segmentation is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the position of a single ingot tool is detected by the template matching method, and the position of multiple ingot tools is calculated according to the characteristic of equal distance between adjacent ingots. Secondly, the Sobel operator is used to detect the edge of the ingot region. In view of the presence of shadow interference on the surface of the metal solution, a symmetric linear segmentation method is proposed to extract the four edge lines of the metal solution. Finally, the intersection of the lines is calculated to determine the boundary of the metal solution. The experimental results demonstrate that the method can overcome the interference of factors such as shadows on the solution surface and changes in illumination. The method also can detect multiple ingot positions simultaneously, with strong adaptive adjustment capability.

articleTitle: Suppressed Circulating Current of MMC with IPSO Optimized PR Controller
abstract: In this paper, the circulating current is suppressed by improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) is proposed. First of all, closed-loop control model of MMC with proportional-resonance (PR) controller is established. Next, the PSO algorithm is improved, and the IPSO algorithm is adopted to optimize the PR parameters. Finally, the simulations in MATLAB/Simulink environment are launched, by comparing IPSO with ant colony optimization and PSO, it is shown that the amplitude of internal circulation can be prominently reduced under fault, and the internal circulation of MMC can be effectively suppressed.

articleTitle: Hysteresis model identification for piezoelectric positioning stage using improved moth-flame optimization
abstract: The hysteresis existing in the piezoelectric positioning stage seriously affects the performance of the positioning stage, and even causes the instability of the system. However, due to the complexity of hysteresis, hysteresis modeling and parameter identification are still a challenging task. According to the hysteresis characteristic of the piezoelectric positioning stage, a hysteresis parameter identification method based on the improved moth-flame optimization (IMFO) algorithm is proposed. First, the diversity of IMFO is enhanced by differential evolution (DE) algorithm, then the subpopulation update strategy is used to balance the exploration and exploitation capability of the algorithm, so as to effectively improve the performance of the identification algorithm. Finally, for the identification problem of the enhanced Prandtl-Ishlinskii (PI) model in the piezoelectric positioning stage, the proposed identification algorithm is compared with five stochastic optimization algorithms. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has higher accuracy, which also demonstrates the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Control of the PMSG Based on the T2SFNN
abstract: In this paper, the permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) is taken as a research object, which has nonlinear motions induced by chaotic oscillation and other factors. An adaptive control strategy combining the type-2 sequential fuzzy neural network (T2SFNN) is proposed to suppress chaos and ensure the smooth operation of the motor. Firstly, a mathematical model is established in the two-phase synchronous rotating coordinate system, and the chaotic motion phenomenon of the PMSG is revealed by constructing an integral operation circuit equivalent to the system state e quation. Then, based on the backstepping control, combined with cosine barrier function, nussbaum-type function and speed function, using a T2SFNN to approximate the unknown nonlinear term in the mathematical model of the PMSG, which can accelerate the convergence of tracking error, guarantee the boundedness of tracking error and output and make the nonlinear system have good transient and steady-state behaviors. Tracking differentiator is used to deal with the complex term explosion in the process of backstepping, so as to improve the accuracy of the control system. Furthermore, the Lyapunov function is used to predefined constraints are never violated and proved all closed-loop signals are ultimately bounded. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the scheme a re verified by simulation.

Author Keywords: the type-2 sequential fuzzy neural network

articleTitle: A novel spatial-temporal fusion deep neural network for soft sensing of industrial processes
abstract: This paper proposes a novel spatial-temporal fusion deep neural network for soft sensing of industrial processes. Different from previous deep learning based methods, the proposed model considers a new structure by combining the gated recurrent unit(GRU) and deep convolutional neural network(DCNN). The temporal correlation is captured by the GRU framework and the spatial correlation/input-output relationship is revealed using the DCNN structure. The resultant features are then fused and fed into a dense layer to produce the final estimations. A backpropagating algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the model. The developed soft sensor considers both the spatial and temporal information and hence are more accurate in soft sensing of important quality variables that are difficult to measure in industrial processes. The effectiveness and feasibility of the soft sensor is verified by an application to the sulfur recovery unit(SRU).

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technologies of Network Distributed Flight Control System
abstract: In view of the increasing requirement of aircraft survivability on the battlefield and the increasing fault-tolerant level, the paper proposes a network distributed flight control system structure, which constructs a distributed system through distributed network and compute nodes. Several key technologies are discussed following may effectively solve the application problems of network control technology in the flight control system. The health management of compute node is completed by various monitoring means, which also provides data basis for the configuration determination of network control system. System task dynamic coordination and scheduling, combining the resource requirements of system task execution with the resource capabilities provided by system compute nodes, achieve the matching of the two through multiple task scheduling methods. The whole scheme, including the monitoring mechanism of system compute nodes and the scheduling mechanism of system tasks, can give full play to the application of network control technology in the distributed flight control system, so as to support the urgent requirements in system reliability, security and fault tolerance.

articleTitle: Distributed event-triggered cloud predictive control for consensus of multi-agent systems under DoS attacks
abstract: In this paper, a novel distributed event-triggered cloud predictive controller is designed for networked multi-agent control systems subject to periodic DoS attacks. In order to solve the collaboration problem of multi-agent system, a distributed event-triggered control strategy is proposed under the constraint that all agents can only communicate with one cloud server intermittently and reduce the communication burden. Meanwhile, we propose a new cloud predictive control scheme to achieve consensus and compensate for periodic DoS attacks actively. By using Lyapunov function method and system analysis method, the security of multi-agent system under attack is considered and give sufficient conditions to realize the consensus. Effectiveness of the proposed theoretical algorithm is demonstrated by simulation result.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Starch Moisture Measurement System
abstract: Starch as an important raw material in production and life, has a strong moisture absorption, the state provisions of starch water content should not exceed 14%, starch factory generally adopts off-line method to detect starch water, not real-time. In order to realize the online measurement of starch water, this paper built an online measurement system of starch water based on Labview platform, studied and established an online measurement system based on BP neural network by using different starch resistance values and different capacitance values of different water contents, so as to realize the online measurement of starch water. The test shows that the system runs stably and reliably and meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: An online algorithm for local address assignment supporting P2P distributed computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider a special type of Peer to Peer (P2P) networks that all nodes have only a small number of reusable local addresses and there is no global unique address for each node. Use of local address avoids the problem of managing global unique address for large networks. There are two constraints on the local address assignment of distributed networks. One is that a node cannot have the same address as its neighbors and all neighbors of a node should have distinguish addresses. The other is that when a node is not assigned an address, it is in a "dormant" state and cannot establish communication with the surrounding nodes. Based on the above two assumptions, we propose an online algorithm for local address assignment supporting P2P distributed computing. Compared with the traditional off-line algorithm, it can dynamically assign addresses to new nodes and handle conflicts in existing online distributed networks. Analogous to the 2nd-order graph coloring problem, we proved that at most Δ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>+1 local addresses are needed for P2P distributed computing.

articleTitle: Refinement of UAV dynamics model through online identification: a model-data hybrid approach
abstract: This paper investigates how to precisely and efficiently obtain the dynamics model of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) which can used in single or swarm control. The UAVs are homogeneous in the mechanical structure, yet differ in a variety of unmodeled uncertainties, which cannot be ignored in high-fidelity simulation systems. To solve this, we propose a model-data hybrid approach that consists of two steps: 1) establishing a baseline model by first-principle; and 2) refining the model through online identification. More specifically, the baseline model is a linearized state equation with pending parameters. The parameters are adaptively determined through a least-squares identification algorithm based on real-time flight data. Finally, we design a comprehensive flight mission with 5 common modes (climbing, level flighting, turning, descending, and circling) for verification. The results of simulation experiment present a good consistency between the outputs of the refined dynamics model and the real flight data.

articleTitle: Redundant Dictionary based Pulse Wave Compressed Sensing
abstract: With the development of sensor technology and wireless communication technology, pulse wave based medical or healthcare instruments have become smaller, portable, and more intelligent. However, energy efficiency is still one of the obstacles for such devices in long term real-time use. Data compression can reduce energy wasting in communication. It is an efficient method for prolonging the lifetime of wireless pulse wave devices. Here, we present a redundant Gaussian dictionary (RGD) based compressed sensing (CS) framework for pulse signals compression. The dictionary is composed of atoms computed as samples of Gaussian function, and a set of parameters are given out for RGD generation. To verify the advantage of the proposed method, we compare the proposed RGD with discrete cosine transformation (DCT), wavelet transform (WT), fast Fourier transform (FFT), and Gabor dictionary. Meanwhile, experiments are done for the determination of the optimal combination of the proposed dictionary with the measurement matrix and reconstruction algorithm. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the RGD can increase the pulse wave reconstruction quality under a higher compression ratio combined with 1-bit measurement matrix and SL0 reconstruction algorithm, it achieves the best performance in MIMIC database testing, the pulse signals is well reconstructed with up to 82% data reduction.

articleTitle: Robust Face Recognition via Multi-scale Contextual Information Ensemble Learning
abstract: The study of robust face recognition has always gained much attention and has been widely applied to many social and public safety protection fields. Image patch based methods have achieved much more attractive performance. Especially, multi-scale patch based methods take the impact of different scales of the image patch into consideration. However, these methods ignore a fact that different parts of the face image contain different contextual semantic information which may be useful for the recognition task. To this end, in this study, we presented a robust face recognition approach by fully utilizing the multi-scale contextual information. Different from previous patch based methods, in our method, we select several patches around the test patch with a certain step in each window. Then the concatenated patch set is linearly represented over the corresponding patch sets on the training samples. By this consideration, the contextual topology can provide complementary contributions to the recognition, especially when the test faces have occlusions. Also, the multi-scale ensemble learning scheme is exploited to further enhance the recognition performance. Our extensive experiments have validated the superiority of our proposed approach over some state-of-the-art patch based robust face recognition approaches.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Track Jamming on Radar Data Processing
abstract: Track jamming can cause disorder in radar data processing process by generating false target trace points, which has low implementation difficulty in actual combat conditions and receives good interference effect. This paper analyzes the interference mechanism of track jamming, makes simulated analysis on the influence of track jamming on radar in the process of radar data processing involving links of track initiation, data correlation and tracking filtering. Experiments show that after the radar is disturbed by track jamming, a lot of resources will be consumed at the initiation and termination of the track, and there will be target data association error, making it impossible to establish or maintain accurate and stable tracking.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method based on TKPCR and its application in superheated steam system
abstract: The issue of multivariate statistical process monitoring is a popular research topic, within which fault diagnosis method faced to nonlinear systems is an important difficulties. This paper proposed a partial derivative contribution plot based on total kernel principal component regression (TKPCR) method which is a solution of the nonlinear process fault diagnosis problem. The TKPCR model is constructed to build the potential correlation between the input and the output matrix. Then, the input matrix X is decomposed into two orthogonal subspace, and two monitoring statistics T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub> are designed for fault detection. Then, we propose a comprehensive index C for fault diagnosis, which is composed of T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub> and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub>. Furthermore, we applied the partial derivate of kernel function to acquire the contribution of variables. The threshold values of each variable's contribution are given to obtain better fault diagnosis results. Finally, the model of the boiler steam superheat system is used to confirm the advantages of this method. In the simulation, the proposed method can obtain the faulty variables accurately for the nonlinear systems.

articleTitle: Online Energy-efficient Control of Urban Rail Train Operation Based on Switching Time Optimization
abstract: Traditional energy-saving driving strategy is to make the train track an off-line optimal speed curve in actual operation. Due to the disturbance in the daily operation of the train, the off-line optimal speed curve is no longer applicable to real situations. This paper studies the online energy-efficient control of single urban rail train operation within a fixed running time between two adjacent stations. A switched-mode system model is proposed to describe the inter-station running characteristics of a train. Based on this model, an optimization problem to minimize the energy consumption of the train is proposed. The optimal switching time can be calculated online by using a switching time optimization algorithm. Since the state transition matrix between adjacent switching times can be calculated offline, in this method, the computation cost is greatly reduced by allocating the operation with the largest proportion to the cost function and its derivative. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulations using the measured data of urban railway train.

articleTitle: Research on Architecture and Time-delay of Metallurgical Industry Cloud Control System
abstract: As a process industry, the metallurgical industry has harsh production conditions and complex control systems, making it difficult to achieve optimal operation, while the rise of cloud computing has brought new ideas to the metallurgical industry control in recent years. Cloud control system (CCS) is the application of cloud computing in industrial control schemes. According to the existing metallurgical industry control architecture, this paper proposes a structure of a metallurgical industry CCS. By analyzing the internal characteristics of the system, the system delay is decomposed into cloud delay and network delay, and the CCS time-delay model is obtained. Based on the established metallurgical industry CCS time-delay model, we design the delay controller by using state feedback and pole configuration methods, and propose a detailed internal structure model of the system. Finally, the typical links are simulated according to common signals in the metallurgical industry. The results show that the designed delay controller significantly improves the control performance of the metallurgical CCS.

articleTitle: Design of Electronic Control System of 8A Malt Roller Crusher
abstract: Due to complexity, high cost and other problems that the traditional roller crushers at different powers are selected according to different products, and the clearance of grinding roller is adjusted mainly through adjusting hand wheel in the control of clearance of grinding roller, the degree of automation is too low. The electronic control system of 8A malt roller crusher is designed to reach the automatic control level, mainly including design of speed system of grinding roller and design of clearance system of grinding roller according to the parameters of system, so as to complete design and achieve the expected crushing effect and finally ensure the operation of the electronic control system of 8A malt roller crusher.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Method for Fiber Nonlinear Compensation
abstract: As the optical system capacity increases rapidly, fiber nonlinear effect compensation has been considered as a key technology. In this work, a new nonlinear effects compensation method based on machine learning is proposed. We first convert the data into the patterns to compensate for the nonlinear inter-symbol interference (ISI). As a nonlinear tool, the artificial neural network (ANN) is trained by preprocessed patterns with supervision. Then support vector machine (SVM) is used to work as a classifier.

articleTitle: SOFC Stack Internal Temperature Estimation Based on Spatial-temporal Distribution Laws
abstract: Solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) stack internal temperature distribution is an important index for stack performance management. Due to the strict gas sealing requirement of SOFC, temperature measuring devices cannot be installed within an acceptable cost and designing an observer to estimate stack inner temperature is an efficient way. However, as for the hydrocarbon fueled SOFC system, the dimension of system input and state variables is very high due to the complex fuel composition, which challenges the observer design. In this work, from the perspective of practical application, a novel method that quickly obtain the stack temperature distribution by extracting spatial-temporal stack temperature distribution features under different operating conditions is proposed. Firstly, the temperature distribution data is generated by a validated mechanism SOFC system model, and then the spatial and temporal features of the temperature distribution are grasped by employing Multivariable Linear Regression (MLR) algorithm. Fusing the information of SOFC center node temperature and the spatial- temporal temperature distribution laws, the SOFC temperature distribution can be obtained. Simulation results show that the MLR model can accurately describe the temperature distribution characteristics under various operation conditions, which paves the way for quickly and accurately obtaining of SOFC stack internal temperature distribution.

articleTitle: Research and Application of High Performance AC-DC-AC Drive System for Hot Strip Coiler
abstract: At present, most of the hot-rolled strip coilers are excitation synchronous motors or asynchronous motors around 1000kW/660V. The article analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the synchronous motors and the asynchronous motors as the hot rolling coiler, introduces the steel rolling process of the coiler, discusses the characteristics and performance of the excitation synchronous motors as the coiler , and explains the selection of two-level AC-DC-AC inverter and the configuration scheme of the electric control system, this paper expounds the vector control system of the high-performance strip coiler and several key technologies in its application, and analyzes the practical application of high-performace AC-DC-AC Drive System for hot-rolled strip coilers.

articleTitle: Recognition of Disordered Targets for Robot Based on 3D Visual Clustering and Matching
abstract: For the problem of the classification and location of flat workpieces with weak texture, high similarity and no significant normal angle feature in the sorting task of industrial robot, an algorithm about recognition of disordered targets for robot based on 3D convexity clustering and E-ICP matching is proposed, which provides the strategy of motion planning for the manipulator to grasp. Firstly, the preprocessed point cloud is segmented into super voxel blocks and clustered by locally convex connection. Then the multiple point cloud clusters are smoothed by MLS respectively to solve the fluctuation of sensor data. After that, in order to reduce the mismatches and improve the running speed, the edges are extracted by the angles among the direction vectors formed by the three-dimensional points of the point cloud cluster and their neighboring points in the local coordinate system. Next, rough matching and fine matching through E-ICP (Edge-ICP) algorithm are carried out between the clusters and the target model in the database. Finally, based on the nearest average distances in the matching, the sort of scores is carried out to complete the tasks of target recognition and pose estimation. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Searching Algorithm for the Central Anchor Position of the High Speed Railway on Long Straight Line with a large slope
abstract: In view of the inaccuracy of existing methods for calculating the central anchor position and the lack of calculation method for the central anchor clamp position on long straight line section with a large slope, the current work introduces the slope of a line and uses the measured length of a span to calculate the tension difference of a wire caused by the deviation of a dropper and a positioning device in the line direction. According to the obtained tension difference and downhill component force caused by the gravity of the wire, the position of the central anchor is calculated. Then, according to the position of the central anchor knot, the tension difference of the dropper offset, the tension difference of the positioning device offset and downhill component force caused by the gravity of the wire, the position of the central anchor knot clamp is calculated. The maximum relative error of the position of the central anchor rope clamp obtained by this method is 1.401%, thus verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of radiation and concept design of mobile radiation measurement design for NNBI facility
abstract: To ensure safely operation and maintenance for NNBI laboratory personnel, the neutron radiation in NNBI deuterium-charged operation was studied. That can provide some guidance for shielding design. In order to master the radiation dose of NNBI during the operation and shutdown timely, it is necessary to design a suitable system to measure the NNBI radiation. Therefore, it can guide the worker and maintenance personnel to work safely. Due to the complexity of NNBI's geometric structure and physical process, the neutron source strength radiation dose at the critical position of NNBI are evaluated based on the LMM local model and MCNP code. The results demonstrate that the calorimeter is the main neutron source region. When the deuterium ion energy is 400keV and the pulse is greater than 100s, and the neutron intensity of the target is 1E+12n/(A · s). The maximum radiation dose rate can reach up to 1E+08 μSv/h. For such a high radiation dose rate, An appropriate radiation measurement methods need to be designed. The design of radiation measurement based on Rob robot mobile platform can effectively reduce the harm of radiation to maintenance personnel.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of high-speed maglev train controller parameters on the vibration of the vehicle-bridge system
abstract: High-speed maglev is more likely to vibrate when suspended in bridge because the bridge is not absolutely rigid and it will deform and vibrate when excited by the electro-magnetic force. The electromagnetic force is generated by the electromagnet driven by the controller. When the controller parameters are not appropriate, the bridge and the car are easily coupled with vibration. To analyze the problem, a dynamic model of the vehicle and bridge for the high-speed maglev train is established. The electromagnetic equation and control system equation of the levitation system is given. Then the influence of different controller parameters on the coupling system is analyzed. Appropriate range of controller parameter k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> from 500000 to 2000000, that within this range, k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>,k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> and ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> have little effect on coupling vibration. When the k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> is greater than 2000000, the coupling vibration of the system is large and the performance becomes worse. But increased k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>,k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> and ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> can suppress vibration.

articleTitle: A Topology Control Algorithm Based on 3-Dimensional Minimally Rigid Graph in Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: This paper proposes an algorithm based on 3-Dimensional minimally rigid graph focusing on the topology control problem in the study of the wireless sensor networks (WSN). Based on generating the 3D minimally rigid graph, the algorithm limits the node degree to reduces the degree variance. The research results prove that the average node degree of the topology constructed by this algorithm tends to be the optimal value 6. Moreover, the algorithm can effectively balance the node energy consumption and improve the network connectivity. Simulation results further verify the algorithm validity.

articleTitle: Estimation of Overflow Loss of Trailing Suction Hopper Dredger Based on TLBO-PF Algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the problem of using PF to estimate the value of overflow loss in the process of replacing the optimal value and reducing the particle difference in the estimation process, this paper proposes an estimation algorithm based on PF and the fusion of the improved TLBO algorithm (TLBO-PF) applied to the overflow Estimation of flow loss. By optimizing the PF reference distribution, the problem of replacing the optimal problem caused by the high probability density region of particle changes during the estimation process is solved. Replace TLBO with PF resampling process to solve the problem of degradation in PF resampling process. By improving the teaching and learning process, the problem of local optimization of probability overlap in the estimation of overflow loss using TLBO instead of PF resampling is solved. TLBO and PF are fused to achieve a large number of sampled particles in the overflow estimation process while making the results easier and excellent, and simulation verification. Compared with the estimated value of PF, the error of the TLBO-PF estimation of the total volume in series is reduced by 4%, and the error of the total mass estimation is reduced by 34%, thus indicating that the TLBO-PF estimation performance is good.

articleTitle: Delay dependent H∞ control for stochastic delay systems perturbed by jump random noise
abstract: The H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller design for delay systems perturbed by jump-type random events, i.e., stochastic delay systems perturbed by Poisson process (PP), is discussed in this paper. From stochastic analysis, this paper provides a bounded real lemma (BRL). In terms of the derived BRL, this paper designs an H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller for stochastic delay systems perturbed by Poisson process (SDSPBPPs).

articleTitle: Odometry Estimation Utilizing 6-DOF Force Sensors and IMU for Legged Robot
abstract: Odometry estimation is the problem of estimating platform pose utilizing different types of sensors. Visual odometry calculates the translation and rotation of two frames by extracting and matching feature points. However, it cannot function properly in some situations, such as dark environment or scenes with repeated textures. In rescuing scenario with poor visibility, fire-fighting robots and nuclear power plant rescue robots can not localize itself by solely depending on visual information. A real-time high precision odometry estimation method based on 6-DOF force sensors and IMU for legged robot, which can overcome the above limitations, is proposed in this paper. The odometry estimation method is realized by real-time robot posture estimation through 6-DOF force sensors mounted on the legs of legged robot. We combine particle filter and Quasi RNN network to build particle filter net. Through the fusion of 6-DOF force sensors and IMU using particle filter net, real-time odometry estimation with high precision is achieved. Compared with the state of art, our method has advantages of higher accuracy, faster computation speed and broader application scenarios for legged robot.

articleTitle: Semi-global Output Consensus of Multi-satellite Systems Based on Characteristic Model Method with Disturbance and Actuator Saturation
abstract: Semi-global output consensus problem of multi-satellite systems described by characteristic model is addressed in this paper. In this system, we consider the follower satellites subject to actuator saturation and external disturbances. Based on the low-gain feedback method and modified algebraic Riccati equation (MARE), we propose a distributed consensus algorithm such that under a connected communication graph and a reachable leader, the follower satellites can achieve semi-global output consensus when using the proposed algorithm. The effectiveness of this method has been substantiated in the simulation part.

articleTitle: An Antenna Diversity-Aided Channel Network for Wireless Channel Estimation
abstract: To estimate channel response is a remarkably challenging task for the wireless communication systems due to the extremely fast time-varying characteristic of channel, such as vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) channel. In this paper, an antenna diversity-aided neural network is proposed for wireless channel estimation. A demodulation reference signals-aided maximal ratio combining estimator is presented to extend the demodulation reference signals into tentative channel response. A super-resolution residual network is utilized to track the variations of V2V channel by extracting the time-frequency correlation of data symbols and a denoise network is used to removing the noise by extracting the noise distribution information of data symbols. Numerical simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed an antenna diversity-aided channel network.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of A Wireless Heating Electric Soldering Iron
abstract: In this paper, a wireless heating electric soldering iron was designed by using electromagnetic induction technology and eddy current heating principle. Through the combination design of software and hardware, the soldering iron can realize automatic load detection, instantaneous heating and automatic heating temperature control, moreover, it can effectively prevent the damage of static electricity to the welding elements, which is convenient to operate and low in energy consumption.

articleTitle: Robust tracking control of non-affine systems under unknown control directions and uncertain trajectory
abstract: This paper studies the tracking control problem with unknown trajectory for a class of non-affine systems subject to unknown control directions. The non-affine dynamics, uncertain tracking trajectory and unknown control directions make the control synthesis much nontrivial. To circumvent these difficulties mentioned above, we employ some techniques. Firstly, a core function method is utilized to compensate the uncertainties inherent in the non-affine dynamics; Secondly, the concept of refitted curve is introduced to deal with the uncertain tracking trajectory; Thirdly, a novel Nussbaum function is introduced into the controller design to circumvent the unknown control direction; Finally, the uniformly ultimately boundedness (UUB) result of the tracking error is ensured, and all internal signals are ensured to be bounded. Simulation examples verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Segmentation and Feature Extraction of Infants’ Hip Joint Ultrasound Images
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a segmentation method for infant hip joint ultrasound images as well as an extraction method of interested region. The method segments the infant hip joint of ultrasound image twice to achieve the optimal segmentation result. The problem of intensities inhomogeneities existing in medical images is solved by mapping the evolved level set functions in the first segmentation procedure into a new, homogenous gray level image. In the second segmentation, shape prior and regularization term are introduced into the original CV model to optimize the segmentation results. The shape prior is used again after segmentation to extract interested regions and related features from segmented image. Experimental results show that our method achieves better segmentation results than existing methods. Besides, our method is superior to other methods on extracting regions of interest.

articleTitle: Temporal Hints in 3D Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: Due to severe self-occlusions and complex articulated pose in hand motion, 3D hand pose estimation remains a challenging task. Most of the state-of-the-art approaches focus on how to extract spatial information effectively around the hand while ignoring the temporal consistency of hand motion, which may give hints on the locations of the occluded joints in the current frame. Inspired by solutions in action recognition, we propose to use temporal information to alleviate hand pose estimation. Specifically, we use a temporal branch to efficiently extract the temporal information of continuous image frames with negligible computational costs through convolution. By combining spatial information, our network can output more accurate hand pose estimation results. We conduct experiments on datasets with consecutive frames. Compared with methods that only use spatial information, our network achieves lower prediction errors. The experimental results also confirm our idea that the temporal information of hand motion is helpful for hand pose estimation.

articleTitle: A Point Cloud Connectivity Reduction Algorithm Based on Distance Thresholds
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of target identification and positioning in the unstructured environment of industrial sites, a point cloud connectivity reduction method is proposed for calculating the near-neighbor average Euclidean distance of the workpiece point cloud boundary K to address the connectivity problem between stacked workpiece point cloud data. Firstlyˈthe boundaries of the point cloud data will be extracted; secondly, the average Euclidean distance from the point cloud boundaries to the non-boundary points of K nearest neighbors will be calculated. The characteristics of the average Euclidean distance distribution at different points on the boundaries will be analyzed, divides the boundary points into junction boundary points and non-junction boundary points, and sets a reasonable distance threshold as a screening condition to remove the junction point clouds and retain the original boundary information to the maximum extent will be set. Finally, the identification rates of three pipe joints are analyzed in the constructed experimental platform. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the connectivity of point clouds and improve the success rate of subsequent identification, with the average success rate of target identification increasing from the original 90.3% to the present 96.3%.

articleTitle: Neural Networks-based Multiple Model Control of a Class of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Parameters
abstract: A novel nonlinear system adaptive control method based on neural networks is proposed for a class of nonlinear discrete-time systems with unknown parameters. The nonlinear dynamics are first represented by the linear part and the nonlinear part. For the linear part, several fixed models are established by the localization method. At the same time, in order to improve the control quality and accelerate the convergence of the system parameters, two adaptive models are introduced. For the nonlinear part, its model can be set up by a neural network. Then, robust adaptive controllers are designed based on the fixed model, adaptive model and nonlinear model. In practice, the sub-model which is most suitable for the system is selected according to the switching rule, and the corresponding control law is implemented. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the transient performance of the system.

articleTitle: A short review on the durability test protocols of hydrogen fuel cell stack of vehicle application by testbench
abstract: Durability, or sometimes called lifetime of fuel cell stack, is the prime parameter of the polymer electrolyte exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) electrical vehicles. Vehicle operations include some driving state which will affect the output behavior of fuel cell stack. Some key driving states are analyzed, and they have significant effects on the durability of PEMFC stacks. Released durability test protocols are reviewed and compared from based on these key driving states. These durability test protocols can be good references on evaluation of fuel cell stack and development of the fuel cell electrical vehicle (FCEV).

Author Keywords: Polymer electrolyte exchange membrane fuel cell

articleTitle: The attitude control of rotorcraft aerial manipulator with saturated control action
abstract: The rotorcraft aerial manipulator (RAM) system is a nonlinear system with strong coupling characteristics, which can actively operate the target object in the flight state. When the manipulator of RAM is moving, the system may suffer from attitude disturbance to cause control input saturation. This paper designed a cascade controller constituted by PID controller and conditioned super-twisting algorithm (STA) for UAV attitude control, which can ensure stability and robustness of system and mitigate windup effect of control action. Besides, the extended state observer (ESO) is utilized to estimate the disturbance. Finally, through the simulation experiment on MATLAB, the validity of the controller is verified. The results demonstrate the robustness and anti-windup effect of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of active ultra-low frequency vertical vibration isolator for atom interferometry
abstract: An active vibration isolation equipment for isolating low frequency ground vibration of cold atom interferometry is demonstrated experimentally. This system combines the passive vibration isolator of negative stiffness elements and voice coil motor actuator can be used to counteract the ground vibration force measured by the seismometer. The processor with high integration and fast computation can be applied to the algorithm of active vibration isolation. Passive vibration isolation equipment can handle vibration above 10 Hz With the feedback path closed, the vertical vibration noise is greatly reduced by a factor of 100 from 0.1 to 10Hz With the help of active vibration isolation equipment, cold atom gravimeter can measure gravity precisely.

articleTitle: Detection Algorithm of Infrared Dim Small Target Based on FPGA
abstract: The traditional infrared dim and small target detection algorithm is generally implemented by DSP (Digital Signal Processing) processor, which is complex and has poor real-time performance. In this paper, a FAST (Features from Accelerated Segment Test) algorithm of adaptive threshold based on FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) is proposed to detect infrared dim and small target. Based on the characteristics of FPGA parallel processing, the hardware acceleration of algorithm is realized by pipeline design. The improved adaptive threshold method can generate appropriate thresholds according to different environments, and avoid the loss or redundancy of dim and small infrared targets due to improper threshold selection. At last, two different groups of infrared images are used for experiment, the results show that the algorithm can detect the dim and small targets in the infrared image in real time, and can achieve high detection rate and low false alarm rate, which meets the requirements of real-time and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on a Strategy of Suppressing Grid Flicker Caused by Wind Turbine Based on Independent Pitch Control
abstract: Wind power is a kind of green energy, renewable, pollution-free, inexhaustible, so wind power has a broad market prospects, its technology is also in continuous progress, wind turbine assembly unit capacity is higher and higher, the scale of wind farm is also towards large-scale development. As the capacity of wind turbine assembly increases, the blade diameter of the matching wind turbine needs to be increased correspondingly to obtain more wind energy. Taking offshore wind turbine as a representative, the blade diameter of some wind turbines has reached more than 100 meters. When the blade diameter becomes larger, it will bring a series of problems. The main performance is that the elasticity and flexibility of wind turbine tower, transmission shaft, blades and other main components will increase correspondingly, while the damping value of power electronic components will be smaller. These problems make the fatigue load variable of large wind turbine more complex, which will lead to the low frequency mode of the unit The more complex the modes are, the more complex they are. When the diameter of the wind turbine increases, the pitch angle increases due to tower shadow effect, wind shear and turbulence time-varying factors, which causes the blade to swing and shimmy more significantly, and then causes the fatigue load condition of the wind turbine to be more obvious, which seriously affects the mechanical stress intensity change between various transmission mechanisms of the wind turbine, thus reducing the service life of the wind turbine Limit. With the increase of blade diameter, the frequency of grid flicker will also be caused, which will cause voltage instability and reduce the power quality of grid after the wind turbine is connected to the grid. With the increase of impeller diameter and fan capacity, in recent years, independent variable pitch control technology came into being.Independent pitch control technology not only has the characteristics of centralized pitch control, but also can balance the unbalanced load on variable speed wind turbine, so as to reduce the fatigue load of wind turbine. Therefore, it has been paid attention to in the field of wind power research in the world. There are many research results in this area, but the research on the relationship between independent pitch control strategy and grid flicker is relatively less. The factors causing voltage fluctuation include air density, impeller speed, pitch angle, wind field distribution and power grid condition. This paper analyzes the wind shear and tower shadow effect which cause the vibration of wind turbine, studies the relationship between independent pitch strategy and wind turbine voltage change, proposes a control strategy of independent pitch and designs a controller to control the power of wind turbine during operation The method of voltage variation to make it stable, and then reduce the flicker of power grid, and carry out simulation experiments to verify its effectiveness. The control strategy can reduce the grid flicker at the common point of wind turbine outlet and grid connection, improve the stability of wind turbine grid connection, and improve the overall power quality of the grid.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Test Case Generation Method Based on CoGAN Industrial Network Protocol
abstract: To solve the problems of low vulnerability triggering rate and low-test efficiency in fuzzy testing of existing industrial control network protocols, a test case generation method based on CoGAN was proposed. The method study normal industrial control network protocol format and grammar, learning anomaly and vulnerability information at the same time, the reuse of trained generator is meet the requirements of the network protocol format and with abnormal or vulnerability information characteristics of test cases, so as to reduce the test cost, improve test efficiency and increase the purpose of the vulnerability trigger rate. Experimental results show that the proposed test case generation method has significant optimization effect and vulnerability detection ability to improve protocol fuzzy testing performance, and finds a "zero-day vulnerability".

articleTitle: Intelligent Driving System for Hot In-place Recycling Heating Vehicle
abstract: In order to improve the harsh working environment such as high temperature and soot faced by the operators of hot in-place recycling heating vehicle, and to increase the intelligent level of heater control, an intelligent driving system composed of a differential GPS positioning system, a path planning system, a vehicle control system and a management center was designed It uses coordinate transformation and the least square algorithm to achieve high-precision path fitting. The Newton method is used to calculate the deviation from the point to the fitting curve, and a double closed-loop PID controller is used to achieve accurate path tracking. The field test results show that the vehicle can be controlled by intelligent driving system to walk along the pre-construction route, and the lateral control accuracy is within ±30mm, which meets the requirements of the hot in-place recycling construction process.

articleTitle: Multiple Targets Tracking with Compact High-Frequency Surface Wave Radar
abstract: Compact High-frequency Surface Wave Radar (HFSWR) can detect ship targets, which has the characteristics of high Doppler velocity accuracy. However, limited by the wavelength and system of the radar, the radial range and azimuth detection accuracy of HFSWR is low. A multi-target tracking method by compact HFSWR is proposed in this paper. The track initiation and track association are performed in polar coordinates and target tracking is performed in Cartesian coordinates. According to radar detection characteristics and ship motion characteristics, the M/N logic method is used for track initiation, the minimum cost association algorithm is used for track association. Finally, the conversion measurement Kalman filter is used for tracking. Finally, a simulation experiment was carried out using the measured Compact HFSWR data and compared with the track of the Automatic Ship Identification System (AIS). The experimental results show that the proposed tracking process can effectively realize the multi-target tracking of the high frequency surface wave radar at sea.

articleTitle: External multi-fluid disturbance analysis of SAW micro-pressure sensor
abstract: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) micro-pressure sensor, which is a microelectronic integrated sensor, has important research significance for measuring microclearance pressure. In this paper, a coupling model of SAW sensor and fluid is analyzed using the finite element method. Simulation experiments show the influence of three different fluid actions on sensor data measurement.
