articleTitle: Deep Embedded Clustering with Asymmetric Residual Autoencoder
abstract: Deep clustering methods have obtained excellent performance on clustering tasks with the benefit of feature representations learned with deep neural networks. Even though promising performance of deep clustering has been shown in different applications, the efficiency of the features achieved is limited by the symmetric structure of the autoencoders employed. Deeper autoencoder will lead to less reliable features extracted from the encoder due to the strong decoding capability of the symmetric deep decoder. To address this issue, a novel Asymmetric Deep Residual Embedded Clustering algorithm is proposed in this paper. Specifically, an asymmetric residual deep autoencoder is constructed to learn the features embedded in high dimensional data. The asymmetric residual autoencoder uses residual connection to enhance the feature extraction ability of the encoder with deeper network, while a shallow CNN is adopted as the decoder. This arrangement could make the feature representation ability of the encoder stronger than decoder's reconstruction ability, which ensures the reliability of the extracted features. In addition, a clustering layer has been incorporated to form an end to end solution. Experiments on benchmark datasets have shown the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Modulated Model Predictive Control for Three Phase Voltage Source Inverter
abstract: The classical model predictive control(MPC) is frequency conversion control, which will lead to larger ripples of the output variables. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a fixed frequency model predictive current control strategy based on space vector modulation(SVM). This strategy combines the switching sequence distribution method of continuous SVM to divide the voltage vector to reconstruct the control set. The constructed control set consists of four voltage vectors, including two effective voltage vectors and two zero voltage vectors. In order to reduce the current ripple through the smallest current error in each sampling period, the cost function is improved. Finally, simulation and experiment verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme.

articleTitle: Fault Detection using Common and Specific Variable Decomposition for Nonlinear Multimode Process
abstract: Due to the change of operating conditions including external environments and production schemes, there are usually multiple modes in most industrial processes. Moreover, different linear and nonlinear correlations simultaneously coexist in different modes, which brings difficulty to fault detection. Aiming at this problem, the paper proposes a fault detection method using common and specific variable decomposition for nonlinear multimode process. The proposed method takes into account the linear and nonlinear correlations in different modes and utilizes the common and specific modeling ideas for enhancing the performance of fault detection in multimode process. First, the multimode process data are divided into the common variable subspace and the specific variable subspace based on sliding window low-order and high-order statistics. Then, the nonlinearity coefficient is used to evaluate the linear and nonlinear correlations for each variable subspace. Subsequently, the common and specific PCA-KPCA-SPCA-based multimode process modeling is developed for fault detection. The fault detection results of the Tennessee Eastman (TE) process demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Study on Recognition Algorithm of Ultrasonic Sensing Gesture Based on Improved Hidden Markov Model
abstract: Gesture is a convenient means of humancomputer interaction. After ultrasonic sensing and extraction of gesture feature sequence, Hidden Markov Model is commonly used to recognize gesture categories. Aiming at the problem that the accuracy of gesture recognition algorithm based on conventional Hidden Markov Model is unsatisfactory, a recognition algorithm of ultrasonic sensing gesture based on improved Hidden Markov Model was proposed in this paper. In this algorithm, state transition probability matrix was improved by Support Vector Machine, and the output probabilities of hidden states in the state sequence were processed by Sigmoid function to optimize the classification performance, so as to improve the accuracy of gesture recognition. In this paper, eight gesture recognition experiments were carried out and the test results showed that the improved algorithm based on Hidden Markov Model optimized by Support Vector Machine could accurately recognize gesture, and the average recognition rate is 94.625 percent, which is 10.35 percent higher than that of conventional Hidden Markov Model. And for each gesture, the recognition rate of the proposed method in this paper was higher than that of based on conventional Hidden Markov Model.

articleTitle: A Novel Fast Decision-making Method for Ship’s Course Altering for Collision Avoidance
abstract: Ship automatic collision avoidance is the key technology of unmanned ship. Aiming at the problem of computational time of collision avoidance decision-making for multi-ship encounter situations, a novel fast decision-making method for ship’s course altering for collision avoidance is proposed. To reduce the number of calculation targets, cluster analysis is introduced to classify multiple target ships with similar attributes into one group ship. Under the constraints of International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, candidate solutions are determined based on own ship’s length and encounter situation. Taking the voyage losses as the objective function, a deterministic optimization algorithm is used to rapidly obtain the optimal course altering decision for collision avoidance in the global scope. The simulation results show that the method is safe and efficient, and can provide decision support for the automatic collision avoidance of ships.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting based on MB-LSTM neural network
abstract: Short term load forecasting is the basic work for the safe and stable operation of power system. With the development of power market, the variability and randomness of short-term load increase the complexity of power load. Higher requirements are put forward for the accuracy of load forecasting. In this paper, a short-term load forecasting framework based on multi-layer stacked bidirectional long short-term memory (MB-LSTM) is proposed. The goal of the model is to solve the problem of error accumulation caused by traditional LSTM and improve the forecasting accuracy. A feedback mechanism is designed to improve the unidirectionality of traditional LSTM network prediction. In order to help the convergence to the optimal solution more quickly, the correlation between the historical load data is mined by the deep learning training method of multi-layer superposition. Finally, the experimental results show that the method can extract data features on the basis of the prediction results, and the effectiveness of the improved method is proved by comparing and analyzing the traditional prediction models.

Author Keywords: Bidirectional Long Short-term Memory Neural Network

articleTitle: Deep Multi-Grasp Detection Network via Augmented Heatmap Regression
abstract: Detecting multiple grasping candidates from images simultaneously is more adaptable and efficient in various environments compared to the single grasp detection. In this paper, we establish a novel multi-grasp detection dataset called NMGD, which contains more than 2000 images with up to 14,000 qualified grasping annotations across different objects and layouts. In the scenario of the multi-grasp detection, spatial information inside the images plays a crucial role. However, the fully-connected layer commonly used in the literature for the single grasp detection drops the spatial information and is more likely over-fitting to lose the generalization ability. To avoid the spatial information loss, we propose an augmented heatmap regression method based on Hourglass module which effectively extracts and embeds the spatial information to perform the multi-grasp detection. The proposed method is validated and illustrated by extensive experiments and real robotic grasping trials. Codes and samples of NMGD dataset is made public in https://github.com/JingyuYang1997/NMGDN.

articleTitle: An integrated optimization approach of high-speed railway line plan to network load-balancing
abstract: With the continuous expansion of China’s high-speed railway (HSR) network, the necessity of studying operating performance from the network perspective becomes prominent. To improve the economic benefits, social benefits and operating performance with constraints of limited transport resources, this paper presents a mixed-integer nonlinear optimization model of HSR line planning problem, integrating operation route plan, train stop plan and passenger distribution plan. Moreover, a two-stage hybrid heuristic search algorithm is designed to solve this model. Finally, numerical experiments are implemented to demonstrate the performance of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Multi-objective Environmental Economic Power Dispatching based on Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm
abstract: The multi-objective environmental/economic power dispatch (MOEED) problem owns a barrier that lots of constraints makes the solving become difficult. To overcome this difficulty, we propose an improved whale optimization algorithm (IWOA) to obtain the best compromise solution. The proposed IWOA algorithm can improve the shortcomings of the standard whale optimization algorithm (WOA). The WOA falls into local optimal frequently and has unstable optimization efficiency. A constrained handling method based on Pareto-dominant (CHMP) is proposed to solve inequality constraints. These strategies have been examined in IEEE 30node system and IEEE 57-node system. The research results reveal that the IWOA can settle the environmental economic dispatch problem of power system effectively.

articleTitle: Robust consensus for general second-order multi-agent systems with time-delay and randomly switching topologies
abstract: The article studies consensus problem with and without disturbance rejection for general second order multi-agent systems subject to random switching topology and constant time delay. The change of topologies is dominated by continuoustime Markov process. Then the consensus problem is transformed into a stability problem by making use of tree-type transformation. The sufficient conditions of consensus and consensus with H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance are gained by establishing linear matrix inequation (LMI). Through solving LMI, we gain the upper bound of delay. Finally, the result were verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the data filling model for the turning motion of the training boat with missing observations
abstract: In order to process the missing turning motion observations of training boat, a data filling model scheme based on the combination of ARIMA (Autoregressive integrated moving average model) and Kalman filtering was proposed in this paper. Firstly, ARIMA was modelled to forecast the missing course observations. Then, the ARIMA model was converted to state space model, and Kalman filtering was employed to recursively estimate the state of yaw acceleration provided the prediction accuracy is unsatisfactory. Subsequently, fuzzy rules were designed to optimize the missing observations of course to prevent errors caused by extrapolating from different initial values. Finally, the optimized series of course were utilized to estimate the missing ship positions in the polar coordinate mode. A case study of the training boat turning motion at sea verifies the effectiveness of proposed scheme, which is beneficial for the usages of sampling data and the reduction cost of ship trials.

articleTitle: Multi-motor underwater coordinated control system based on virtual spindle
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low control accuracy and slow dynamic response caused by the unbalanced motor load under complex disturbance when the underwater vehicle driven by dual motors is moving underwater, the underwater dual motor control strategy of virtual spindle control is given. First, establish the relationship between the underwater dynamic model and the motion model and the torque variable generated in the motor control process. Then combined fuzzy control and fractional PID algorithm to construct a FFO(fuzzy fractional-order) PID controller, and establish a FFO PID dual-motor synchronization control scheme based on virtual spindle synchronization control strategy to improve the motor coordinated control ability in response to changing loads. Finally, the underwater dynamic balance control is completed, and the underwater coordinated control of dual motors is realized. The simulation results show that, compared with the traditional integer-order PID, this control strategy can improve the system control performance and is more robust.

articleTitle: Vision Based Autonomous Tracking of UAVs Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Air-ground cooperation is of great importance in certain extreme environment missions, which require real-time tracking of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) on the ground vehicle. As reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved great success in many challenges of planning and control, a research on path planning of UAVs for object tracking based on RL is presented, considering images from a visual sensor as the input. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) and a spatial soft-max layer are used to detect the object in the images. The tracking results of a filter CSR-DCF based on OpenCV are combined with the output of CNN to improve training efficiency and obtain better tracking performance. Three independent experiments are conducted with different conditions in simulated environments where a quadcopter is trained to track a ground robot based on V-REP. Valid results show that the UAV has good performance in the tracking work with MAE of 0.23m in x and 0.19m in y.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Adaptive Optimal Control of UAV
abstract: This paper studies a data-driven adaptive optimal attitude control problem of a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) via state feedback. A novel sampled-data-based adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) method is developed. We consider the uncertain system parameters and external disturbances. Then the optimal feedback gain is iteratively learned by input/state information. The stability of this method is ensured theoretically. Finally, simulation results are presented to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Robust Non-rigid Point Set Registration Based on Global and Local Mixture Structural Feature
abstract: This paper proposes a mixture structural feature based non-rigid point set registration algorithm, this algorithm mainly contains correspondence estimation and space transformation. In the step of correspondence estimation, Euclidean distance and angle based global and local structural features are used to describe structural difference between two point sets. Then the global and local structural features are combined to construct a cost function, which provides the correspondence by minimizing structural difference using a linear assignment method. In the step of space transformation, a thin plate spline function is used to solves space transformation problem of the source point set. The performances of the proposed algorithm are verified by simulation data and real data, and compare with four classical algorithms where proposed algorithm achieves the best alignment in most cases.

articleTitle: Reentry Trajectory Optimization of Powered Hypersonic Vehicle for Improving Range based on Discontinuous Ignition
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the discontinuous ignition reentry optimization problem of powered hypersonic vehicle, the reentry trajectory characteristics at different ignition time and ignition duration are analyzed by multiphase Gauss pseudospectral method. Given the attack angle and piecewise linear function described bank angle profiles, the problem of discontinuous ignition for powered reentry trajectory optimization is transformed into a parameter planning problem of ignition time, ignition duration, bank angle parameters and total flight time. By solving the nonlinear multi-constraint parameter optimization problem, the optimal ignition time, ignition duration and bank angle are obtained. Zero value bank angle and real-time calculation bank angle simulation examples are designed to optimize bank angle and ignition commands, respectively. The simulation results show that the discontinuous ignition reentry trajectory optimization problem of powered hypersonic vehicle can be solved by parameterized bank angle profile.

articleTitle: Design of ADRC for Guidance System of High Speed Maglev Train
abstract: The guidance system of electromagnetic suspension high speed maglev train is a complex coupled nonlinear system, which will be subjected to complex interference force during its operation. Due to the external interference and the change of system parameters, the controller based on single linearization model can not maintain good control performance all the time. Aiming at this problem, the Active Disturbance Rejection Controller (ADRC) of the guidance system is designed. Firstly, the guidance system model is established and the classical linear quadratic regulator (LQR) is designed. Secondly, a linear extended state observer (LESO) and an active disturbance control law are designed. Finally, the two algorithms are simulated in the nonlinear model of the guidance system. The results show that the ADRC is more robust and the control effect is satisfying when adding disturbance force and gap disturbance in the guidance system.

articleTitle: Image segmentation and object measurement based on stereo vision
abstract: Stereo vision is an effective measurement method, which uses the principle of triangulation to obtain the three- dimensional information of the surface points of the object. Image pre-processing is the processing of input image before segmentation and matching in image analysis [1], which the core issue is Segmentation. Only accurate segmentation of the measured object can accurately measure its volume. Firstly, the measurement volume generates three-dimensional point cloud; Secondly, the object contour was obtained and traversed from the point cloud, and the largest and smallest contour was filtered. Secondly, the smallest rectangle of the contour and the coordinates of four vertices of the rectangle are obtained. Finally the size of the object was calculated. Only volume of the object was accurately measured, it can provide a more efficient basis for the grasping strategy of the manipulator. In this paper, the accuracy of the volume measurement of the object is obviously improved by the improved vision algorithm.

articleTitle: Frequency Control Strategy of Isolated Grid System Using Sliding Mode Algorithm
abstract: Frequency stability is a primary condition for secure operation of isolated micro-grid. However, the load frequency control (LFC) is complicated with parameter uncertainties and external disturbances. This letter concentrates on addressing the critical problem of frequency deviations by a novel sliding mode control (SMC). Firstly, a model of the island micro-grid LFC is investigated. Secondly, Secondly, a SMC based on disturbance observer is designed for isolated systems, where a neural network observer is presented to estimate disturbances. Finally, several simulation examples are carried out to verify the feasibility of the SMC, which can eliminate the frequency deviations.

articleTitle: Copula-based JITL for polyester fiber polymerization process modeling
abstract: The polymerization process is the critical stage of polyester production, and the reaction mechanism of the polymerization process is complex and involves a large number of variables. The melt intrinsic viscosity is an essential indicator of the polymer, control and prediction of melt intrinsic viscosity is particularly crucial for the synthetic fibers industry. This paper introduces the Copula feature selection method, and nonlinear features of the polymerization process are selected to establish the least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) model for the viscosity prediction. Since the Just-in-time learning (JITL) can account for the dynamic behavior of the process, and the Copula function can determine the nonparametric measure of the dependence between variables, a Copula-based JITL is proposed for viscosity prediction of polyester fiber polymerization process. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is verified by the actual industrial data.

articleTitle: A Kind of Nonlinear Observer Design
abstract: This paper surveys the results of nonlinear observer design. The observer is designed for nonlinear systems, where the nonlinear terms are output dependent. The nonlinear observer is designed by introducing an updated high gain in order to obtain the asymptotical stability of the designed observer. The validity of the proposed observer is shown through an example.

articleTitle: A Preliminary RSWKS Framework for Multiple Chang Points (MCPs) Detection on Pathological Signal Analysis in Partial Epilepsy
abstract: In order to better interpret and early detect the heart abnormalities, in this paper a preliminary RSWKS framework describes the implementation of multiple change-points (MCPs) detection on pathological ECG signal analyses of post-ictal heart rate oscillations in partial epilepsy. In our random slide window (RSW) method, the slide window size is randomly selected from an optional set predefined by practical data features and experimental knowledge, then the resultant MCPs are obtained by means of KS statistics from each slide window. By comparing with the fixed slide window (FSW) approach, the proposed RSWKS is evaluated by using synthetic time series, as well as ECG samples of postictal heart rate oscillations in partial epilepsy. Then, the abnormal patterns are recognized by analyzing data features among the resultant multiple change points. Moreover, the severity of partial epilepsy is roughly distinguished in terms of the number, strength and period time of ECG oscillations in the stage of partial epilepsy sudden attack. The purpose of our RSWKS is to provide a novel platform for abnormal pattern recognition through MCPs detection quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Scanpaths Generation for Target Search Based on Deep Learning
abstract: Scanpath is a sequence of gaze fixations changing with time when browsing something, which records eyes' movement dynamically. Accurate prediction of scanpaths can help computers better predict which area human pay attention to and drive the development of next-generation systems that can understand human behavior and needs. Therefore, this paper introduces an algorithm of scanpaths generation for target search. Based on one-shot learning network, the algorithm extracts the target map with task information, and then imports it into a visual model of the superior colliculus to predict the task-drive scanpaths. The results are similar to the gaze behavior of human eyes in shape, direction and length. At the same time, the algorithm also has the ability to predict the scanpaths based on unseen categories.

articleTitle: Air-recovery method of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Swarm with Lower Speed Based on Backstepping
abstract: The swarm of the UAVs is characterized by flexibility and concealment. At present, Many countries are competing to develop the technology of UAVs swarm. Air-based launch and recovery of the swarm can overcome the constraints of geographical environment, which have the characteristics of rapid deployment and evacuation. This technology will become an important way for deployment and withdrawing of the swarm in the future. However, there is a large gap between the cruising speed of the UAV and the carrier, which has become an urgent problem to be solved in the way of air-recovery. In this paper, we establish the model of "mothership-cable-net" based on the theory of "tow-cable". The constraint of internal states of the model is analyzed, and a closed-loop control scheme that makes the recovery net slower but stable at a constant height is built. To reduce the speed of the recovery net and make it converge to the predefined height without changing the height of the carrier, a nonlinear controller based on backstepping technique is designed which can also adaptively adjust the recovery net with different damping coefficients. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Improvement of Vehicle Path Tracking by Relaxing the Steering Angle Speed Limit
abstract: System constraints have an important influence on the path tracking of vehicles. The steering angle speed limit is a kind of system constraints. But the value of the steering angle speed limit adopted by different researchers is not the same. The influence of different values of the limit on path tracking is not clear. To clarify these influences, we refer to previous work to establish path tracking controllers based on linear model predictive control (LMPC) and nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC). Subsequently, we compare LMPC-based controllers with different steering angle speed limits and then compare NMPC-based controllers with different angle speed limits. According to the simulation results, relaxing the steering angle speed limit can make the error of the LMPC-based controller change from divergence to convergence. And, relaxing the steering angle speed limit can further reduce the error of the NMPC-based controller. When the steering angle speed limit is relaxed from ±10°/s to ±20°/s, the maximum absolute value of the displacement error is reduced from 0.551m to 0.326m, and the maximum absolute value of the heading error is reduced from 0.110m to 0.067m. Besides, we should note that relaxing the steering angle speed limit requires replacing the steering mechanism of the vehicle with a high-power steering mechanism.

articleTitle: Robust Rendezvous Control of Relative Constrained Linear Multi-Agent Systems: An Edge-based Event-Triggered Control Approach
abstract: In this paper, the rendezvous control of linear multi-agent systems(MASs) subject to relative constraints and disturbances is investigated. Different from the node-based method in the literature, an event-triggered control scheme based on the edge Laplacian framework is constructed. Under the edge framework, the rendezvous problem can be easily solved by stabilizing the equilibrium of the corresponding edge system to zero. Then the relative state constraint is equivalent to the constraints on the edge state dynamics, and can be satisfied by restraining it to a invariant constrained set. Finally, an edge-based event-triggered controller with both disturbances compensation and constraints satisfaction is designed. System stability is proved by Lyapunov stability theory, the Zeno-behaviour phenomenon is also avoided. Numerical example shows the effectiveness of the results.

articleTitle: An Improved Speed Compensation Method for Multi-motor Synchronous Control
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the synchronous control performance of multiple motors in a complex industrial production process control system is easily affected by motor parameters and load disturbances. The traditional speed compensator in the adjacent cross-coupling structure of multiple motors is reasonably improved. In view of the effect of motor parameters on synchronization performance, by adding a synchronization coefficient related to rotational inertia to the speed compensator. The integrity of the system is increased, and the effect of different motor parameters on the system synchronization performance is suppressed. Aiming at the influence of internal and external disturbance factors on the synchronization performance, a method of replacing the fixed compensation gain in the speed compensator with a fuzzy PID controller is proposed and designed. The anti-interference of the system is improved, and the influence of internal and external interference on the synchronization performance is suppressed. According to the simulation results, the difference from the traditional synchronization error speed compensator is that the improved synchronization error speed compensator effectively reduces the influence of motor parameters and interference on the system synchronization performance. The synchronization error among motors of the system is decreased, and synchronization performance of the system is improved.

articleTitle: Finite-time consensus for discontinuous multi-agent systems with nonidentical nodes
abstract: The paper studies the finite-time (FT) consensus problem for discontinuous multi-agent systems with nonidentical nodes. By combing the FT control theory, a consensus protocol is proposed. Then, the FT consensus over switching topology is further studied. Moreover, some sufficient conditions are obtained. Finally, a simulation is performed, and results show that the method is efficient.

articleTitle: Design of Agriculture Intelligent Irrigation System based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: The Agriculture Intelligent Irrigation System based on Wireless Sensor Network is designed in order to further improve the level of agricultural intelligence, improve the convenience and efficiency of farmland irrigation, optimize the irrigation mode, and improve wireless sensor network technology. The system uses STM32 microprocessors as controller, uses fuzzy PID control strategy to implement irrigation. It uses wireless sensor network technology and monitoring technology to measure the environmental data, and realizes intelligent irrigation. It can solve the problems of poor stability and waste of water resources, improve the level of farmland irrigation automation, and help to further realize the sustainable development of regional agricultural economy.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Heating Cut Tobacco Dryer Based on Fuzzy PID Control Algorithm
abstract: PID control has many advantages such as good robustness, high reliability, simple algorithm, flexible use, etc., and is widely used in the field of industrial control. In the process of cut tobacco drying, there are problems such as time delay, non-linearity, time-varying of the drying object, and it is difficult to establish an accurate mathematical model. As a result, the conventional PID controller has problems such as poor tuning, poor performance, and poor adaptability to the controlled process. In view of the above problems, this paper presents a self-tuning fuzzy PID control algorithm with the advantages of no need to set up accurate mathematical model and good robustness. The simulation results show that the response is faster, the temperature control of the dryer can achieve good results, meeting the requirements of high-quality production.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Modeling and Fault Diagnosis of Maglev Suspension System
abstract: Fault diagnosis is a hot issue in the reliability research of maglev, especially for high-speed maglev. On the other hand, fault diagnosis is also of great significance to the follow-up fault-tolerant control. In this paper, the suspension system of high-speed maglev train is taken as the research object. Based on the analysis of the structure, composition, and working principle of the suspension system, a mathematical model is constructed. Considering the possible disturbance and failure of the system, a fault model based on the overlapping structure suspension system is proposed, and a full state observer is designed to diagnose the fault. The results show that the fault model has generality in the fault diagnosis, which can realize the fault diagnosis more quickly and efficiently. The full state observer can realize the fault detection effectively, but there is no way to further analyze the fault.

articleTitle: Iterative Learning Control Based on Stretch and Compression Mapping for Trajectory Tracking in Human-robot Collaboration
abstract: This paper presents a novel iterative learning control (ILC) scheme based on stretch and compression mapping for a robotic manipulator to learn its human partner's desired trajectory, which is a typical task in the field of human-robot interaction. The proposed scheme is used to reduce the interaction force between the robot and the human partner in repetitive learning process. Thus, the robot can track the human partner's repetitive trajectory with a small interaction force, leading to little control effort from the human. As the human is involved in the control loop, there are various uncertainties in the system, including variable iteration period in the task under study. The stretch and compression mapping is applied to this problem. In the simulation, the proposed scheme is implemented in the human-robot interaction scenario. Results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed scheme and also illustrate better performance of the proposed ILC compared with other ILC methods with variable periods.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Cap Ply Winding Equipment for BTR Tires
abstract: As one of the most important equipments in the production of BTR radial high grade tires, the cap plywinding equipment mainly has the following problems: low winding control accuracy, large tension fluctuation during the winding process, inconsistent gap and so on.Based on the MCCP CAM trajectory algorithm, a set of zero-dgree cap ply winding equipment is developed for s-type winding, which can be used for tension control and detection during the winding process.

articleTitle: QN-S3VM Method for Evaluation of Liver Functional Reserve
abstract: When doctors assess the liver reserve function of patients with liver cancer before hepatectomy, if the assessment is not appropriate, patients are prone to postoperative liver failure(POLF). Child-Pugh is the most commonly used method for clinical evaluation, but this method only relies on biochemical indicators, which may lead to poor prediction. This paper aims to evaluate the liver reserve function of patients with imaging omics information using an effective machine learning scheme. The performance of models including support vector machine (SVM), COP-Kmeans, MLP, SGD-S3VM, QN-S3VM are predicted by comparing accuracy and F1 Score. In particular, the QN-S3VM model with the best performance can achieve an accuracy of 0.91, which is higher than the Child-Pugh method. As such, the proposed intelligent diagnostic algorithm can provide routine diagnostic assistance and consultation for doctors to achieve the purpose of reducing the workload.

articleTitle: Control enhanced estimation of the driving strength in a superconducting circuit
abstract: In this paper, we consider the system where a superconducting qubit is coupled to a resonator acting as a harmonic oscillator. Unlike the existing work regarding estimation of the coupling strength or oscillator frequency, we aim to sense the amplitude of a microwave drive by utilizing the qubit as a quantum probe. Furthermore, in order to improve the estimation precision, we employ a periodic control protocol that is easy to be implemented in practice. Such improvement does not require any manipulation of the oscillator. The proposed strategy sheds light on a systematic study on estimation of the driving field in superconducting circuits by means of adding control.

articleTitle: Reasoning Based on HAZOP Ontology
abstract: The traditional Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) analysis method mainly takes the form of brainstorming and records the discussion results in electronic documents. A large number of HAZOP analysis reports are difficult to be reused due to different forms, resulting in a waste of resources. At present, the knowledge ontology is used to describe HAZOP data. Although knowledge sharing and reuse can be realized, the hidden relationship between data is not mined. Information omissions may occur when querying information. To solve this problem, this paper proposes to set up custom inference rules based on the construction of HAZOP ontology to mine hidden relationships. The experimental results show that the addition of the custom inference engine can realize the supplement of implied relationship, which is beneficial to the mining of potential semantics.

articleTitle: Adaptive Formation Regulation for Multi-agent Systems with Structure Uncertainties via Variable Recombination
abstract: This paper proposes adaptive formation regulation problem for a class of non-identical multi-agent systems with structure uncertainties. In order to design the fully distributed consensus protocol, we use a time-varying adaptive distributed observer and a distributed compensator. Then a variable recombination method is designed to overcome the uncertain agents with non-identical dynamics. At last, a fully distributed control law is designed to solve the formation regulation problem for non-identical multi-agent systems.

articleTitle: A Prescribed Performance Back-stepping Control Approach for Air-breathing Hypersonic Vehicles (CAC2020)
abstract: A prescribed performance back-stepping control approach is presented for a generic air-breathing hypersonic vehicle (AHV) with the uncertainties of the model and unknown disturbance. By prescribed performance, a novel performance function characterizing the error convergence rate, maximum overshoot and steady-state error is designed for the output error transformation without initial errors. In order to enhance the robustness of controller, the novel nonlinear disturbance observers (NDOs) based on tangent sigmoid tracking differentiators (TSTDs) are introduced to estimate and compensate the uncertainties of the model. To eliminate the "explosion of term" of back-stepping control strategy, sliding mode differentiators (SMDs) is applied to obtain the derivatives of virtual control laws. Finally, the tracking performance the proposed control approach is testified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Improved principal component analysis with double-weighted local outlier factor and its application in process monitoring for roasting furnace
abstract: Aiming at the monitoring problems of roasting furnace production process where the abnormal furnace states are difficult to detect, this paper proposes a modified PCA algorithm based on the combination of double weighted strategy and local outlier factor (DWLOF-PCA). The proposed method mainly solves two problems. Firstly, the LOF algorithm is introduced to construct the new monitoring indicators. Secondly, in order to obtain better online monitoring results, combining double weighting strategy and LOF algorithm to improve the new statistics. In the first-level weighting strategy, different weights are assigned to different components to highlight abnormal information. In the second-level weighting strategy, a moving weighted window is designed to weight the previous monitoring results to reduce the drastic fluctuation of the current results. Finally, the offline test is performed using the roaster field data of a smelter in Hunan.Compared with the existing PCA process monitoring algorithm, this method can effectively detect abnormal furnace conditions,the monitoring performance is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Shoulder-arm Massage Chair System
abstract: With the development of science and technology, more and more office workers need to use computers. Nowadays, arm and shoulder pain has become a common occupational disease for office workers. At present, we urgently need a massage chair product that can cover shoulder and arm massage. Based on the basic analysis of the working principle of the massage manipulator, combined with the standard size of human body, this paper uses SolidWorks modeling software to design a massaging manipulator for the shoulder-arm and a shoulder-arm orbit seat, and completes the design of the shoulder-arm massage chair system by combining the two. After testing, the arm-shoulder massage chair designed in this paper can relieve muscle soreness and provide a quick and convenient massage way for office workers.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control of DC Microgrid Based on Nonsingular Terminal Sliding Mode
abstract: In this paper, the DC microgrid hybrid power system including wind turbine, micro gas turbine generator and storage battery are established to study the protection and control of parallel grid point in the grid. A nonsingular terminal sliding mode observer is designed to diagnose and reconstruct the faults for the current sensors of grid-connected inverter. A fault-tolerant control strategy of grid-connected inverter is proposed by using fault reconstruction to modify the designed integral sliding mode control law. By using the Lyapunov stability theory, this paper also proves that the system will reach the designed sliding surface in a limited time when the faults occur. Finally, the power control experiment of microgrid is completed in Simulink. The results show that the observer method proposed in this paper can effectively reconstruct the current catastrophe fault and realize the power tracking control when the faults occur.

articleTitle: Gradient Descent Feedback Correction for Robust Deadbeat Predictive Control in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor System
abstract: In order to optimize the control performance of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) system, the deadbeat predictive control (DPC) is introduced. But due to the lack of rolling optimization and feedback correction, the control performance suffers from the mismatch of model parameters. To deal with the problem, the gradient descent feedback correction (GDFC) method is proposed, which automatically corrects the resistance and inductance in the operation process without the need of additional observer or identification model, enhancing the robustness of the DPC greatly. The proposed method also has the advantages of simple operation and low time-consuming. Then the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed method are verified by the simulation results which show the convergence values of resistance and inductance under different working conditions.

articleTitle: A Method for Normal Mapping of Lightweight Mesh Model
abstract: Aiming at the problem of time consuming of online transmission and rendering of 3D models, a method is proposed to reduce the model transmission time without reducing the quality of rendering. First, we present a mesh model lightweight method base on the butterfly pattern. The geometric error of the simplified low model is reduced compared to the traditional simplification algorithm. Then, an improved normal map algorithm based on 3Dc is presented. First, the minimum and maximum values of the normal map are counted and interpolated. Then, each block in the map is matched, and the minimum and maximum numbers are recorded. The method is used to interpolate the set of points in the fitting block. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm can guarantee the three-dimensional model has a high sense of realism, but also can greatly shorten the 3D model transmission and rendering time.

articleTitle: Response analysis of servo system based on PI controller
abstract: With the strong national defense force, the stationariness of the land combat system is an important guarantee of the entire national defense force, especially the stability of vehicle-mounted weapons appears to be more and more important, in the process of movement, the real-time stability of the system is an important guarantee of the entire vehicle-mounted system. This article mainly aims at the on-line setting parameters in the operation of the complex system of PI control, this paper introduces a kind of time-invariant systems based self-tuning PID control system design scheme, system model in metal smelting industry as the research object, the lag in series to the stability of the system calibration, data calculation and Matlab do Simlink model simulation, the simulation diagram of data results show that the system in the movement process after correction with 2.2 seconds to be steady equilibrium point in the system, is faster than before correction for almost 5 seconds, so correction system to achieve the fast response control of servo system.

articleTitle: Finding Patterns in Adversarial Training
abstract: Adversarial training has become an universally accepted robust method to train networks defending against adversarial attacks. However, feeding networks with adversarial examples is a cumbersome process, and there is no clear explanation for the differences between networks with the same architecture that are learned by adversarial training and learned by natural training method. So in this paper, we focus on the patterns of network learned by adversarial training. For comparison, we visualize the weights and feature maps of networks learned by these two training methods on MNIST, and find some patterns of adversarially trained model that are important for defending against adversarial examples and that are unique to naturally trained model. First, we find that adversarially trained network denoises the noisy data caused by adversarial images and enhances the outlines of semantically informative content in feature maps. Second, we find that adversarial training performs model compression, making some of the channels of a convolutional layer have no activation on input images. Further observation shows that different from naturally trained model, which have different most activation channel corresponding to different input, adversarially trained model often has the same most activation channel regardless of input. This phenomenon also leads to a sparse network reducing 50% number of parameters and 87% computation costs, and the pruned network performs as good as original network after pruning the least activation channels without retraining. But the naturally trained counterpart loses more than 40% accuracy using the same pruning strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet New Threshold Denoising in Ship Data Preprocessing and Modeling
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the data collected during the construction of ships contains noise and other undesirable factors, a new threshold function denoising method for ship experimental data is presented. The denoising simulation comparison of ship engineering data is carried out with three threshold processing method respectively, including hard threshold processing, soft threshold processing and new threshold processing. Then use the denoised data to establish the suction concentration prediction model of the cutter suction dredger. Finally, A good denoising effect is provided by the third threshold processed data, which provides relatively stable data for the subsequent establishment of the suction port concentration prediction model.

articleTitle: Convergence speed in weighted Dyson hierarchical network
abstract: The convergence speed of undirected weighted Dyson hierarchical network is considered. Dyson hierarchical network is a strong connected graph. We consider Dyson hierarchical network as a multi-agent system (MAS). We show the exact analytic expression of convergence speed by calculating the second smallest eigenvalue of Laplacian matrix under two different pattern to give weight. The analytical method in this paper lean upon matrix theory and algebraic graph theory. This paper will contribute to obtain the analytical expression convergence speed under two new patterns to give weight.

articleTitle: Exploration of Biological Genetic Code from the Perspective of I Ching
abstract: I Ching, which came into being at the time of Yin and Zhou dynasties, is a classical work combining symbol system and concept system. Over the Thousands of years of evolving and interpretation, not only its philosophy is abundant, but also its symbol system contains more and more complete mathematical logicality. From the deduction of scientific logic, since we are looking for the origin and noumenon of the universe, everything in the universe as the research object must be the evolutions and derivatives of the origin and noumenon, so the evolution principle of TaiQi can naturally be used to guide scientific research. In the field of biological genetics, the model construction of the genetic theory system has an amazing coincidence with the I Ching's symbol system. In this paper, by comparing the biological genetics with I Ching, the corresponding relationship between the triplet code of nucleotides and 64 hexagrams is found out from the principle of I Ching evolution, and the divination interpretation of the three termination information codes is given from the perspective of I Ching. It has been proved that the model construction of the theoretical system of biogenetics has an amazing coincidence with the symbol system of the book of changes.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Arrangement Route Function Based on A* Search Algorithm
abstract: This paper mainly solves the problem of train arrangement route in the Automatic Train Supervision (ATS) system, and improves the efficiency of train route search. According to the train’s schedule, this module can automatically search for the route in the training plan and realize the arrangement of the target route according to the result of the interlocking logic check. In the design of the automatic route layout function of the ATS simulation system, we propose a heuristic search-improved A* search algorithm to realize the route search, which greatly improves the route search efficiency. Besides, this paper also completes the joint simulation of other subsystems of ATS and CBTC. The simulation results show that the designed ATS simulation system has reached the expected goal, has good applicability, and can provide ATS system teaching assistance to students of related majors.

articleTitle: Adaptive Load Frequency Control Based on Echo State Network for Power System
abstract: In this paper, a method for load frequency control (LFC) on the basis of echo state network (ESN) is presented to control the frequency stability of power system. Complex modeling of the power system for load frequency control is avoided in this method. In view of the network learning and approximation ability of ESN, the convergence speed of determining the controller parameters for power system can improved. Controller parameters are adjusted adaptively according to the changes of system data in real time. The output weights and the reservoir of ESN can be synchronously updated. The proposed method can achieve the desired value faster and smoother, and lessen the effect with the load change suddenly. The theoretical method is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Research of Autonomous UAV MIAMS in Large Maneuvering Acceleration Condition
abstract: In this paper, the Micro-Inertial Attitude Measurement System (MIAMS) for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) in large maneuvering acceleration condition is researched by the Microsoft Visual Studio (MVS) simulation tool, and the vehicular and UAV experimental platforms. Firstly, the external large maneuvering acceleration is compensated based on the dynamic characteristics of the UAV. Secondly, the Adaptive Mahony Complementary Filter (AMCF) is introduced for implementation the attitude measurement accurately only utilizing the tri-axial gyroscopes and accelerometers in maneuvering conditions. Thirdly, the MVS simulation tool is utilized to tune the parameters of reducing the large maneuvering acceleration on forward and lateral directions. Finally, both the vehicle and the UAV high-speed ground taxiing experiments are conducted to testify the precision and feasibility of the UAV MIAMS, the experimental results demonstrated that the attitude measurement error of MIAMS is no more than 0.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup> in large maneuvering acceleration condition.

articleTitle: Synthesizing and Recovering Dynamic Patterns Using the Causal Reasoning Model
abstract: A new method using the causal reasoning ConvNet mode is proposed for synthesizing and recovering dynamic patterns. In the model which defines the probability distribution, a multi-layer filter is used to capture the spatiotemporal information. The problem of synthesizing and recovering pattern design is to capture the optimal synthesis or recovery based on the training model and the solution to maximize the objective function. In the algorithm, the synthetic video generated by the ConvNet of opponent training is matched with the observed (recovered) video frame, and the multi-layer parameters of the filter are updated. The maximum likelihood algorithm is designed to get the synthesis (recovery) of the real video patterns. The DynTex database is used to evaluate the effectiveness of this method and the results are compared with typical synthesis methods.

articleTitle: Improved Strategy for Dynamic Voltage Restorers Considering Voltage Sag Duration
abstract: This paper proposes an improved compensation strategy for dynamic voltage restorers (DVR) to solve the voltage sag problem of different duration. Based on the detailed analysis of the traditional compensation strategies, an improved compensation strategy adapting to voltage sags is proposed, which can gradually switch from pre-sag voltage compensation strategy to minimum energy compensation strategy. This proposed strategy not only avoids the impact of phase angle jumps on sensitive loads, but also achieves long-term voltage compensation. In addition, to further reduce the energy consumption during the compensation process, the load reference voltage is appropriately reduced considering the voltage sag tolerance of loads. The simulation experiment results prove the effectiveness of this strategy in reducing the phase angle jump and extending the compensation time.

articleTitle: A Novel Control Method of Air Fuel Ratio for Natural Gas Engine
abstract: In order to meet the increasingly strict emission requirements, the control of the engine's air-fuel ratio (AFR) has been the research focus of major manufacturers and universities. However, due to the long delay time of AFR measurement, the inaccurate estimation of the intake air mass into the cylinder, and the errors in the amount of the injected fuel, precise AFR control for engines is still a challenging issue, especially during the transition condition. Aiming at the problem of AFR control in natural gas engine, this paper redefines the objective of AFR control and establishes a new error system of the AFR, a feedforward plus feedback strategy is then proposed to regulate the error to approach zero, trying to reduce or even eliminate the overshoot of air-fuel ratio caused by feedforward, which may lead to unstable combustion of the engine. Moreover, the proposed strategy is verified by co-simulations on the platform of Matlab/Simulink with GT-POWER.

articleTitle: Achieving Consensus of Opinion Dynamics in Networks with Stubborn Individuals
abstract: The focus of this paper is to achieve opinion consensus for the opinion dynamics model in the network with stubborn individuals. It has been shown in most of the existing works that the opinion dynamics model in the network with stubborn individuals usually could not achieve opinion consensus. In contrast with these results, by adding an integral term that describes the historical knowledge of the neighboring opinions, we propose a modified model of the existing Taylor's model. The primary feature of this modified model is that as long as the underlying graph is connected, opinion consensus can be realized in the network with stubborn individuals. we prove this opinion consensus by employing a Lyapunov function based method. Finally, we present an example to illustrate our main result.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Stabilization of High-order Nonlinear Systems Subject to Actuator and Sensor Attacks
abstract: In this note, we investigate the security problem of a group of high order nonlinear cyber-physical systems (CPs) when actuator and sensor are corrupted by attacker carrying state information. Only using the compromised state, it is proved that all the resulting signals is uniformly bounded and asymptotic stabilization of output data for primitive pant are guaranteed by adjusting design parameter in spite of adversarial attacks. Finally, the presented algorithm is verified by illustrate examples.

articleTitle: Research on Load Reduction Potential of Electric Vehicle Based on System Identification
abstract: The research on the potential of demand response load is conducive to its role in shifting peaks and filling valleys in power grid operation and solving the contradiction between power supply and demand. As a typical flexible load, electric vehicles have great potential in terms of energy saving, emission reduction and energy structure adjustment. This article starts with electric vehicles to study their potential to participate in grid demand response, analyzes the functional relationship between their SOC and charging power, and establishes electric vehicles. The charging and discharging model of the car uses the system identification method to identify the functional relationship between the charging power of the electric car and the SOC, and focuses on the analysis of the factors affecting the response potential of the electric car. The analysis of calculation examples shows that the start time of demand response, the initial value of SOC and the predetermined value of SOC all have a significant impact on the demand response potential of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: A Novel Stochastic Grey Model Construction and Analysis
abstract: In reality, there are systems which always face with information volume is unsure, data volume is not enough, and mathematical model explanation is inaccurate. Grey system is a useful tool to process these kinds of problems. In the grey model, one-order or high order differential equations are always used for system model. Meanwhile, stochastic differential equation or stochastic model can be used for describing the complex system under the disturbed condition by random factors. Considering the advantage of stochastic grey model, the stochastic grey model with perturbations is researched; the form and basic analysis of stochastic grey model were discussed in this paper. Compared with classical grey model, stochastic grey model can reveal the inner features of the sequence developing and show more information for uncertainties reflected by random influences in the complex data.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Based Sliding Mode Control of Second-Order Underactuated System with Unknown Dynamics
abstract: In this paper, the trajectory tracking control problem of second-order underactuated system with unknown dynamic and prescribed performance constraint was discussed. Event-triggered sliding mode control combined with adaptive method is investigated to solve the problem. By introducing the constraint transformation, which is used to convert the constrained system into unconstrained one, and prescribed performance function (PPF), the steady and transient performance of closed-loop system are guaranteed. After obtained the unconstrained system, an event-triggered adaptive sliding mode control was proposed. The proposed method is robust to uncertain disturbance and saves computing and communication resources. Then, through the Lyapunov theory, the update laws of control law and adaptive laws were obtained, and also the stability of closed-loop control system was proved. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed control approach.

articleTitle: Intelligent fingerprint lock based on STM32
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent fingerprint lock system based on STM32 is studied. The fingerprint identification technology and the traditional password input method are combined to realize the identification of the user, with high security. The system is composed of MCU control module, fingerprint identification module, electromagnetic lock module, user interaction module and power supply part. These systems cooperate with each other to realize a series of functions such as accurate fingerprint identification and unlocking. In terms of program, C language is used for modular programming, which is convenient for debugging and maintenance and upgrading. After the actual test, the system has high recognition rate, fast response speed, and can adapt to various use environment, and has a broad market prospect.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Snowdrift Game with Time-Varying Neighbor Promotes Cooperation
abstract: Addressed in this paper is the issue of how to induce cooperation among selfish individuals by changing the number of interaction neighbors in the evolutionary snowdrift game. Quite a few mechanisms that promote cooperation have been intensely investigated in the evolutionary game, and each player has the same number of neighbors to play, which is inconsistent with most actual situations in society. Here, we take into account that there are fixed neighbors and time-varying neighbors in the snowdrift game. Each individual has the same number of fixed neighbors, and time-varying neighbors can be randomly selected from the fixed neighbors. The time-varying neighbors constantly change in the evolutionary process. The results of Monte Carlo simulations reveal that the cooperation level of the evolutionary snowdrift game that the introduction of time-varying neighbors is significantly improved. Further speaking, our results can provide a theoretical basis for promoting group cooperation in society.

articleTitle: Time-varying feedback stabilization of systems with input saturation actuators in complex mode space
abstract: Complex modes are often present when structural damping and gyroscope effects are included in systems. With the presence of unsymmetric matrix in governing equations, states of systems should be decoupled in complex mode space. This paper considers design and analysis of control for systems expressed in complex mode space. In the category of Lyapunov stabilization, sufficient conditions of state feedback controller for such systems are established. Under the condition that actuators suffer from the problem of saturation, a new control law which introduces a time varying coefficient for feedback gain into the nested controller is developed. The coefficient is dependent on the convergence rate of the system and utilizes actuators' capacity and meanwhile, guarantees the asymptotical stability of the system. Numerical examples of a spinning smart beam structure with single input and multiple inputs are given. It is found that the strategy investigated can be used to control systems with complex modes. And the new low-and-high gain controller which consists of a time varying coefficient for high gain can efficiently reduce the vibration and utilize actuators' full potential at a high level.

articleTitle: Study on height Control of Corn harvester in Hilly and mountainous area
abstract: The cutting table of corn harvester in hilly and mountainous areas can't be automatically adjusted to the complex terrain, which makes the level of corn harvest in hilly and mountainous areas on the low level. In order to solve this problem, the height control system of cutting table of corn harvester in hilly and mountainous area is studied in this paper. A height control framework of cutting table is proposed based on inclination sensor to test the angle of terrain changing and the adjusting angle of cutting table, which is based on the hydraulic dynamic model of harvester. Furthermore, the estimative method of ground slope is obtained, and three kinds of cutting table height control algorithms with different detection angle ranges of the system are designed. Finally, Simulation analysis and experimental verification are done. The results show that the simulation test time of the cutting table height reach to adjusting balance position is 0.8s and the actual test time is 1s on the upper 10°, and the simulation test time of the cutting table height reach to the adjusting balance position is 0.5s and the actual test time is 0.6s on the upper 5°. The maximum error of cutting table height control of corn harvester is less than 20%, which adapts to the changing working conditions in hilly and mountainous areas and meets the design requirements. It meets the needs of harvest and improves the degree of automation of corn harvesting in hilly and mountainous areas.

articleTitle: Capsule Networks based on Cross Product
abstract: In Capsule Networks(CapsNets), the dynamic routing mechanism is used to generate the digital capsules, the lengths of which represent the probabilities that the entities exist. However, the dynamic routing has high computational complexity, which makes CapsNets not efficent than other modern deep networks. Inspired by the geometry meaning of cross product, we calculate the cross product of the feature and weight capsules, whose length is used as a measure of the probability of the input sample belonging to different classes. It is shown in the simulation that the resulting capsules tend to be more sparse with the increase of the dimension of the feature capsule, besides, some subcapsules have greater effects on the classification. The represented model improves the performace of the ResNet backbones by 23% on CIFAR-10 dataset and that of tht CNN by 17% on MNIST dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Architecture Design of the Aeroengine Health Management System
abstract: With the increasing performance requirements of advanced fighters, the engine structure is becoming more complex, which makes the traditional fault diagnosis technologies have more difficulties to meet these new requirements. Based on the requirements of rapid, accurate and continuous support, the engine health management technology has been applied in the engineering area. In this paper, we analyzed the related results and applications of engine condition monitoring and fault diagnosis system, studied and designed the architecture of engine health management system, analyzed the key technologies in detail, presented the workflow, and get the conclusion of the influences on engine maintenance support mode. The research is helpful for the engine health management system design, which is the base of engine maintenance support system optimization, and is the reference for improving engine fault diagnosis level and maintenance capability.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of SO2 Distribution in Boiler Based on Deep Neural Network
abstract: The prediction of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> distribution in the boiler is an important basis for accurate control of the combustion process. In order to better grasp the distribution of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> inside the boiler, and at the same time solve the problems of long time-consuming CFD numerical simulation process and narrow coverage of typical working conditions, a deep neural network (DNN)-based SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> prediction model in the furnace is proposed. The model uses the Lasso method to select the characteristics of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> related variables, and on this basis, selects the DNN algorithm for predictive modeling. Experimental results show that DNN has higher prediction accuracy compared with common data modeling methods, and the average absolute error is reduced by about 36.66% and 76.38%.

articleTitle: A Class of Time-delay Model Calculation for Grey System Modeling and Analysis
abstract: In the practical world, limited and small samples without enough information are always existed for the data measured or the system to be analyzed. Grey system is a useful processing way to study these kinds of data or system, especially for small-sample data and incomplete information. Considering that time delay is existed in some system identification problems, a class of grey time-delay model was given and disused including grey time-delay model and fractional grey time-delay model. The analysis and calculation was researched by Simulink block diagram via Matlab software in the whole paper. Experiment and simulation showed the proposed time-delay grey model can be used to express the system with time-delay problem. By the Simulink block diagram, it can improve the calculation efficiency and make the results easily analyzed for complex grey models.

articleTitle: Robot Auxiliary Suspension and Control Feedback System
abstract: With the gradual rise of the robot industry, the corresponding robot auxiliary system came into being, the object of this study is the robot auxiliary feedback system, can realize the protection of humanoid robots in motion and the corresponding auxiliary control, permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) was manufactured in the middle of the last century, with the development and use of the information industry,the permanent magnetic synchronous motor with its small size, high conversion efficiency High-precision control, and a closed-loop control follow-up system, the function is to enable the up-position command to achieve rapid and precise speed and position response. The Field-oriented Control (FOC) system is a permanent magnet synchronous motor that can be used in the no-position control sensor detection method, and the use of current ring control to achieve the force control of the robot auxiliary. The adaptive control of the robot-assisted force is realized by controlling the output current of the inverter, using the control of PI control ,and the prediction of the current loop.

articleTitle: Herding of a Flock of Agents Using Single Robot
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm is proposed for enabling a single robot to herd a flock of agents to a designated space or tracking a specified trajectory. The herding algorithm is designed using a second-order dynamic model of flocking based on Reynolds rules. At first we analyze the stability of the flock with or without external effect (herder) and conclude the conditions of avoiding fragmentation of the flock. From these conditions a herding algorithm is proposed, and it is also demonstrated using numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Design of 3D Printing RoboCup Rescue Robot
abstract: The Rapidly Manufactured Robot Challenge (RMRC) is a challenge of RoboCup Rescue Robot league that aims to develop just-in-time, custom purpose, and low-cost robots for responders to produce on the spot when disaster strikes. The RMRC robots are required be open-source hardware design using standard parts and/or 3D printed materials, and software that can be easily duplicated when needed. This paper aims to present the design of RMRC robot including hardware structure and software system. It specifically focuses on the robot design which contributed for the improvement of robot performance on complex terrain.

articleTitle: Control strategy analysis of Multilevel inverter based on H-bridge
abstract: Multi-level inverters are widely used in large motor drives and high-power power supply devices represented by high-voltage frequency conversion, for the problem of the output voltage of traditional inverter is more output harmonics and low quality. Starting from the principle of the inverter's traditional carrier phase-shifting control strategy, this paper uses the cascaded H-bridge circuit topology to analyze the hybrid modulation control strategy based on carrier phase-shifting and third-harmonic injection technology. Analyzed the multilevel inverter switch of the working situation in detail, and designed a kind of double closed loop control system, The output voltage and harmonics of the multi-level inverter are simulated and verified by MATLAB. The final results show that the control strategy helps to improve the output waveform quality, it is feasible.

articleTitle: Tri-quadrotor with main and secondary rotor
abstract: Multi-rotor aircrafts were widely used in military and civilian fields. However, the development of multirotor aircraft was limited by power and endurance time. In order to improve these problems, this paper focused on the flight module with one main rotor and three secondary rotors under the triangular frame, which can form the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Array. Mathematical modeling and dynamics analysis were carried out, and a controller was designed to realize its control. The frame was a triangle, which reduced the footprint of the aircraft, improved space utilization, and made the rotor placement more compact. The main rotor and the secondary rotor structure made it easier to achieve separate power supply and hybrid power supply between the rotors. Through the adjustment of the control allocation matrix, the control method of the main rotor and secondary rotor triangular quadrotor aircraft had a similar structure to the traditional quadrotor, and the simulation of the quadrotor with the main rotor and secondary rotor structure under the triangular frame was achieved through simulation and physical construction experiments.

articleTitle: Quantized Adaptive Control of Linear Uncertain System with Convex Analysis
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive control problem of linear uncertain system with quantized state feedback is considered. As the quantized state feedback is discontinuous, the classical adaptive control scheme can not be applied directly. For such a case, the convex analysis methodology is applied. The controller and parameter update law with quantized state feedback is treated as convex combination of some smooth signals. Further, the quantizer is designed to ensure the stability of the closed-loop system.

articleTitle: Ship Detection in SAR Imagery Based on Density and Clustering
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm for ship detection based on density and clustering is proposed for SAR imagery. The algorithm includes density map generation, local extremums extraction, target quasi-centers classification, suspected area identification, and detection results determination based on the quasi-centers and the suspected area. The proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the impact of sea clutter, outspread shadows and crossed sidelobes in SAR imagery, and provide more accurate detection results. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Regenerative Braking System Simulation based on Kalman Filter
abstract: As an important component to increase the mileage of electric vehicles, the regenerative braking system has become an indispensable part. Reasonable control strategies can not only improve vehicle safety and reliability but also increase the utilization of energy. In this paper, we design an energy recovery control strategy model using Carsim and MATLAB/Simulink. The proposed model is based on the Kalman Filter, which can optimize the model accuracy and improve the robustness of the system. At last, the results of the simulation show a matching relationship with actual situation.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Consensus of Multi-agent Systems with Adjustable Threshold Parameters
abstract: In this paper, a time-varying adjustable parameter is applied to the threshold function of the state error for each agent and the parameter is adjusted with the ratio of state-error to the error threshold which is more suitable in the whole process of the change of state error. The parameter's trend can be adjusted to meet different control needs thus the trigger frequency can be adjusted correspondingly. Under the case discussed in the paper, an increasing threshold parameter is designed to decrease trigger frequency while consensus can still be guaranteed. Lyapunov theory is used to analyze the asymptotical stability and to obtain the appropriate event condition for each agent. The validity of the method is illustrated with simulation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of New-type Medium-speed Maglev Train by Riding Comfort and Running Stability
abstract: Based on LMS Virtual. Lab, the dynamics simulation analysis of a medium-speed maglev train with mid-mounted linear motor was carried out to evaluate passenger riding comfort and running stability. Firstly the dynamics simulation model of medium-speed maglev train with mid-mounted linear motor was established, then two kinds of methods for assessing passenger riding comfort in relation to vibration in railway vehicles were introduced. The result shows that medium-speed maglev train meets the needs of passenger riding comfort and running stability.

articleTitle: Face tracking based on low illumination
abstract: In the environment of low illuminance, the traditional face tracking is easy to be affected by occlusion, deformation and other factors in the process of tracking, Therefore, in order to achieve accurate face tracking in low illumination environment, an improved compressed sensing tracking method combining HAAR-LBP cascade classifier is proposed in this paper. First, HAAR feature is used for face coarse tracking, then bilateral filtering is used for image enhancement, and finally LBP feature is used for fine tracking. The improved tracking method overcomes the difficulty that the traditional method has poor tracking effect and is easy to lose the target under the condition of low illuminance, and the tracking accuracy is also improved. Accroding to the experiment, it can be easily known that the accuracy of the improved algorithm is about 5% higher than that of the traditional algorithm, and the real-time performance of the improved algorithm is also improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault-Tolerant Finite Time Attitude Control for Quadrotor
abstract: An adaptive attitude tracking control algorithm for quadrotor with disturbance and actuator fault is investigated. Because of the needs of convergence rate and time, the proposed finite time controller can guarantee the attitude tracking error converge rapidly. Firstly, using nonsingular terminal sliding mode surface, an adaptive fault-tolerant attitude control scheme is described. Then, the Lyapunov stability analysis is used to make sure the stability of dynamic system and boundedness of signals. Finally, experimental results are given to indicate that the method we put forward is effective.

articleTitle: NOx Emission Prediction for A Coal-fired Power Process Using Gated Recurrent Unit Approach
abstract: NOx produced by coal-fired power plants greatly affects our atmosphere environment, and makes that the NOx emission prediction for coal-fired power plants become very important.
