This area-based model may suffer from the degenerate case where areas of some rectangles vanish. This case is meaningless in VLSI physical design. Moreover, the sizes of rectangles may have great difference in an optimal solution. It is well known that there are several optimization criteria in integrated circuit design (such as area, wirelength, cross number, etc). This paper proposes a new model by replacing the objective function from the total area to the maximum diameter of the rectangles. Our main result is to present improved algorithms, in which the time complexity of a partitioning procedure is reduced from O(n) to O(logn).

articleTitle: High Robust Vision System of Robot in Intelligent Manufacturing
abstract: The interference of natural light in intelligent manufacturing will affect the classification and positioning accuracy of robot vision system. In order to improve the robustness of vision system, this paper first uses homomorphic filtering based on illumination reflection model to improve the problem of uneven brightness of image, and then uses the fast-adaptive threshold segmentation method based on integral graph to binarize the image. Then a variety of shape feature descriptors are used as features, PCA is used to analyze the main components, and then input them into a BP neural network for shape recognition and classification. The experimental results show that the method is robust and real-time, which can also meet the actual needs of the factory.

articleTitle: Deep Transfer Learning Based on Convolutional Neural Networks for Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Spacecraft
abstract: The on-orbit operation and all-weather duty of spacecraft lead to the rapid increase of test data, which brings severe challenges to fault diagnosis. In recent years, deep learning has shown excellent performance in feature extraction and pattern recognition. More and more attentions have been paid to the application of deep learning in spacecraft fault diagnosis. However, the success of deep learning largely relies on sufficient labeled data. Due to the high reliability of spacecraft, the test data usually contains lots of normal sample points, while the faulty sample points are extremely scarce. Firstly, this paper designs a fault diagnosis model based on 1-D convolutional neural network, which directly processes the 1-D raw data and extracts features; then, for the first time, the transfer learning technology is introduced into the field of spacecraft fault diagnosis, and a domain adaptive deep transfer model is proposed. MMD is used to reduce the discrepancy of data probability distribution between the source and target domain. The results of the experiments show that the proposed model could accurately diagnose and identify the faults of spacecraft in different application scenarios.

articleTitle: Asymptotic properties of zeros for discrete-time linear systems with backward triangle sampled-and-hold using delta operator
abstract: This article focuses on a well-studied theoretical problem that, for rapid sampling, a continuous-time system with minimum-phase properties may become a non-minimum phase discrete-time system in the discretization process. The properties of zeros for discrete-time linear models in the field of digital control when using the special shift operator was considered in this paper. From the former relevant studies one can know that the backward triangle sample-and-hold (BTSH) as an alternative hold method to discretize the continuous-time systems has an advantage over ZOH in stabilizing sampling zeros for linear system with classical forward shift operator. In this article, we deduce the exact sampled-data model of linear system using delta operator to replace forward shift operator in the case of BTSH. Furthermore, the expressions and properties of zeros for the corresponding discrete-time system are derived.

articleTitle: A neuro-optimal control method of modular robot manipulators based on nonzero-sum game strategy
abstract: This paper presents a nonzero-sum strategy-based neuro-optimal control method for modular robot manipulators (MRMs). Based on joint torque feedback (JTF) technique, the dynamic model of the manipulator systems is described as an integration of joint subsystems. A local dynamic information-based robust compensator is designed to engage the model uncertainty compensation, and then, the optimal tracking control problem of an MRM system is transformed into an n-player nonzero-sum game issue of multiple joint subsystems. By taking advantage of the adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) algorithm, a cost function approximator is developed for solving the Hamilton- Jacobi (HJ) equation, thus facilitating the feasible derivation of the neuro-optimal control policy. Finally, experiment results illustrated the effectiveness of the developed control method.

articleTitle: Object Modifier Generation for Image Captioning
abstract: The recently proposed Encoder-Decoder based models have made great progress in image captioning. However, we find that the captions generated by them ignore some objects that humans care about and mostly lack modifiers for objects. To solve these problems, we proposal an Object Modifier Generation Mechanism (OMGM), which combines modifier vocabulary building and Multi-Task Learning (MTL). By building a modifier vocabulary, OMGM-model emphasizes the described objects, which are more concerned by humans. MTL jointly trains the text generation and the modifier generation, where the auxiliary task makes it easier for the main task to learn more features of modifiers. We analysis qualitatively and quantitatively on Microsoft COCO dataset. Our OMGM-model achieves the best performance on most metrics compared to other models. These results can also quantitatively prove that our OMGM is good for generating better captions with more objects and modifiers.

articleTitle: Attention-based Deep Learning for Visual Servoing
abstract: The traditional image based visual servo(IBVS) system relies on manually extracted features, the process of estimating the feature Jacobian is very complicated and difficult. This paper proposes an approach of visual servo control which has an end-to-end structure. We find the excellent performance of convolutional neural network in classification and regression tasks and make use of it, attention mechanism is introduced and region of interest(ROI) is extracted through the feature extraction to strengthen the expression of feature information. The corresponding relationship between image space and pose space is successfully obtained. The dataset is collected by performing perspective transformation on the image. The proposed dual-stream network processes the input images which representing the current task pose and the desired task pose at the same time, and The command obtained from the network output can control the robot to complete the corresponding visual servo task. The proposed approach has achieved good results in the corresponding experimental scenes.

articleTitle: Fixed-time consensus protocol design for disturbed second-order multi-agent systems
abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of fixed-time consensus tracking control for disturbed second-order integrator systems. Firstly, for dealing with the external disturbance, an observer is proposed such that the estimation errors converge to zero with a fixed settling time. Then, a distributed fixed-time control law is proposed by using the homogeneous method. The rigorous proof shows that the achievement of fixed-time consensus tracking control. Finally, the effectiveness of the theoretical results is provided through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Dual Deep Neural Networks for Improving Trajectory Tracking Control of Unmanned Surface Vehicle
abstract: This study proposes a deep learning-based method for trajectory tracking control of Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV). Trajectory tracking control is an effective approach for autonomous sailing, making the USV to track towards a desired route. Dual Deep Neural Networks (Dual-DNN) are presented in this study to evaluate and revise the traditional Line-of-Sight (LOS) guidance algorithm. In particular, One DNN is used to evaluate the sailing effect of USV, while the other DNN is used to estimate the cross-track distance and lateral distance of the guidance law. The experimental results demonstrate that by adopting the proposed Dual-DNN model, the trajectory tracking error is reduced by 5.3% and 21.7% compared to the Single-DNN model and the traditional LOS model, respectively. The magnitude and frequency of throttle and rudder manipulations have been reduced. The smooth curves from the actuators are more consistent with the regular mode of surface vehicle maneuvering.

articleTitle: An improved indoor thermal preference indicator based on distributed consensus algorithm
abstract: Driven by the strong demands in the green buildings for saving energy consumption and increasing the human thermal comfort, an improved indoor thermal preference indicator based on distributed consensus algorithm is proposed. To this end, a temperature-energy model derived by the temperature-load model and load-energy model is addressed first. On this basis, an improved indoor thermal preference indicator is proposed. It is followed by the distributed consensus algorithm based on the alternating direction method of multipliers for optimizing the proposed indicator. The feasibility of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated by a case study on the multizone building system.

articleTitle: Management and Control System of Hazardous Chemicals Storage Cabinet Based on Android
abstract: In order to solve the contradiction between the widespread use of hazardous chemicals and the low efficiency of supervision, a novel information management scheme is proposed. As the core, a set of cabinet storage management system for hazardous chemicals is developed. The system is deployed on Android mobile terminal and adopts MVC architecture. It integrates automatic control technology, sensing technology, communication technology and computer technology. Intensive management of hazardous chemicals, operators, storage cabinets and reagent storage environment is realized. The system effectively solves the problems of unclear classification of hazardous chemicals, chaotic storage, imperfect management system and insufficient safety factor of management means. After functional tests, the system has good performance and has been put on line in relevant units.

articleTitle: Exponential Synchronization of Delayed Inertial Memristive Neural Networks
abstract: Exponential synchronization control problem of a class of delayed inertial memristive neural networks (DIMNNs) is explored. DIMNNs can be modeled as a second-order differential equations. This second-order differential equations possess the nature of discontinuous right-hand sides. With the help of the concept of drive-response systems, the theory of differential inclusions, Lyapunov functional method and a suitable controller, the sufficient criterion is explored to make the DIMNNs is exponential synchronization. It worth noting that the synchronization analysis method of DIMNNs adopted in this paper is not the variable transformation and reduced-order method, but direct analysis method. In the end, a numerical example is given to state the validity of the derived result.

articleTitle: Shared Control of Robot Based on Adaptive Network-based Fuzzy Inference System
abstract: The teleoperating system has the shortcomings of the limited instruction set and low control efficiency, which cannot efficiently complete complex tasks. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a robot shared control method based on the adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system, which includes two parts: local fuzzy autonomous control and adaptive fuzzy neural network based shared control, in which shared control implementations combine the robot's direct control commands with autonomous control to ensure that the robot correctly executes the operator's intentions, and can respond to the external environment in a timely manner, so that the robot can adapt changes in the external environment and adjust the movement trajectory in Real-time. Compared with the fuzzy control method, the experimental results prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Comparison Study of Tracking Differentiator and Robust Exact Differentiator
abstract: This paper presents a comparison study of two commonly-used differentiators, namely tracking differentiator (TD) and robust exact differentiator (RED) in both the frequency and the time domains. Specifically, we compare their performances in filtering and differentiation estimation for a large number of inputs with different levels of noises. Meanwhile, the parameter adaptability regarding different inputs for the two differentiators is tested. Furthermore, the efficiency of the two algorithms are evaluated respectively by the hardware. The results show that TD outperforms RED in quickness, smoothness, and noise-tolerance with no overshoots, while RED has advantageous exactness and robustness in the filtering and algorithm's simplicity. Also, TD has a better parameter adaptability and tolerance to signal frequency's variations whereas the performance of RED is heavily dependent on parameter setting. To overcome the overshoot problem in RED, an enhancement by adoption of the transition function is proposed. These results shall provide useful tips for selecting appropriate differentiators in real-life engineering, and designing new differentiators as well.

articleTitle: Analysis of MOOC Learning Effect Based on Brain Cognition Research
abstract: `Internet plus' education has promoted the process of the networking teaching model. The extensive development of online teaching modes such as MOOC has provided massive amounts of learning behavior data for educational researchers. In order to increase the attention of MOOC learners and achieve better teaching results, teachers need to rationally design MOOC courses from multiple dimensions such as teaching content, courseware design, and learner psychology.The rapid development of brain science research is constantly injecting new vitality into the reform of teaching methods. Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a non-invasive measurement of the electrical activity generated when neurons in the brain emit electrical signals synchronously. In specially designed experiments, a large number of the same stimuli will usually appear repeatedly, and the event-related potential (ERP) can be extracted by averaging the EEG data segments and superimposing them together. ERP is the direct result of specific sensory or cognitive events, and it is the response of the brain that can be measured. Therefore, it has been widely used in various research fields such as neuroscience, cognitive science, and psychology. ERP also has important applications in brain-computer interface. In this study the best state of MOOC learning is explored from the perspective of brain cognition. We obtain and measure the induced brain waves with or without novel stimulus, then analyze the extract ERP component and conduct discriminatory analysis. We design relevant eye movement experiments and EEG experiments to obtain eye movement data and EEG data. Through analysis and comparison, under various learning load levels, we find the relationship between the MOOC course design method and the attention of MOOC learners. Further discuss how to rationally design courses to improve students' learning effects.In this study we discuss the teaching reform methods that teachers should adopt in MOOC teaching, design efficient course introduction methods, stimulate learners' positive emotions, transform teaching methods as novel stimulus, enable learners to jump through the trough of thinking and increase their alertness. Related experiments verify the effectiveness of these methods and provide an effective way to improve the teaching quality of MOOC courses.

articleTitle: An Adaptive State Estimation Algorithm with Unknown Input and Missing Measurements
abstract: An adaptive Kalman filter algorithm based on retrospective cost input estimation (RCIE-AKF) is proposed for linear discrete-time system with unknown input and missing measurements. Firstly, the prior estimation input are optimized by retrospective cost function, which is reconstructed by system Markov parameters. The input estimator is constructed by prior inputs and residuals, and its coefficient matrix is updated by using the recursive least squares. Secondly, under the architecture of the Kalman filter (KF), the adaptive gain adjustment matrix is designed to improve the robustness of state estimation with missing measurements. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the validness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm with comparison to the traditional KF algorithm.

articleTitle: The Design and Application of Deformation Automatic Monitoring System for Metro Tunnel Crossing Project
abstract: For the construction safety monitoring problem that the urban rail transit crosses existing lines or important buildings(structures), two sets of automatic deformation safety monitoring systems are designed and developed. And they are both applied to a station project of Changsha Metro Line 4 passing through the existing Metro Line 2. The result of field practice shows that systems are reliable in operation, and accurate in measurement data. And the monitoring data from this two sets of system are consistent. So it can ensure the smooth progress and safety of the project construction.

articleTitle: Research on Power Distribution Control Strategy of Cutter Suction Dredger
abstract: Cutter suction dredger is one type of suction dredgers for dredger filling project. The power of the construction equipment in the cutter suction dredger accounts for about 65%-85% of the load of the entire ship's power system. Due to the uneven soil quality, the dredging conditions during dredging and the optimal power distribution algorithm will frequently adjust the set speed of the inverter motor, which will cause the power of the ship's power grid to fluctuate greatly and affect the stability of the ship's power grid. The article proposes a power distribution strategy based on a sliding-mode observer, which is used to track real-time feedback of the ship's power system, and redistribute power to near the standard value according to the grid frequency acceleration, thus well reducing the frequency and voltage fluctuations of the cutter suction ship grid.

articleTitle: Research on wind power prediction based on Doppler Sodar
abstract: In the process of decomposing the original signal, Doppler sodar used to measure the wind speed can effectively strip the high frequency, intermediate frequency and low frequency signals from each other by the empirical mode decomposition in wind power prediction. The prediction process of the model used in this paper and the evaluation index of the results. In order to verify the effect of the model, the measured data of an offshore wind farm in the coastal area of East Asia from January to April 2019 were selected for strict and standardized verification. The collected raw data are input into the empirical mode decomposition of the collection accurately and normatively, thereby obtaining accurate and complete modal components. At the same time, they are divided into three categories of intermediate frequency, low frequency and high frequency according to their fluctuation characteristics. Through the selected indicators for a comprehensive and objective evaluation, it is understood by testing that the model created in this paper has good feasibility and effectiveness, not only high prediction accuracy, but also fast calculation speed.

articleTitle: Parameter extraction of the photovoltaic model via an improved composite differential evolution
abstract: To provide more general and efficient photovoltaic (PV) systems, performing the simulation, control, and optimization on the corresponding PV model are essential and significant. The accurate degree of the related parameters is crucial for the performance of PV models. However, when identifying the parameters by an evolutionary algorithm, complex characteristics of the PV system propose difficulty for the solver. For this purpose, this paper develops an improved composite differential evolution (ICoDE) algorithm. In ICoDE, each individual generates three offspring by using three strategies from the strategy pool. During the evolution, the selection probabilities of different search strategies are adjusted dynamically to improve diversity in the early stage and speed convergence in the late stage. The proposed ICoDE is tested on the single diode model, double diode mode, and PV module. Compared with seven advanced optimization algorithms, the simulation results indicate the superiority of ICoDE.

articleTitle: Design and Energy Management of Three-Port Converter for PEMFC Hybrid Power System
abstract: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (PEMFC) hybrid power system has attracted widespread attention due to its high efficiency and environment-friendly characteristic, in which DC/DC converters with remarkable performance and superior energy management strategies occupy a dominant position. In this paper, a novel single-inductor Three-Port converter is proposed, which combines fuel cell and battery to form a hybrid power system. A power tracking control method is also implemented to switch the operating modes of the system according to the load demand power and the power source state, in which different voltage or current regulators in various working modes are developed to meet the requirements of steady-state and dynamic performance. The results of simulation and experiment indicate that multiple working modes can be flexibly switched under different load conditions, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed Three-Port converter and control strategy for PEMFC hybrid power system.

articleTitle: Performances investigation of Ejector affected by Secondary Flow Humidity in PEMFC
abstract: Ejector has been successfully used in proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) hydrogen circulation system because of its small size and no parasitic power. Since the secondary flow of ejector contains water vapor generated by PEMFC, and the outlet humidity of ejector is affected by the secondary flow humidity, the relationship between the outlet humidity of ejector and the secondary flow humidity needs to be studied through modeling and simulation. In this paper, the prediction model of the outlet humidity of the ejector is established and validated by simulation. The two-dimensional numerical model of the ejector is simulated by fluent, and the influence of the secondary flow humidity of the ejector on the outlet humidity is studied. The simulation results show that: The maximum error is 8% compared with the calculated value. In the case of double shock wave, the power is inversely proportional to the humidity; when the power is 40 kW, the outlet water content is the largest which increases by 0.158 kg. The outlet pressure is inversely proportional to the humidity, and the back pressure is reduced by at least 0.16 bar at the same power.

articleTitle: A New Method of Trajectory Accurate Measurement by Single Photoelectric Theodolite
abstract: Photoelectric theodolite is an important equipment to realize the measurement of aircraft motion trajectory in flight test. A single photoelectric theodolite with laser ranging equipment is usually used for tracking measurement. However, many factors may lead to abnormal or unavailable of laser ranging information in flight test, therefore, an accurate single station target trajectory measurement method based on eccentricity constraint is proposed. By installing the midline monitoring equipment in the aircraft taxiing datum line, the aircraft glide monitoring video is obtained, and the aircraft eccentricity is obtained through image analysis, which provides constraints for the single station positioning of photoelectric theodolite, so as to realize the accurate measurement of aircraft trajectory. The experimental results show that the method is simple, accurate and reliable. When the eccentricity accuracy is better than 5cm, the heading accuracy of single station measurement is better than 0.2m, and the elevation accuracy is better than 3cm, which can well meet the requirements of flight test.

articleTitle: Research on Filling and Sealing Robot Positioning Algorithm with Gaussian Mixture Model
abstract: Pharmaceutical manufacturing is a basic yet important industry for human health. And many pharmaceutical manufacturers using robots to ensure pharmaceutical quality and safety. This paper focuses on the Filling and Sealing Robot for Abe bottle pharmaceutical product manufacture. The inaccurate positioning of the bottle mouth will lead to robot operation error. So, we proposed an accurate positioning method for the Filling and Sealing Robot by applying the Gaussian mixture model (GMM). The bottle mouth image was radially expanded with a selected positioning coordinate and clustered by the GMM. The Euclidean metric distance between each cluster center and the mean of input data was calculated and modeled by multiple linear regression and then given the predicted position. Experimental results showed that this method accurately detects the center position of the bottle mouth, which guaranteed successful automatic filling and sealing by the Filling and Sealing Robot within the pharmaceutical assembly line.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Generation Prediction of Photovoltaic Panels Based on Meteorological Parameters and Support Vector Machine
abstract: On the basis of fully considering the impact of photovoltaic (PV) panels performance and actual operating state parameters on the power generation efficiency, a multi-variable short-term PV power generation prediction method based on support vector machine (SVM) is proposed in this paper. As a supervised learning model, SVM has outstanding advantages in data analysis and pattern recognition. Meanwhile, in order to obtain accurate and reliable data sources, an online monitoring system is established in the PV power station of Jilin Province. Actual monitoring data from PV monitoring system are used to train and validate of model, the simulation results show that the proposed model has higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: DOA Estimation for 2D Incoherently Distributed Sources with Nested Array Based on Matrix Reconstruction
abstract: Aiming at two-dimensional (2D) incoherently distributed (ID) sources, virtual arrays formed by a proposed nested array for estimating the direction of arrival (DOA) are obtained by vectoring cross-correlation matrices of subarrays. Rational invariance relations with regard to general manifold matrices of virtual arrays are obtained. In the light of the concept of ESPRIT, matrices are constructed to satisfy rotation invariance through rearranging receive vectors of the virtual arrays.

articleTitle: Formation tracking control for second-order nonlinear multi-agent system with unknown maneuvering leader
abstract: Time-varying formation tracking control problems for multi-agent systems with second-order nonlinear dynamics are investigated in this paper, where a leader with unknown dynamic control input is considered. By utilizing sliding mode control approach, a distributed formation tracking controller on the basis of the neighboring state information is designed. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, sufficient conditions for the realization of predefined formation tracking are summarized. A numerical simulation with six agents is performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed formation tracking protocol.

articleTitle: Design of coherent quantum observers in the presence of unknown inputs
abstract: In this paper, we proceed with our research on coherent quantum observers, with a focus on the scenario where there exist unknown inputs to the quantum plant. In our previous studies, we were mainly concerned with linear quantum plants in the absence of unknown inputs. However, when there are unmodeled dynamics or disturbances in quantum systems, the quantum version of Luenberger observers or Kalman filters might not be adequate. Given that no prior knowledge is assumed for the unknown inputs, we take advantage of the Hautus lemma to improve the robustness in observing a quantum system. More precisely, we consider linear quantum stochastic systems with unknown inputs involved whose dynamics correspond to open quantum harmonic oscillators. We show the procedure regarding synthesis of coherent observers for such systems that accomplish the task of simultaneously estimating system variables together with the unknown inputs, which is also illustrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: TLD tracking algorithm for metro construction site security
abstract: In view of security issues, this paper studies how to track the target at the metro construction site accurately and effectively. It is proposed to replace the tracking module in the TLD(Tracking-Leaning-Detection) algorithm with the GOTURN algorithm, to enhance the tracking robustness of the original algorithm in response to the target's illumination changes, rotation, occlusion, etc. To solve the problem of inaccurate sample division in the TLD algorithm learning module, a sample constraint mechanism is introduced to divide positive and negative samples more objectively and accurately. The sample deletion mechanism of weighted model matching is introduced to delete samples that are weak in characterizing the current target, which improves the tracking accuracy and efficiency of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can well reduce the interference that is caused by the target pedestrian's illumination change, turning, occlusion, etc. It can accurately track the target pedestrian for a long time, and has good robustness and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Evolution of the External Owned Account Trading Network on Ethereum
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the evolution of the External owned account Trading Network(ETN) on Ethereum from August 10th, 2015 to June 9th, 2017 through the perspective of network science. It is showed that the evolution of the topological properties of the ETN and important events are closely related. The average degree of the ETN is not constant but fluctuates within a small range of (2.1, 3.2). And there exists the extremely strongly positive correlation between the number of nodes and the number of edges in the ETN. Moreover, following the events happening, the degree distribution of ETN changes obviously. Moreover, the ETN has smaller values of degree correlation coefficient and clustering coefficient than that of the randomized graph with the same degree sequence, which implies that ETN shows the disassortative mixing pattern by degree and owns few triangles. Through the method of k-shell decomposition, our investigation shows the core of the ETN grows stepwise.

articleTitle: Day-ahead economic dispatch including photovoltaic power generation cost
Multi-stage multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm based on the evolutionary information of population
abstract: In the past few decades, many variations of multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm have been proposed to balance the convergence and diversity of optimal solutions. However, it is still difficult to obtain a set of accurate and well-distributed solutions for most complicated multi-objective problems. In this work, we present a multi-stage multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm (MSMOPSO) based on the evolutionary information of population. The evolutionary information of population is evaluated by the particle evolutionary ability, the population evolutionary ability, and the particle evolutionary efficiency. On the one hand, the optimization process is divided into two stages according to the population evolution information. Then, a novel leader selection strategy and a mutation operator to the particles are applied in different stages, aiming to improve the convergence performance and population diversity separately. On the other hand, flight parameters including the inertia weights and learning factors are adjusted adaptively and independently, which can better balance the global exploration and local exploitation abilities of the algorithm. Finally, the proposed algorithm is evaluated on benchmark test functions. And results show that the MSMOPSO is highly competitive for its obtained approximate Pareto fronts with uniform distribution and satisfactory convergence.

articleTitle: An Artificial Intelligent Method of Power Load Forecasting in Short-term
abstract: Due to the randomness of power load, single forecasting method is difficult to meet the requirements of forecasting accuracy. Study results show that the combination forecasting method can improve the prediction accuracy to a certain extent. This paper presents a short-term power load forecasting method based on ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD), long short term memory (LSTM) and Markov chain (MC). Firstly, the original power load series data are decomposed into a series of subsequences according to different frequencies by EEMD. Secondly, the low-frequency subsequence is used as the input of multiple linear regression model to predict, the high-frequency subsequence is used as the input of LSTM to predict, and MC is used to eliminate the random error to improve the prediction accuracy. Finally, the sub forecasting results are combined to get the final load forecasting results. This method can effectively predict the change trend of each frequency component, and at the same time, it also takes into account the randomness of prediction error. The experimental results show that the combination method improves the accuracy of short-term load forecasting to a certain extent, and meets the actual engineering requirements.

articleTitle: A State Transition Algorithm with Variable Local Candidate Solution Space and its application to Residue Hydrogenation Fractionation Process
abstract: Parameter Optimal State Transition Algorithm (POSTA) is a global metaheuristic method with adaptive parameter adjustment capabilities. However, its fixed local search candidate solution space easily leads to the computational redundancy and the problems that are difficult to jump out of local optimization. Therefore, a novel state transition algorithm with variable local candidate solution space is proposed in this paper, called VLCSSSTA. First, a dynamic logic of distance control is designed to speed up the search, which adaptively changes the size of the candidate solution space. Then, the larger candidate solutions are randomly generated to enhance the ability to jump out of the local optimum. Statistical research results show that the proposed algorithm has better performance than POSTA and some classic optimization algorithms in five benchmark function experiment. Finally, the proposed method is applied to the operation optimization in residue hydrogenation fractionation (RHF). The experimental results also verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Anti-Swing Control Strategy of Portal Crane
abstract: In this research, the anti-swing control strategy of portal crane for handing operation in port was studied by experiments. Firstly, the anti-swing control strategy of portal crane was designed, and the important parameter range of the control strategy was preliminarily analysed based on simulations. Secondly, the inclination measurement system of wire rope was developed, whose reliability was verified by experiments. Thirdly, by using the anti-swing control system, the anti-swing strategy could be joined to crane control system. Finally, through optimizing the anti-swing control coefficient in the field test, the working efficiency of the portal crane could be greatly improved under handling condition, where the final rotating position was appointed. Meanwhile, the driver operations and other performances of crane were not affected. The experimental works proved that satisfactory results could be achieved with the anti-swing control strategy.

articleTitle: A Bayesian Fault Diagnosis Method Incorporating Background Knowledge of Abnormality Signs
abstract: In process industries, fault diagnosis is to isolate the problem source that degrades control loop performance. In order to reduce dependence on the amount of historical data, this paper focuses on the use of background knowledge and incorporating it into Bayesian diagnosis. We formulated a kind of knowledge, known as Abnormality Signs, as constraints on the underlying probabilities and introduced those constraints into Bayesian diagnosis framework. In this way, the observation space dimensionality can be reduced. The proposed approach is evaluated by an application to a diagnosis problem of a simulated oil sand slurry handling system. The advantage of combining background knowledge with historical data is achieved even when the abnormality is sparse.

articleTitle: Control and Simulation Technology for the swarm of Air-launch UAVs
abstract: Aiming at the air-launch system of the swarm of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), we develop a strategy to control the launched vehicle at high altitude and high speed. Meanwhile, a reasonable performance scheme is essential to the continuous change of the center of gravity and quality of the carrier during launching. Considering this problem, the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis and kinematics simulation are used to optimize the load distribution of the carrier and select the best transmission mode. The requirements of short control time in the cruise phase and rapid launch of the UAVs are satisfied. The navigation algorithm based on the total energy control system (TECS) of launched vehicle is designed. The 3-D simulation system of launching is designed and parameters are selected. The rationality and effectiveness of the vehicle navigation algorithm are verified to meet the requirements for the swarm of air-launch UAVs.

articleTitle: Variational value learning in advantage actor-critic reinforcement learning
abstract: The performance and applications of reinforcement learning based on artificial neural networks (ANNs) have been limited by the overfitting problems of ANNs. With probability distributional weights and the variational inference technique, Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) can reduce the overfitting of data and thus improve the generalization ability of models. This paper proposes an advantage actor-variational-critic reinforcement learning algorithm (called A2VC) based on advantage actor-critic reinforcement learning (A2C). We model the value functions as a probability distribution and implement the distribution by the critic BNN. Based on the variational inference technique and the reparameterization trick, the weights of the critic BNN are well optimized. On the other hand, weights of the actor ANN are optimized with the stochastic policy gradient. Simulations in the lunar lander and cart-pole environments show the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed scheme over conventional A2C algorithm on the learning and decision-making capacity of agents.

articleTitle: Constrained Predictive Controller Design Based on Fuel Exhaustion and Thermal Constraints of A 5 kW SOFC Stack
abstract: Considering two temperature layers model of 5 kW SOFC (solid oxide fuel cell) stack not only dramatically reduces complexity of the model, but also shows the higher precision, which should be preferred in the controller design. Taylor series for the model are adopted, and then based on the static output power point, the constrained predictive controller is designed considering the fuel exhaustion and thermal constraints. The temperature and its gradient, output power, and fuel exhaustion are emphatically analyzed, which can ensure the fast power tracking and thermal safety simultaneously. Besides, the control standards of the fuel exhaustion show more rigorous compared to operating safety, which is comprehensively considered during controller design. The result shows that although power tracking process accelerated with the increase of the current regulation rate, the risk coefficient of the operating safety is increasing too.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of ship pilotage process risk based on cloud model
abstract: The safety of pilotage operation of ships in tidal ports is significantly affected by tides, and the multi-window pilotage operation is affected by many uncertain risks. In order to carry out effective ship pilotage risk control during multiwindow period, it is necessary to simulate the dynamic ship pilotage risk of multi-period to grasp the evolution law of process risk. Based on the analysis of ship pilotage task scenarios, risk factors in different stages of pilotage process is obtained. By acquiring the subjective and objective factors data of different sampling points in the pilotage process, the cloud model is used to carry out the risk modeling and dynamic simulation of multiperiod ship pilotage process. Aiming at the piloting process of a luxury cruise ship from Yangtze Estuary anchorage to Waigaoqiao designated berth, combining objective data and expert knowledge of sampling points, the risk of the piloting process during six tidal window period ships was simulated. The results show that the risk evolution of the ship piloting process as a whole shows the law of "bathtub curve", the risk of the ship piloting is higher in the initial and berthing period, and the risk value of the ship in the normal navigation stage presents a relatively low stable state. Among the six window periods, the overall risk is the highest in the period of " rapid rising ", and the lowest in the period of "high flat tide" and "low flat tide". The simulation results are consistent with the pilot's cognition of piloting practice.

articleTitle: H∞ Filtering for Discrete-time Markov Jump Systems with Partly Unknown Transition Probabilities Based on Delta Operator
abstract: In this paper, the filter is constructed in Markov jump system whose transition probability is partially unknown based on delta operator. As a new discretization method, delta operator can incorporate the continuous time system and the discrete into the unified framework. In order to eliminate the cross coupling phenomenon in the four operation modes, a special relaxation variable is introduced. Finally, the numerical example shows the desired filter is stochastically stable and augmented system with time sequence of the mode jumping from the case that partially unavailable transition probability satisfies the system index. The proposed method is less conservative.

articleTitle: Dynamic Matrix Control for Multi-excitation-unit Inductive Power Transfer Systems
abstract: Inductively power transfer (IPT) systems is attracting more and more attention in the field of engineering. To cover more charging area and harvest more output power for IPT systems, more and more researchers focus on multi-excitation-unit (MEU) configuration for IPT system. MEU-IPT system usually has multiple inputs at the primary side that need a coordinated regulating strategy to achieve set-point tracking ability on the system outputs. Due to its strong nonlinearity and high system order, the control of MEU-IPT system is always a challenge. However, the inputs and outputs of MEU-IPT system meets linear relationship. To overcome the difficult and complexity of modeling MEU-IPT system before controller design, this paper attempts to control the system without physical modeling. Instead, the system model is constructed using system output data. Then the Dynamic Matrix Control (DMC) is used to control the MEU-IPT system. The results of simulation prove that the method is useful which the multiple output reference voltages of the MEU system can be tracked.

articleTitle: Logistics Transportation System Based on the Differential Evolutionary Algorithm
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce and logistics industry, logistics transportation network based on different modes of transportation has become more and more complex. At present, the problem of multimodal transport logistics is considered as a kind of complex vehicle routing problem. Therefore, proper choice of logistics vehicle routing plays an important role in improving the economic benefit and rationality of logistics planning. In order to get a reasonable path, the Differential Evolutionary algorithm (DE) is applied to the study of multimodal transport logistics. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme are proved by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Almost Sure Exponential Stability in the Stochastic Delay Replicator Dynamics for Evolutionary Snowdrift Games
abstract: We investigate stochastic snowdrift games in which the payoff of players are disturbed by stochastic noise and time delay in this paper. The stochastic replicator dynamic model is proposed so as to investigate stochastic stability of evolutionary games. Our most interesting results concern the impact of multiplicative noise and time delay on the cooperation behavior in large well-mixed populations. The theory of stochastic delay differential equation is used as the main research tool. A sufficient condition on time delay and noise is proposed that it is corrected to guarantee the stable equilibrium point is indeed the almost sure exponential stablility (ASES). Moreover, we get a generalization of the cooperation evolution in two-strategy games. Stochastic Lyapunov framework is used to prove the stochastic stability and finding the value of delay is the key and challenging in our case. Examples are illustrated our results.

articleTitle: Containment-rendezvous Control for First-order Multi-agent Systems
abstract: This paper focus on containment-rendezvous issue of discrete-time first-order multi-agent system, which means all followers converge to an agreement point that belongs to the convex hull consisting of leaders. A proportional-integral (PI) coordination control protocol is constructed for followers achieving the asymptotic containment-rendezvous, and sufficient convergence conditions on the gain parameters are presented with the help of frequency-domain analysis approaches. A numerical simulation example is provided to exhibit the effectiveness of results.

articleTitle: Research and Application for Finishing Hot Mill Strip Width Model
abstract: Finishing hot mill width models are researched and developed in this paper. Some common reasons of width change in the finishing mill are introduced. Introduced some models related to finishing hot mill strip width which are used in our finishing mill setup model system for width prediction. These models include spread during horizontal rolling, width change caused by looper, width variation by high temperature creep and heat expansion and cold contraction during rolling. It is used to a 1700mm stainless steel hot mill rolling production line and the target width performance has a good effect. And the roughing mill width self-learning coefficient for finishing mill width changes are smooth and stable.

articleTitle: Data-Based H∞ Tracking Control for Time-Delay Systems Via Adaptive Dynamic Programming
abstract: In this paper, an data-based H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> tracking control algorithm is studied for the discrete delay system with disturbances. The augmented system is constructed and then transformed into a data-based system consist of inputs, outputs, and reference trajectories, which replace the state vector by a data vector. Next, based on the Bellman optimality principle, the historical data is adopted to derive a new Bellman equation. In order to realize H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> tracking control, the input and disturbance are generalized to the zero-sum game problem. Finally, by collecting operational data online, a H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> tracking control method based on data-based reinforcement learning algorithm is presented. Simulation example shows that the proposed reinforcement learning tracking control method is effective.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Orthodontic Treatment Based on the Registration of X-ray Image Features
abstract: This paper proposes a method using feature-based registration, which quantitatively evaluates orthodontic treatment on X-ray lateral skull radiographs. Considering the problem of inconsistent scales of images before and after orthodontic, and to make the registration more robust to noise, this paper introduces a registration algorithm based on maximum correntropy criterion with scale constraints. By aligning the crania and mandibles separately and aligning teeth on this basis, the quantified movement of four key teeth can be acquired, which indicates the result of orthodontic treatment. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method makes evaluation of orthodontic treatment under the same reference and is not sensitive to the error of the mark points, which is accurate and robust.

articleTitle: Energy Control Strategy Study of HEB Based on Torque Distribution
abstract: In order to reduce the gas consumption of the engine, and maintain the battery state of charge (SOC) value in a reasonable range, the energy control strategy of HEB (Hybrid Electric Bus) is optimized by the distribution of demand torque based on driving conditions. Firstly, actual driving conditions of HEB are analyzed. Secondly, three driving conditions are divided according to characteristics of the HEB running load. Then, four types of energy control strategies are proposed according to the logic threshold algorithm, which use the optimal fuel economy as the control target and the engine operating point and battery SOC value as the control object. Finally, considering the actual driving conditions, the HEB control strategy model is established by the Matlab/Simulink and cruise software. Results show that compared with the original HEB, the proposed four types of control strategies can better reduce gas consumption under different riving conditions, and reduce the gas consumption rate of HEB by 4.4%.

articleTitle: Mental Workload Assessment
abstract: Mental Workload (MWL) represents the occupancy of brain resources under working conditions and is one of the important auxiliary strategies for adaptive automation. This article uses different levels of drone simulation tasks to induce different levels of MWL, records the EEG during the control of the drone, and combines the subjective scale to explore the relationship between MWL and EEG and establish MWL assessment model. The study found that the new index closely related to MWL, mutual information. Combining mutual information and power spectrum characteristics to establish a SVM-based MWL assessment model, and finally the accuracy rate of MWL classification reached 92.6%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Anti-clamp System for Learning Platform Based on Deep Learning
abstract: In this paper, a kind of deep learning - based learning table automatic closing anti - clamping technology is proposed. Based on image processing, this technology builds a machine vision model of deep convolutional neural network, collects samples in sections for video analysis, conducts batch image preprocessing on massive data, trains corresponding models respectively, and then conducts real-time monitoring on the closing process of the learning desk. If there is an obstacle, the information will be fed back to the system to stop the closing of the learning desk. If not, continue to perform the closing action until the learning table is completely closed. This method through the actual test, has high response speed and accuracy of the obstacle detection, detection blind area is smaller, the advantages of non-contact and active prevention clip. At the same time, it has strong adaptability, low requirements on hardware, and has a very good application prospect.

articleTitle: Control-Oriented Wind Farm Wake Modeling with Near Wake Performance and LES Validation
abstract: With the deepening research on wind farms, wake effects have gradually been paid attention to and used in wind farm optimization. During this development, the engineering wake models are adopted, which could be further improved in modeling accuracy. This paper adopts a control-oriented wake model to improve the modeling accuracy, especially in the near wake region. A double-Gaussian wake model is incorporated with appropriate wake deflection and combination models and a vertical wind profile function. Based on a Large-eddy simulated dataset, the proposed model is adopted and verified. The widely-used Gaussian wake model is also adopted and compared with the proposed model. Results show good agreement between the presented model and LES results, especially in the focused near wake region.

articleTitle: Propulsion system optimization for the tail-sitter VTOL SUAV
abstract: This study is focus on the optimization of the proprotor propulsion system for an tail-sitter VTOL SUAV. The propulsion should meet the need of vertical taking-off, cruising and transition between hovering and cruising. The propulsion system is necessary for the effective control in flight, especially in transition mode. Based on the tail-sitter VTOL SUAV, the design difficulties are analyzed. And the optimization is built with the consideration of BEMP system matching and two different design points. The flight test proves that the optimized proprotor propulsion system is suitable and effective to control.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired attitude determination method based on polarized skylight and ground horizon
abstract: Due to the existence of the gyroscope bias, the attitude obtained by the MEMS inertial sensor easily diverges over time. However, animals in nature can use the natural attributes for navigation, such as geomagnetic field, gravitational field, polarized skylight and stars. The purpose of this paper is to investigate an attitude determination method which mimics animal polarization and omnidirectional vision. This method uses a bio-inspired polarization sensor and a central catadioptric camera to estimate attitude by measuring polarized skylight and ground horizon. We first described the overall framework of the novel bio-inspired attitude determination method and analyzed the measurement principle of polarized skylight and ground horizon. Then, the estimated attitude and MEMS inertial results are fused by a closed-loop Kalman filter. The experimental results indicate that our proposed method can effectively correct the attitude drift of the MEMS inertial sensor. This work provides a novel attitude reference method for potential robot navigation.

articleTitle: Extended Prescribed Performance Control for Train Tracking Operation with Switching Dynamics
abstract: This paper addresses a new extended prescribed performance control (EPPC) for automatic train tracking operation in the presence of switching dynamics. By switching dynamics, it is meant that the considered mathematical model is established considering partitioned multiple operational conditions, which are widely encountered during the whole running process, such as changing of operational resistances, emerging of tunnel, and so on. Hence, the model with switching dynamics is much more accurate with comparison to conventional model with empirical parameters. With comparison to traditional prescribed performance control scheme, the proposed EPPC is a scheme capable of guaranteeing the output error converges to a small residual set with adjustable bounds. In this paper, defined tracking errors with respect to train movement are constrained by the predefined boundary functions and determined by control gains synchronously. Moreover, both average dwell-time and arbitrarily switching dynamics in the closed-loop systems can be proved to be stable by the designed control scheme. Finally, simulation results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Throttle Control Method Based on Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System
abstract: In the actual control of the electronic throttle, the electronic throttle control system is affected by the return spring, friction, and gear clearance, and exhibits nonlinear characteristics and disturbance or parameter uncertainty caused by engine shake. It makes device design difficulties. In response to the above problems, a non-linear mathematical model of the electronic throttle is established, and a control algorithm based on the T-S model adaptive neural fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) is designed. The adaptive neural fuzzy inference system is used to optimize the input and output parameters. In Matlab / simulink, set up a simulation model to simulate the step signal, sinusoidal signal, disturbance and parameter perturbation. The simulation results show that the nonlinear position of the electronic throttle is the most obvious initial position (limping home position), ANFIS control strategy has better tracking effect; compared with conventional PID control, ANFIS control has better steady state, dynamic performance and anti-interference ability, and has stronger adaptability and robustness.

articleTitle: Robust Hierarchical Sliding Mode Control of Double-frame Mobile Robot with Suction Cups
abstract: In this paper, a novel double-frame mobile robot with suction cups for aircraft skin inspection is studied. A robust hierarchical sliding mode (RHSM) scheme is presented to ensure the state stabilization of the robot system. Initially, the double-frame robot moving on the curved surface is analyzed, the nonholonomic constraint equations are established, and the dynamic model of the mobile double-frame robot is derived through Lagrange method. Then, a RHSM controller is designed, including a hierarchical sliding mode controller for sliding motor, rotating motor and leg cylinder, and an observer for estimating the total uncertainty. It is shown that the system is closed-loop stable, and the system variables are asymptotically stable. Simulation section is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the RHSM method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A method of laser point temperature detection based on CNN
abstract: There has been a direct relationship between the temperature of the laser point and the quality of the casting in the process of the 3D printing. In the paper, a method based on convolutional neural network (CNN) was proposed to estimate the temperature of the laser point. The collected temperature data used were trained by the deep-learning method. A new structure of the model was proposed on the part of the CNN model, which improved from original LeNet. The process of the prediction for the testing set was carried out through the new model. The unknown temperature in the testing set can be estimated. The experimental result illustrates that the proposed method is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Cooperative Stabilization Control of the Linear Time-invariant System Based on Distributed Observers
abstract: In this paper, the cooperative stabilization problem of linear time-invariant (LTI) systems is studied based on a class of distributed Luenberger observers. A given LTI system is estimated by a network of observers. In case of observability configuration or external attack, each observer has to possess different measurement output of the LTI system. Classical distributed control strategies cannot be directly used because they are assumed to obtain identical information. In view of this problem, a class of distributed observers are designed under an undirected graph, which can recover the state of the LTI system by limited local information. By using any single channel of the estimated state, a control input is proposed to stabilize the LTI system. By analysing the stability of an augmented system which involves the LTI system and the estimation error system, some necessary and sufficient conditions are derived for the existence of control gains that guarantee the stabilization of the LTI system. In addition, some algorithms are proposed to specify the control gains. Lastly, some simulation examples are given to verify the effectiveness of the theoretical result.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Scaling Based Adaptive Fault-tolerant Control Scheme for Rigid Spacecraft with Simultaneous Sensor and Actuator Faults
abstract: This paper develops an adaptive fault-tolerant control scheme for spacecraft attitude tracking control with sensor and actuator faults simultaneously. The adaptive control scheme is designed based on paramaterization of unknown gyro bias and inertia parameter. To overcome the obstacles of matrix integrability, an output filter is introduced to modify the parameter regression matrix, and the influence of matrix modification is eliminated by dynamic scaling. The proposed adaptive controller can ensure the stability and tracking performance of spacecraft subject to sensor and actuator faults simultaneously. Simulation results are given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive fault-tolerant control scheme.

articleTitle: Model Free Adaptive Control for Thrust Cylinder of Water Well Drilling Rig
abstract: To solve the problem of poor propulsion velocity tracking performance caused by the load change in the water well drilling rig system, a control method for the thrust cylinder of water well drilling rig based on the data-driven was proposed. The force equation of thrust cylinder with variable load was discretized, and the nonlinear system about output displacement and input current after the discretization was given; Since multiple variables were in the nonlinear system equation and the load changes model was unknown, the model-free adaptive controller based on the data-driven was designed and the pseudo partial lead number method of estimation awas given; A model-free adaptive controller for thrust cylinder of water well drilling rig system was established, and the simulation results were given in the MATLAB/Simulink environment. Research result shows that under the constant load of thrust cylinder in the normal operation, with the time range of 0.05-0.1s , the speed errors of thrust cylinder piston utilizing the model free adaptive control (MFAC) scheme and the PI vector control scheme are 0.05m / s and 0.02m / s , respectively. In the case of thrust cylinder load was changed suddenly, with the time range of 0.4-0.5s , comparison of the momentum error between MFAC and PI control, PI control has 100N overshoot and it can reach the expected value at 0.001s , MFAC can be stable without overshoot at 0.05s . Therefore, the model free adaptive control scheme has better robustness and stability in the control for thrust cylinder of the water well drilling rig, and the proposed method is an effective data-driven control method for suppressing the load disturbance.

articleTitle: Tilting Curve Design of a Novel Tilt-rotor UAV Based on Rotor/Wing Interference Model
abstract: This paper describes a method of designing and optimizing the tilting curve based on the rotor/wing interference model. Considering the interference between the rotors and wings, the slip theory is used to build the aerodynamic model in the transition mode. Then, the accuracy of the aerodynamic model is improved by the use of aerodynamic simulation data. Based on the aerodynamic model, the three-degree-of-freedom dynamics model is established. And then, the method of the velocity profile is used to design the tilting curve, and the curve is optimized by the genetic algorithm. Finally, the simulation results are present to prove the effectiveness of the tilting curve.

articleTitle: Superpixels-based Robust Fuzzy C-means Clustering Algorithm with Boundary Retune for Image Segmentation
abstract: In this paper, a superpixels-based robust algorithm for image segmentation based on fuzzy C-means (FCM) is investigated, which performs image segmentation with the help of global information and local one (SGFCML). Superpixels can remain the similar intensity information in each superpixel, and reduce the noise influence, which is a popular preprocessing method. In this paper, after the superpixel preprocessing, in the first stage, for the initial segmentation an improved fuzzy local information c-means algorithm is performed, which introduces coefficient of variation of local windows and pixel gray value similarity simultaneously. Because these two factors are introduced, the trade-off between smoothing and clustering can be controlled more accurately and the robustness can be enhanced. In the second stage, local information is utilized to perform segmentation in the regions near the initial boundary, and weighted voting strategy applied to refine the boundary. Experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm is effective over conventional FCM and other extended FCM algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal dispatch of CCHP system considering exergy loss and economic cost
abstract: Distributed combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) system develops as a novel energy supply way which achieves energy cascading utilization and increases the energy efficiency. In this study, mathematical models of a typical CCHP system considering both exergy loss and economic cost of each equipment are established. Multi-objective optimization is also conducted to optimize economic cost and exergy loss simultaneously by multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO) algorithm. The optimal solution is selected by grey decision-making approach. Compared with the conventional economic dispatching, the results indicate the proposed multi-objective dispatch is more efficient in a way.

articleTitle: Driver Behavior Modeling via Inverse Reinforcement Learning Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
abstract: In this paper, an inverse reinforcement learning method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed to model driver's steering behavior. Initially, the vehicle dynamics is represented by a Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model which provides a method of approximating Q-function. Then the driver behavior model is described as an optimal control policy with decision-making model which illustrates the driving style. Subsequently, the Q-function is approximated by a quadratic polynomial-in-memberships form and the PSO algorithm is used to obtain the decision-making model from the driving data. And the corresponding optimal control policy is obtained by using the Q-learning policy iteration method. Finally, a numerical simulation is carried to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Parallel-machine Scheduling Problem Considering Energy Consumption and Deteriorating Effect
abstract: In actual manufacturing process, a great deal of energy resources is employed. Therefore, decision-makers have to not only consider time-oriented objectives, but also focus on energy-efficient criteria. In our work, we study the energy-efficient problem of the parallel machine scheduling with uncertain factor, i.e., deteriorating effect. And a mathematical model to reach minimization makespan and energy consumption is formulated. Then, we design an approach of multi-objective ant lion optimization according to the characteristics of this work. By conducting extensive simulation experiments, this work compares ant lion optimization approach with two popular multi-objective evolutionary algorithms. And two performance indexes of coverage metric and inverted generational distance are employed to analyze their results of the experiment. The comparative results indicate that the better solutions can be found by ant lion optimization approach for solving our concerned problem.

articleTitle: Multi-linear CCD indoor human localization approach based on unscented Kalman filter
abstract: A low-cost, high-precision trilinear CCD sensor is used to locate the human indoors. The sensor is composed of three linear CCD cameras. According to the imaging rule of ID camera and the principle of coordinate transformation, the position and attitude of the human carrying this sensor can be measured. An indoor human localization approach based on unscented Kalman filter (UKF) is proposed. When point lights arranged on the ceiling are temporarily blocked, the position and direction angle of the target can be estimated by the UKF algorithm according to the current sampling information. Simulation and experimental results show that the indoor human localization approach is feasible, which can track the target when point lights are temporarily blocked.

articleTitle: Design of Motor Shaft Power Meter Based on Phase Detection Using Improved All Phase FFT
abstract: This paper presents a measurement scheme of the motor shaft power based on the phase detection using the improved all phase fast Fourier transform (APFFT). This method can measure the phase difference and frequency of the output signals from the torque-speed sensor connected to the motor, which are proportional to the torque and revolving speed, respectively. A signal processing circuit is proposed to stabilize the amplitude of the output signals from the torquespeed sensor which fluctuates with the change of operating states of the motor. In addition, STM32 single-chip computer is applied to sample the output signals, and an improved APFFT method is performed on this microprocessor, which can detect the phase with a high measurement accuracy. It is proved that the improved APFFT method is immune to the interference of the harmonic and direct current noise, and it has a high accuracy when the Gaussian noise is not server. Experiment results are shown to prove the validity of the proposed scheme.

Author Keywords: Improved all phase fast Fourier transform (APFFT)

articleTitle: Two-layer structure predictive control of target tracking mode for dual time-scale system
abstract: In the dual time-scale system, the time for the fast and slow model to reach steady-state values is inconsistent. Based on the "point" model strategy of integral variables, this paper compares and analyzes the slow model variables with the integral variables and designs a two-layer structure predictive controller for the dual time-scale system under the model truncation. The steady-state optimization layer uses the step response characteristics of slow model variables to derive the multi-step controlled variable prediction values after the truncation point. Based on the improved displacement matrix, the error correction coefficient is modified by introducing an error compensation factor in the dynamic control layer to reduce the accumulated error of model truncation. Under the truncated dual time-scale system model, the improved strategy proposed in the paper can not only maintain the amount of calculation of the predictive control but also solve the problem that the steady-state target calculation is not accurate enough due to model mismatch. Finally, the elfectiveness of the improvement strategy is verified by simulation comparison.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Simulation of Complex Equipment Support Mission Profile with Mission Constraints
abstract: At present, complex equipment rapid support and the multiple scientific analysis of equipment support are not competent with the combat needs. This paper used a UML- like language to establish the timing relationship model between support activities. Based on the corresponding activities, we used simulation experiments with association rules to obtain a complete support mission profile with mission constraints. The model can establish complex equipment support mission profiles of any numbers and types, highly scalable, and can be updated quickly following the equipment iteration.

articleTitle: A Neural Policy Learning Method for Robust Stabilization of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
abstract: In this paper, a neural-network-based policy learning method is established to solve robust stabilization for a class of continuous-time nonlinear systems with both internal dynamic uncertainties and input matrix uncertainties. First, the robust stabilization problem is converted to an optimal control problem by choosing an appropriate cost function and proving system stability. Then, in order to solve the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation, a policy iteration algorithm is employed by constructing and training a critic neural network. The approximate optimal control policy can be obtained by this algorithm, and the solution of the robust stabilization can be derived as well. Finally, a numerical example and an experimental simulation are provided to verify the availability of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Control of unknown mismatched uncertainties by event-triggered schemes
abstract: This paper is concerned with the event-triggered control problem of unknown mismatched time-varying uncertainties. Three event-triggered schemes, namely, the absolute scheme, the relative scheme, and the switching scheme, are proposed to reduce the unnecessary signal transmission. A backstepping-like design approach is employed to cope with the mismatched time-varying uncertainties. Consequently, the proposed controllers could compensate for the mismatched time-varying uncertainties and ensure the closed-loop system globally bounded. The validity of the proposed schemes is shown by an illustrative example.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Tracking Control for Switched Linear Systems with Structural Uncertainties
abstract: This paper investigates the robust fault-tolerant tracking control (FTTC) of a class of switched linear systems with structural uncertainties. Based on a practical and general model of actuator failures, robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> fault-tolerant tracking performance of the system is considered. Meanwhile, by utilizing multiple Lyapunov functions technique, sufficient conditions for the existence of the fault-tolerant tracking controller are given. Moreover, the corresponding controller solvability condition is cast into a convex optimization problem, which can effectively achieve the decoupling between the Lyapunov matrices and controller gains. Finally, simulation studies demonstrate the feasibility and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On control design of a multi-group SEITR model
abstract: This paper provides a multi-group SEITR model with immunity, and studies the stability of this model. For this model, we give the stability analysis of disease-free equilibrium (DFE) which is related to the basic reproduction number. If the basic reproduction number is large than one, then the disease will persist in the population. In this case, we consider to design appropriate control strategy which can reduce the number of exposed population. Finally, a numerical example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Optimal control for switched nonlinear systems with state-dependent switching
abstract: A dynamic optimization method is proposed for optimal control of switched systems with fixed switching sequences. The subsystems are activated automatically once the state variable passes through a certain switching surface in the state space. In order to solve this optimal control problem, firstly, the control vector parameterization (CVP) technique is applied to approximate the control input by a piecewise constant function. Second, the partial derivatives of the objective function with respect to parameterized control input are computed in a costate-based formula. Finally, the dynamic optimization method is presented by the gradient-based optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Shop Scheduling with Time Lags Based on Petri Nets and Heuristic Search
abstract: The increasing demand for diversity and individuation of commodities in such a smart manufacturing age leads to new requirement for the flexibility and responsiveness of shop scheduling. This paper mainly deals with the scheduling in an industry computer main board production line which can be modeled as a job shop scheduling problem with time tag according to its real situation analysis. A new responsively heuristic search, combing with petri nets modeling and the heuristic L1 algorithm, is proposed to solve the problem. The method uses best first strategy to expand the scale of reachability graph, and then pruning techniques are applied to make sure that the solution complies with the request of time constraints. At the same time, the maximum degree of petri net concurrence approach is developed to accelerate the search process in case of the status explosion of petri nets. Experimental results are carried out to show the effectiveness and responsiveness of the method. Especially the concurrency strategy can reduce about 82.18% average percentage of the number of markings comparing with the one without concurrency consideration.

Author Keywords: industry computer main board production line

articleTitle: Research On Application of Data Fusion In Streetlights Control System
abstract: The application of Data Fusion technology in intelligent control system of street light is researched. The realization of intelligent control of street light mainly depends on the detection of external environment by temperature and humidity sensor, photoelectric sensor and current sensor. In the research process, Kalman filter equation is used to fuse the data collected by the sensor to realize the primary diagnosis of fault monitoring and alarm. In the feature layer and decision layer of the system, the fuzzy logic method is used to obtain the membership functions of light intensity and temperature and humidity. Finally, the environmental control results before and after fusion are obtained by the membership values of humidity, temperature and photosensitive sensor and fuzzy Data Fusion algorithm The state and reliability of the sensors are analyzed, and the description of the external environment information is more accurate. It can be proved that Data Fusion technology can improve the intelligence and stability of street light control system.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Index of Airborne Ammunition Support Equipment Optimization
abstract: Through organizing the equipping and usage of current airborne ammunition support equipment, this paper analyzed the corresponding support efforts and determined the procedure and equipment list of single equipment based on present support mission, obtained the sequence diagram of single equipment support by adopting the IDEF3 approach, analyzed the influential factors of airborne ammunition support equipment optimization via the DEMATEL methodology, and established the evaluation index system of airborne ammunition support equipment optimization.
