articleTitle: Fault detection for discrete-time Markov jump systems with time-varying delays and partially known transition probabilities
abstract: This paper investigates a fault detection (FD) method for discrete-time Markov jump systems with timevarying delays and partially known transition probabilities. Different from the traditional systems that need to know all transition probabilities, the proposed method only needs to know the partially known transition probabilities to realize FD, which relax the condition greatly. The FD design is reduced to a H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filtering problem through the FD filter is regarded as residual generator. A numerical example demonstrates effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of Campus Safety Culture Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
abstract: With the increasing attention from all occupations on campus safety, it is urgent to strengthen the construction of safety culture in universities. After sending questionnaires to students, teachers and administrators in a closed management engineering university, this paper uses SPSS 22.0 to test the rationality and reliability of the questionnaires. According to the test results, an operable evaluation index system of campus safety culture sensitivity is established, and then four first-level indicators affecting the sensitivity of campus safety culture are determined, which are safety concept culture, safety behavior culture, safety management culture, and safety physical culture. Seven secondary indicators and twenty-eight tertiary indicators have been established. Using analytic hierarchy process to determine the weight of each evaluation index, a three-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is established. According to the actual situation of the university, the judgment is calculated, which concludes that both the safety culture sensitivity and the safety behavior culture of the university are the highest, both the safety concept culture and the safety material culture are higher, and the safety management culture is the lowest. This result further verifies the rationality and feasibility of the indicator system, at the same time, also indicates that there are still some problems in the school's management system. The establishment of this system is helpful for the university to regulate and manage the problems, and provides reference and help for this kind of engineering universities to evaluate and improve the construction of campus safety culture.

articleTitle: Sign synchronization of coupled nonlinear systems with cooperative and competitive interactions
abstract: This paper studies various criteria for sign synchronization of coupled nonlinear systems with cooperative and competitive interactions. sign synchronization means that all states have same sign when time exceeds a threshold. When the adjacency matrix is a nonnegative matrix, Based on Kamke's theorem and Comparison theorem, we obtain some sufficient conditions such that the coupled nonlinear systems achieves unanimity. When cooperative and competitive relationships coexist and the nonlinear items are switching systems, some results of Lie bracket are used to obtain sufficient conditions for sign synchronization.

articleTitle: Multistability Analysis and FPGA Implementation of a New 3D Chaotic System
abstract: In this paper, a new 3D chaotic system is proposed based on a generalized Hamiltonian system with dissipative term by selecting the appropriate structure matrix, dissipation matrix, and input matrix. The basic dynamic characteristics are analyzed by using simulation including phase portraits, Lyapunov exponent spectrum and bifurcation diagram. In addition, the coexisting attractors and multistability of the proposed system are further investigated. Finally, this new 3D chaotic system is validated by designing and implementing its digital circuit using the Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA).

articleTitle: Estimation of Urban Traffic State Based Velocity Cell Transmission Model
abstract: The traditional cell transmission model takes the number of vehicles in the sub-sections (cells) as the state variable. In traffic state estimation, the system output equation needs to be established by combining fundamental diagram, increasing the uncertainty of the system and reducing the estimation accuracy. At present, vehicle trajectory data has been widely used in traffic state analysis and optimization, and velocity data is easy to obtain. Therefore, under the current background, directly use mobile device data to build traffic flow model has become an important research problem in the traffic field. Firstly, this paper studies the cell transmission model with velocity as the state variable, which is called the Cell Transmission Model for velocity (for short CTM-v). Further, with network control data and traffic flow parameters as inputs, the CTM-v model is programed by using MATLAB, and then the state evolution of road network is analyzed. Finally, taking the topological network in Changping District of Beijing as an example, the simulation environment is established by using VISSIM simulation software. The results show that the simulation errors compared with CTM-v model evolution are below 5 km/h, except for the large error in the transition of congested and non-congested state, which validate the accuracy of the proposed CTM-v estimation model in this paper.

articleTitle: Application of Reflectance Modulation to Coupled Orbit and Attitude Control on Solar Sail
abstract: The solar sail takes advantages of solar radiation pressure to achieve orbital propulsion which offers a sustainable maneuvers method in deep space exploration. This paper proposes a coupled orbit -attitude control method which can control trajectory and attitude at the same time on solar sail. Firstly, by the torque and force generation a diffusion modulation of coupled orbit-attitude dynamical model has been given. Secondly, the distribution of sailboards on solar sail under the solar radiation pressure has been discussed. Thirdly, control laws based on the traditional state-dependent Riccati equation has been obtained to the coupled orbit-attitude problem. Then, numerical simulation of a solar sail on the Earth orbit which are based on the reflection modulation have been given.

articleTitle: A Modeling Method of FCCU Reactor-regenerator System using NARX
abstract: The nonlinear autoregressive model with exogenous variables (NARX) by Levenberg-Marquardt(LM) algorithm is applied to model the FCCU reactor-regenerator system. NARX is a dynamic neural network, its delay term and output feedback structure features are suitable for modeling complex systems. We consider the regenerator pressure and riser temperature as the system output, which determines the system stability and product distribution. At the same time, we select the regenerator smoke gas flow and the riser catalyst flow as system inputs. The simulation results show that the NARX model can effectively describe the practical dynamic characteristic of the FCCU reactor-regenerator system, at the same time it has better predictive and generalization ability than the traditional artificial neural network (ANN) model.

articleTitle: Optimal Guaranteed Cost Control of Switched Singular Systems
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of optimal guaranteed cost control (GCC) for linear switched singular systems. A sufficient condition is given to guarantee that the GCC problem has feasible solutions according to the multiple Lyapunov function theory. Switching proportional-derivative (PD) state feedback guaranteed cost controllers are designed using step-by-step design. Next, optimal guaranteed cost controllers are designed by solving a convex optimization problem with some inequalities constraints. Numerical simulation shows the merits and the efficiency of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-axis Cooperative Control System based on A Certain Radar
abstract: Radar military electronic equipment has higher and higher requirements for the reliability of the system. This paper not only presents the design method of the radar antenna dual-axis cooperative control system for this problem, but also discusses the important role of this technology in improving the reliability of the entire system and the key technologies such as the composition, working principle and design scheme of the system. Applying this technology to the actual radar system design can improve the reliability and stability of the system, and the system can integrate different types of controllers, variable frequency drives, and communication buses. Based on this, the system can be applied Data acquisition, exchange and other occasions where the computer needs to work continuously and similar multi-axis control systems.

articleTitle: Microservice Driven Parallel Framework for Image Collection and Processing in the Large-scale Laser Beam Collimation System
abstract: Laser beam collimation involving image collection and processing is an essential task in the high-power laser experiment. With the development of worldwide high-power laser facilities, both the type and the amount of image collection devices have increased, which contributes to a large-scale heterogeneous image collection system and a highly concurrent image data environment. It is challenging our current image collection and processing system, and requiring a more efficient control pattern. Parallelism by utilizing the multi-thread technology is an effective solution, while a big obstacle is that image collection devices can not be parallel driven, thus we obtain the pseudo parallelism. To address this issue, giving the existing microservice based distributed architecture utilized by the laser beam collimation system, we equip each of these devices with an embedded computer. We conduct the co-design of hardware and software for each image collection device, such that each embedded computer serves as an independent and parallel servant of image collection and processing. This parallel framework is expected to reduce the time consumption of image acquisition and processing. What's more, hardware customization can be further implemented.

articleTitle: A novel time cost mechanism in spatial snowdrift game
abstract: The factors that affect cooperation have always been the focus of evolutionary game research. This paper studies the effect of time cost in the snowdrift game on a square lattice. For drivers in the snowdrift game, they must consider not only labor costs but also time costs. Two drivers do the common work faster than one. Therefore, when the time cost is too high, individuals will cooperate to avoid the loss of time cost. The simulation results show that the level of cooperation has been significantly improved when the time cost is two times the labor cost.

articleTitle: A novel wavelength selection algorithm based on permutation analysis and variable combination
abstract: As one of the most important preprocessing procedures in spectral detection, wavelength selection plays an irreplaceable role in reducing the model computation consumption and prediction error. However, many wavelength selection methods only use a mono-directional strategy to capture the synergetic influence between wavelength points, which causes information loss and limits their performance. Herein, a novel algorithm called bidirectional permutation analysis (BPA) is proposed. To completely capture the synergetic influence between each wavelength point, we first modify the permutation analysis to select wavelength points that have a high synergetic effect with any other wavelength points. Then, the variable combinational population analysis (VCPA) is used to select other wavelength points from another direction that whether they are suitable to combine with front selected wavelengths. Benefited from this bidirectional selection structure, BPA could more comprehensively evaluate the synergetic effect between wavelength points and avoid the loss of useful information. The performance of BPA was estimated by using the spectral common dataset of corn oil. The comparison results indicate that our algorithm performs better on both accuracy and stability than four state-of-the-art algorithms: CARS, VCPA, VCPA-GA, and VCPA-IRIV.

articleTitle: Experimental study on metallic bipolar plates fuel cell system with high power density
abstract: To further promote fuel cell applications, the Tsinghua fuel cell team has developed a metallic bipolar plates fuel cell system. This paper first introduces the overall structure and working principle of the metallic bipolar plates fuel cell system. Secondly, the steady-state characteristics of fuel cell are introduced: 1) The mass of FC stack is 140kg. 2) The rated output power and peak output power of the stack are 96.2kW and 106.1kW respectively. 3) The rated output power and peak output power of the FC system are 81.3kW and 88.0kW respectively. The volumetric power density of the FC stack developed by Tsinghua team is 3.3 kW /L. Finally, the dynamic characteristics of fuel cell system are introduced: 1) The control error of current and anode inlet pressure is less than 3%. 2) The control error of cathode inlet pressure is less than 5%. 3) In most cases, the control error of air mass flow if less than 10%. The experiment results show that the metallic bipolar plates fuel cell system developed by the Tsinghua fuel cell team can stably output 81.3kW power, with the highest efficiency up to 53.2% and good dynamic characteristics, which can be further applied to actual vehicles.

articleTitle: The Design of Distributed Simulation Architecture for Embedded System
abstract: Traditional simulators and simulation equipment are independent of the actual equipment, and the related training is on the operation of weapons and equipment. It is obviously that the function of simulation training is missing. The real feel and training effects cannot fully meet the training requirements of the actual equipment. This paper analyzes the development status of embedded simulation technology at home and abroad, and expounds the requirements of embedding the simulation system in actual equipment. It aims at multi-entity embedded simulation modeling, real-time online simulation, the simulation scheduling management of the real-time operating system, the management of data interaction, etc. The key issue is to study the architecture design of a multi-entity distributed embedded simulation system for practical exercises. It proposes an architecture design plan for an embedded simulation system which has an independent simulation function layer and facilitates the general development of simulation models. By building an embedded simulation verification environment that supports the air platform, we conduct simulation verification. The result shows that the system architecture have the ability of realizing multi-entity operation management, solving the problem of multi-entity simulation data interaction and management, and meeting the needs of supporting multi-entity distributed simulation.

articleTitle: Tractor steering teleoperation control with fuzzy PID algorithm based on delay time measurement with timestamp
abstract: Because of the labor shortage and aging of population in rural areas, and considering of the technological limitations nowadays, the tele-operational driving robot of human-in-loop is developed to help people to drive a tractor without physical attendance. The time delay control is vital for remote control of tractor steering because of the changeable weather condition and communication channel which leads to communication time delay. Firstly, the timestamp method is utilizing to measure the random time delay to transfer the problem of random time delay control to constant time delay control. Then the PID controller suitable for different time delay is study and the fuzzy controller is using to adjust the control parameters dynamically. Finally, design the experiment to evaluate the position tracking performance of the proposed algorithm which shows that the average and maximum position tracking errors are 10cm and 18cm respectively under the random time delay ranged from 0 to 1000 ms. The results indicate that the tractor steering teleoperation control with the fuzzy PID algorithm based on delay time measurement with timestamp has good tracking performance, strong robustness and important application prospects in intelligent agricultural industry.

articleTitle: A New Scheme of Fault Location for Parallel Double-circuit Transmission Lines
abstract: This paper adopts GPS technology to implement time synchronization, propose a new double-circuit transmission line fault-location scheme . In order to obtain accurate results, the scheme considers the coupling effect between parallel lines and adopts the distribution line model. Based on the transmission line theory, the parameters of the distribution line model are extended by the third-order Taylor series. Determining the fault phases first, and then the healthy phases of the transmission line system can be ignored. The new fault location scheme can locate various types of faults (including evolving faults and cross-country faults), and has been tested in different fault points, different transition resistances, different fault initial angles and different fault types. In addition, the influence of different sampling frequency and parameter errors on the scheme is tested. This scheme avoids the influence of the healthy lines on the calculation of the fault distance and utilize accurate electrical signals, so the results are more excellent. The simulation study using MATLAB software and the max estimation error of fault location does not exceed 0.9056%.

articleTitle: Automatic Test Platform for High-Speed Railway Autonomous Controlling Machine based on Production Re-direction Mechanism
abstract: The Autonomous Controlling Machine module of high-speed railway is in charge of traffic safety control of distributed stations, which is the core module of train dispatching system. With the intellectualization and centralization of dispatching, current semi-automatic test mode of Autonomous Controlling Machine is difficult to meet the demand of accelerated iterative module version. In addition, there are some defects such as low functional coverage and high hardware requirements. Taking full advantage of the existing complete train operation scene and complex production data, on the basis of ensuring the safety of railway operation, a set of automatic simulation test platform for station Autonomous Controlling Machine based on production system but isolated from its one-way data is designed. Through the redirection and reuse of benchmark data, the automation and full coverage of function test can be realized, and the defects of performance test of the whole module can be made up at the same time. The idea of the scheme has been partly applied to the field application, which makes significant improvement in improving the automation and integrity of the test, and also provides the data basis for the subsequent intelligent scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Speed Probability Density and Modeling of Transmission Line Tower
abstract: In the study of meteorological conditions for power line design, wind speed is the key consideration. Gale is one of the most serious natural disasters that cause failure of overhead lines. In this paper, based on the measured method of multi-point synchronous horizontal wind speed in open and flat terrain of 66kV power transmission line, taking the measured wind speed data as the research object, the multi variable empirical mode decomposition method is used to establish the non-stationary wind speed model, and on this basis, the influence of wind speed distribution of transmission line tower pole is discussed. It can be seen from the experiment of modeling and simulation that the wind speed output by the wind speed physical model is closer to the actual wind speed, which provides a guarantee and basis for the analysis of the impact of wind speed probability density of the transmission line.

articleTitle: Trajectory Optimization of Aircraft for A Continuous Descent Continuous Procedure
abstract: In this paper, a Continuous Descent Continuous(CDO) trajectory optimization problem is considered. In this problem, the optimal trajectory of a CDO procedure is designed. First, the CDO trajectory optimization problem is formulated as multiple phase optimal control problems. Then, a trajectory optimization results for a CDO is given based on the pseudo spectral method, which guarantee the delay time costs, noise costs and fuel consumption minimum. Last, Simulations results and analysis are considered to verify effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-objective Gaussian Water Cycle Algorithm in Optimal Power Flow Problems
abstract: In order to surmount the shortcomings of the standard water cycle algorithm in solving the non-convex optimal power flow (OPF) problem, a multi-objective Gaussian water cycle algorithm (MOGWCA) is proposed. Three multi-objective OPF simulation experiments are used to demonstrate the property of the MOGWCA, which improves the global development capability and population diversity through the Gaussian mutation mechanism. Test cases considering fuel cost, emissions, active power loss and voltage deviation are applied on IEEE 30 and IEEE 57 test systems. A large number of outcomes display that the MOGWCA algorithm can get a well-distributed Pareto front (PF) and effectively solve the multi-objective OPF problem.

articleTitle: Research on Complex Robot Manipulation Tasks Based on Hindsight Trust Region Policy Optimization
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms have make remarkable progress in robot manipulation task in recent years. However, the success of completing the task relies heavily on the special design of reward function which requires engineering experience or domain-specific knowledge. To avoid complex reward shaping and make robot learning more general, it's of great essential to study the sparse-reward environments. In this paper, we present two types of challenging goal-conditioned sparse-reward tasks with 7-DoF robot arm, one is a target reaching task with obstacles, and the other is the dynamic object task where the target object moves at a certain speed. Based on the Hindsight Trust Region Policy Optimization (HTRPO) algorithm proposed by our research group, we studied the control performance on the two types of tasks with continuous high-dimensional state space. The results show that HTRPO can achieve more stable strategic performance, higher success rate and sample efficiency compared with its baseline algorithm TRPO and HPG. However, there still remains challenges in solving the tasks with high moving speed.

articleTitle: Fault line selection of distribution networks based on feature matching of power disturbance data
abstract: With the access of distributed power sources and the extensive use of power electronic equipment, faults in distribution networks are becoming more frequent. By researching the current signal when the fault occurs in the distribution network, it can be found that there are great differences between the waveform characteristics of the fault line and the normal line. On this basis, a new method for fault line selection of distribution network based on the feature matching of power disturbance data is proposed, which realizes the fault line selection of distribution network by means of feature extraction, feature database construction and topic search with the power disturbance data provided by power quality monitor. Among them, it is necessary to select the power quality monitor which is easy to be deployed as the data source, so as to solve the problems of insufficient measurement configuration and information island in distribution network and improve the observable ability of power grid. According to the simulation verification of the IEEE 13 node and IEEE 37 node system, the proposed method is not only simple and practical, but also can accurately accurate position the fault without being affected by the factors, such as initial fault angle, fault location, and power grid structure.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on Intelligent Perception of Extraterrestrial Body Surface Based on Deep Learning and Transfer Learning
abstract: It is one of the developing directions of deep space exploration in the future to carry out surface wide patrol detection of extraterrestrial bodies by unmanned or manned means. Whether the unknown complex surface environment can be accurately and efficiently identified is the key problem affecting the detection efficiency. This paper explored the method of obstacle detection on two-dimensional images of the surface of extraterrestrial bodies by deep learning and transfer learning techniques. The main contents of this paper included training data acquisition, neural network model training using transfer learning, and the obstacle detection. The method in this paper had been verified with the ground prototype of "Yutu" rover in the simulated lunar surface test site, and could identify rocks, slopes and other obstacles as well as the test prototype itself, laying a foundation for further research and engineering application in the future.

articleTitle: Accelerometer-based Stroke Length Estimation of Sucker-Rod Pumping System in Smart Field
abstract: In smart field, innovative technologies and advanced equipment are used to reduce operating costs, monitor wells conditions, optimize the production and improve economic performance. Stroke length is an important parameter in oilfield. It reflects the working condition of production wells. Accurate and effective measurement of stroke length imposes great impacts on oil production. In this paper, a novel method to efficiently perform drift-free stroke length estimation of sucker-rod pumping system with acceleration sensors is proposed. This method includes two stages of integration and two stages of filtering. First, an band-pass infinite impulse response filter is applied to eliminate the drift and sensing errors of acceleration data collected by accelerometer. Then, an integration is calculated to derive velocity signal with the filtered data. After that, a high-pass filter is performed to remove the DC offset of the velocity. Finally, a periodic velocity signal is selected to perform integration operation to compute the stroke length. The proposed method is validated against a real dataset from an oilfield. The experimental results illustrate that the proposed method can reduce sensing errors, suppress interference, and improve estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive optimal output regulation for industrial hydrocracking process
abstract: Hydrocracking is an important petrochemical process, in which the reactor temperature determines the final product distribution and quality. In this paper, a new data-driven optimal reactor temperature control method is proposed through the integration of reinforcement learning, adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) and output regulation theory. Different from the existing literature, the reactor temperature control problem is formulated as an output regulation problem, and a policy iteration (PI) based ADP algorithm is employed to find the adaptive optimal controller. The simulation results show that the actual nitrogen content in the stream of R101 outlet can be regulated to the desired value and keep the reaction temperature of each bed in R101 to a minimum while disturbance rejection is achieved.

articleTitle: H-infinite Stability Analysis and Controller Synthesis for Markov Jump System with Pure Time-Delays
abstract: Some H-infinite stability control methods for Markov jump systems with pure time-delays are discussed in this paper, and some theorems are obtained to stabilize the systems with some anti-disturbance performances. Firstly, the system description with some distributed time delays is obtained by using a system transformation. Secondly, according to a positive energy functional and LMI technique, some sufficient conditions are achieved for making sure the system is stable. If those criteria are solvable, some controllers can be gotten to stabilize system and the energy gain from the external disturbance to the system output is constrained to be no larger than a prescribed value. Furthermore, some examples are given to show that the obtained methods are useful.

articleTitle: Attitude Pointing of Overactuated Tilt-Quadrotor Robot Using Camera/IMU
abstract: This paper studies attitude pointing control for an overactuated tilt-quadrotor robots, having a fully actuating input vector due to an 8-DoF (degree of freedom) design: four thrusts and four tilt angles. We shall develop a specific inner-outer-loop nonlinear control algorithm for the problem using the local camera and IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) sensors. Particularly, we show that the outer or position loop and the inner or attitude loop control can be done in a separate manner for a nominal model. Then we can establish a useful mapping between the model control inputs and the actuator inputs by virtue of the overactuation property. We also present the simulation and initial experiment results to validate the proposed design algorithm.

articleTitle: Weighted Fusion Incremental Kalman Estimator for Descriptor Systems under Poor Observation Condition
abstract: Under certain environmental conditions, the unknown system errors often occur and yield to larger filtering errors when the unverified or uncalibrated measurement equation is used. Incremental equation can be introduced, which will effectively solve the problem of state estimation for the systems under poor observation condition. For the linear discrete descriptor systems under poor observation condition, a descriptor incremental Kalman estimation algorithm is firstly presented under the canonical form. It solves the state estimation problem for the descriptor systems with unknown measurement errors, which doesn't meet the requirements of classical Kalman filter. Furthermore, an optimal weighted fusion descriptor incremental Kalman estimator is given based on the linear minimum variance optimal fusion criterion. Compared with the existing augmented dimension-enlarged processing methods, the proposed algorithms are simple in form and small in computational burden so as to be easily applied in engineering practice. A simulation example shows its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Driving Cycle Construction Based on Sorting-Time Hybrid Method
abstract: In order to construct the driving cycle for the classification of road congestion degree, data preprocessing is performed on the driving data of the vehicle, and it is divided into 591 kinematics segments, and the characteristic parameters of each kinematics segment are extracted. Principal component analysis method is used to reduce the dimension of feature parameters, perform k-means clustering analysis, classify kinematics fragments into four categories, and analyze the congestion degree of each category. On the basis of the correlation coefficient method, representative kinematics segments are selected in descending order and time, and four types of driving cycle classified based on the degree of traffic congestion are constructed. Finally, the relative error method is used to verify the rationality of the construction of driving cycle.

articleTitle: A Prediction Method for Ultra Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Basing on Long Short -Term Memory Network and Extreme Learning Machine
abstract: Thigh degree of accuracy towards the prediction of wind power contributes a lot to planning, economic performance and security maintenance. The viewpoint existing in this paper includes a kind of methods for Ultra short-term Wind Power Prediction basing on long short-term memory network and extreme learning machine. In the data preprocessing stage, considering the coupling between wind power and weather, ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) is used to decompose the wind power sequence, and principal component analysis (PCA) is used to remove features that are poorly correlated with wind power prediction. In the prediction stage, the low-frequency component uses the long short-term memory network prediction model. High-frequency feature points is used for extreme learning machine prediction model. Finally, we reconstruct the prediction results.

articleTitle: A master-slave residual network-based classification method for PV panels dust accumulation
abstract: In this paper, considering the idea of the master-slave structure, a new classification method based on master-slave residual network is proposed to classify the degree of dust accumulation on the photovoltaic (PV) panels. Through training the master-slave residual network, the structure parameters of residual network can be determined, such that the proposed classification method can obtain the better classification accuracy for different learning tasks. In order to determine the structure parameters of residual network, four learning algorithms are given to determine the input type, the number of convolution layers, weight learning method and the pooling method, respectively. In order to verify the accuracy of the classification method, an image dataset for different degree of dust accumulation is collected by artificial simulation experiment, and thus, the simulation results show the effectiveness of this proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Energy Window for Combined Power Vehicle
abstract: Aiming at the problem of energy window design in climbing mode switching of combined power vehicle, this paper presents an energy window design method based on parameterized model and effective specific impulse as performance index, and further proposes an energy window optimization design method for parameters of integrated aircraft/engine based on random direction search method, so as to make the engine performance more favorable and provide design basis for trajectory planning at the same time.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of Human-computer Interface for Auxiliary Aircraft Assembly
abstract: In the process of aircraft assembly, many assembly parts are involved, such as cable assembly, riveting hole and so on. How to effectively obtain and manage the information of the assembly process has become an important research issue. Augmented reality technology can superimpose virtual information on the real scene, improve workers' understanding of the assembly scene, and provide a more efficient way of accessing and managing information. Therefore, through the design of wearable AR intelligent glasses-aided aircraft assembly interface, this paper puts forward the design method of augmented reality interface on smart glasses, and evaluates the usability of the interface.

articleTitle: A new design of extended state observer for a class of uncertain nonlinear systems with sampled-data measurement
abstract: To expand the application of extended state observer (ESO) to nonlinear uncertain hybrid systems, the paper proposes a new design of ESO based on sampled-data measurement. To theoretically show the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid ESO, both the stability and convergence of the ESO are investigated. More specifically, the dynamics of the estimating error and the corresponding equilibrium set are analyzed, which provides a mathematical technique to deal with the jumps in hybrid systems. Based on the properties of the equilibrium set of error dynamics, we then prove the stability and convergence of the proposed ESO. More importantly, owing to the explicit stability condition, the tuning law of the observer gain vector is illuminated.

articleTitle: A Novel Interface Device Developed based on MRT for Prosthetic Hand
abstract: This paper proposes a novel interface device for prosthetic hand based on muscle redistribution technique. It is a new type of surgery for persons with forearm amputations and the movement of deep muscle can lead to the deformation of skin. It provides the basis of the novel interface of human and prosthetic hand for avoiding the invading the body. Then interface device is designed that combines the flexible tactile sensor and surface electromyography. The gestures recognition method is proposed integration of two types of sensors. Finally, a residual limb simulation device is designed to prove the effectiveness of the tactile sensor for measuring deformation and the proposed device is applied on the wrist level amputation person. The six actions are selected to test and the experimental results show the superior performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Guidance Control Method for Imaging Air-to-Ground Missiles
abstract: Precise attacking of the vital regions of the threatening targets can be achieved by using the imaging air-to-ground missiles (AGMs), and a guidance control method suitable for the stable control of the imaging AGM is proposed in this paper. Components of the guidance control system are determined on the basis of the guidance property analysis of the imaging seekers, and the calculation method of target pointing is given based on the inertial navigation system (INS). Stable missile body control is realized by fusing tilt stability control, attitude control, height control, gravity compensation control, environmental adoption compensation control, and impact angle constraint control together. Experimental results on real collected data have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Gap metric-based fault detection and fault-tolerant control for uncertain systems
abstract: The fault detection and fault-tolerant control is researched for systems with model uncertainties based on gap metric. Firstly, by the aid of the coprime factorization technique, the mathematical models are established for uncertain systems and systems with multiplicative faults. Secondly, an observer-based control law is employed and the fault detection residual scheme is designed. The necessary condition on successful fault detection is presented with gap metric. Finally, the fault-tolerant controller design method is presented. The effectiveness of the proposed method is illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Command-Filter-Based Adaptive Fixed-Time Fuzzy Control for Strict-Feedback Nonlinear Systems
abstract: This paper studies the problem of adaptive fixedtime fuzzy control for a class of single-input single-output (SISO) nonlinear systems. By combining the fuzzy logic system and fixed-time theory, the adaptive fixed-time fuzzy control approach is developed. Meanwhile, the technology of command-filter is introduced, which can eliminate the issues of "complexity explosion" and "singularity" caused by the derivatives of virtual controllers. Based on the stability theory of fixed-time control, it is proven that the tracking error can converge to a small neighborhood of origin with fixed-time convergence rate, and the boundedness of closed-loop system signals can be guaranteed. Finally, the validity of the designed method is tested based on a simulation example.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Control Strategy for the Consensus of Networked Systems
abstract: The consensus problem is one of the fundamental problems studied in networked systems. In this paper, we first propose the hierarchical control strategy to solve the consensus problem, which is similar to the pyramid structure of human society. In the next step, we analyze the convergence properties of the proposed protocols. Finally, simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and significance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A four-dimensional memristor chaotic system based on Colpitts oscillator
abstract: In this paper, a four-dimensional memristor-based Colpitts oscillator is proposed. The new memristive chaotic circuit is modeled by introducing an exponential nonlinear term of the original system with a generalized memristor model. The memristor has brought a powerful transformative ability to the field of microelectronics. The memristor, a non-linear resistance that can memorize current, will become a very promising storage element in the future with its superior characteristics. Therefore, the Colpitts oscillator based on memristor has a good application prospect under certain conditions. Basic dynamic analyses are performed to analyze the chaotic characteristics. The phase portrait, power spectrum and the Poincare section are analyzed by numerical simulations. the influences of circuit parameters on complex dynamic behaviors are studied by the Lyapunov exponent spectra and bifurcation diagrams. The positive Lyapunov exponent indicates the chaotic state of the proposed system. Finally numerical analysis shows that the proposed system passes the NIST test successfully, which is useful in the field of Secure Communication.

articleTitle: On Strong Stabilization of Linear Difference Equations with Multiple Time Delays
abstract: This paper concentrates on the strong stabilization problem of linear difference equations with multiple time delays. Based on an existing condition in which the coefficients of linear delay equations appear as a linear function, a sufficient condition for the state feedback design is provided in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). The stabilization problem of a class of 2-D Roesser models is also studied, which leads to a sufficient condition for the existence of the state feedback controller. A numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the presented results.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Segmentation Method of 3D Point Cloud Data
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low efficiency and accuracy of traditional 3d point cloud data segmentation algorithm when kinect vision sensor collects human point cloud data, an adaptive segmentation algorithm of human skeleton points combined with direct filtering was proposed. The direct filter image segmentation through the human body skeleton information to calculate the center of the human body coordinates as a benchmark set threshold value range, compared with traditional direct filter different image segmentation need to specify a target segmentation dimensions and domain's shortcomings, in this article, through the human body skeleton data combined with direct filter method can achieve the goal of adaptive segmentation

articleTitle: Research on the Blockchain Derivatives: Based on Time Series of Token Price Risk and Yield
abstract: Aiming at the new lending derivatives in the cryptocurrency market, this paper studies the value fluctuations and risk characteristics of Bitcoin as a basic product through Time Series Analysis and establishment of GARCH models. Based on the linkage between the value of financial derivatives and basic products, this paper analyzes the characteristics of cryptocurrency lending derivatives. The results show that Bitcoin yield has peak fat-tail characteristic and volatility clustering characteristic. Bitcoin has higher risk and leverage than traditional financial products. Investors have a higher response to the falling yields that have a greater impact on the market. As a cryptocurrency, Bitcoin has risk-compensating characteristics, and its price fluctuations last a long time. The results of this paper provide an important reference for the establishment of risk management mechanism and related policy regulations in the cryptocurrency market, and also provide risk warnings to market participants.

articleTitle: Research on Suspension Control Strategy Based on Adaptive RBF Neural Network for MVAWT
abstract: In order to improve the anti-disturbance ability of the maglev vertical axis wind turbine (MVAWT), a suspension control strategy based on the adaptive radial basis function neural network (ARBFNN) is proposed. Considering the complexity and inaccuracy of the modeling, RBFNN is utilized to estimate the uncertain nonlinear disturbance due to its advantage of infinite precision approximation, and the update law of the network weights is obtained based on the adaptive control theory. Finally, the simulation experiments using the proposed ARBFNN suspension control strategy and the traditional PID control strategy are carried out respectively for comparison. After comparative analysis, it can be seen that the proposed control strategy has online real-time control function, it can effectively improve the control performance of the maglev system of MVAWT and can guarantee the stable operation of the suspension process.

articleTitle: Voltage Control Method of PV Grid-Connected DC Bus based on Tracking Differentiator
abstract: In the photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected power generation system, when the output power of the PV panel changes suddenly, the voltage fluctuation amplitude of the bus on the DC side is large. If the control is improper, the normal operation of the system will be directly affected. In order to improve the control performance of bus voltage effectively, this paper proposes a DC bus voltage control method based on tracking differentiator (TD). Compared with the traditional double-closed-loop PI control, this method can improve the dynamic response performance of the system without adding additional sensors and effectively suppress the noise in the signal. In this paper, the traditional PI controller and the PID controller based on tracking differentiator are simulated respectively. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of XML Schema Based Information System
abstract: The collection, editing and processing of all kinds of equipment data is the core of all kinds of weapon equipment integrated support information system. Traditional information processing systems are less scalable, stable, and reliable. This paper proposes an XML Schema based information processing system, which stores the result into XML format which is produced by processing the collected data. Firstly, the system is designed with loosely coupled design mode, which is divided into model transformation module, configuration file generation module, data editing module and data validation module. Secondly, the functions of each module of the system are defined in detail. Finally, each functional module is implemented to obtain an XML Schema information system. The verification results of the system show that the system can process various types of equipment data, and is available, reliable and stable.

articleTitle: A Optimized NURBS Curve Trajectory Planning Algorithm Based on Genetic Algorithm
abstract: This article mainly designs a trajectory planning algorithm for DELTA parallel robots. This algorithm is a timeoptimal trajectory planning algorithm. The space trajectory is based on the NURBS Curves, that is, the curve equation is calculated after wo know the positions which the robot pass through in the space. Then use the genetic optimization algorithm to optimize the curve, get the optimized curve and then discretize the curve for interpolation calculation. At last we use the V-rep simulation software to simulate the algorithm, the similarity between the simulation trajectory and the calculation trajectory is very well, and the experiment proves that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-VOCs Detecting System Based on multidimensional-GC
abstract: In this study, we utilized microelectromechanical system (MEMS) processing technology to design and fabricate a micro gas chromatographic (GC) column. Based on the characteristics of separated volatile organic compounds (VOCs) we selected CB-40 (40% phenyl group + 60% polydimethylsiloxane) to fix the chromatographic column and fabricated a capillary-type micro column as the primary separation column. By selecting the same stationary phase of padding as same as Silica Bond Plot, we fabricated a micro filling chromatographic column as the secondary separation column. Moreover, typical VOC gas mixtures, including hydrogen sulfide, methyl mercaptan, carbon disulfide, dimethyl sulfide, benzene, methylbenzene, ethylbenzene, xylene and styrene, were adopted to be separated and detected, Finally, by designing a combination of sample feeding acquisition modules and control heating modules as well as adopting a self-fabricated micro-channel preconcentrator and a photoionization detector with high sensitivity and small volume, the detection precision was improved considerably. The limit of detection (LOD) of benzene and hydrogen sulfide can reach 50 parts per thousand (ppt).

articleTitle: A Map and Trajectory Merging Method of Overlapping Area for Multiple Mars Rovers
abstract: The exploration of Martian surface covers a large area. The exploration capability and range of a single Mars rover is limited, which can be improved by using multiple Mars rovers. The key technologies to realize the exploration of multiple Mars rovers are map merging and trajectory merging, including similar area searching, overlapping area merging and optimization of Mars rover and feature points. Therefore, a map and trajectory merging method of overlapping area for multiple Mars rovers is presented in this paper. Considering the sparsity of image descriptor, the similarity scoring function based on L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> norm is established. And then threshold suppression algorithm is used to select the similar images and eliminate the low similarity images. Meanwhile the consecutive sequence of similar images is selected as overlapping area. The pose transformation relationship of two Mars rovers in overlapping area can be solved, which is used as the initial value of optimization of Mars rover pose and 3D point cloud. Finally, the map and trajectory merging result is obtained. The simulation results and ground tests show that the merging method presented in this paper can quickly search overlapping area. The merging result of map and trajectory has a high accuracy.

articleTitle: A combat evaluation method based on index rules
abstract: Although the existing combat evaluation technology can support the definition and evaluation of the index system by users to a certain extent, it cannot clearly explain the characteristics of the index. The hierarchical relationship and the inclusion relationship among the index items, and the setting and use of weight values are not dear. It is so difficult for users to understand and use that this paper proposes a combat evaluation method based on index rules. Through the establishment of data standards for the internal structure of the evaluation index system, different evaluation needs have been met. We also provide a graphical index system construction environment, so that users can dearly set the relationship between indicators and indicator preference, and improve the accuracy and effectiveness of the definition of the evaluation index system. The example of aircraft flight performance evaluation index system deeply proved this method.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Integrated Energy System Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) combining multi energies such as power, heat, cooling and gas, can be applied to improve the overall energy efficiency based on the energy cascade utilization. In order to enhance the operation efficiency of IES, an operation optimization method is proposed in this paper based on deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG). Two categories of models of linear ones and nonlinear ones are established, then a nonlinear optimization model is constructed by taking the annual operating cost as the objective. With regard to the instability in its training process of DDPG, two improved strategies of scaled initial state spaces and dynamic noise compensation are presented. In the case study, the proposed method is employed to obtain the optimal operation strategies for a typical scenario of a practical IES. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed one not only obtains the most economical strategies, but also exhibits the robustness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: New High-frequency Isolated Quasi-Z-source Inverter
abstract: In order to make up for the shortcomings of traditional Z-source and quasi-Z-source inverter, such as weak boosting capacity, large capacitor voltage stress, and electrical isolation on the input and output sides, this paper proposes a new high-frequency isolated quasi-Z-source inverter circuit topology. The inverter replaces the inductor in series with the power supply with a set of boost units on the basis of the traditional quasi-Z-source inverter, and replaces another inductor with an isolated transformer. The working principle and control principle of the inverter are introduced in detail and a simulation model is built under the simulation environment of Matlab/Simulink. The results show that the proposed inverter can greatly improve the boosting capacity.

articleTitle: An Optimized Back Propagation Neural Network Based on Genetic Algorithm for Line Loss Calculation in Low-voltage Distribution Grid
abstract: A calculation model of the theoretical line loss rate of smart distribution network in the low-voltage substation area was devised. Based on the back propagation neural network, the model was optimized by the genetic algorithm (GA-BP model). The model took the active and reactive power of each power supply area as the input and the theoretical line loss rate as the output. The results showed that the genetic algorithm had achieved the best fitness after 92 iterations, and the R-squared of all training data was R=0.99916; after calculated the test samples, the maximum absolute error was 0.14% of GA-BP model, which was 0.61% less than that of the BP model; the mean absolute error was 0.055%, which was 0.273% less than that of BP model. In general, the GA-BP model has a better non-linear fitting ability and higher accuracy of calculating the theoretical line loss rate in the low-voltage distribution area.

articleTitle: Model predictive control of bidirectional DC/DC converters for hydrogen fuel cell vehicles
abstract: In order to improve the response speed and reliability of the bidirectional DC/DC converter in hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, extend the life of the hydrogen fuel cell, and thereby improve the performance of hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, this paper applies model predictive control (MPC) to hydrogen fuel cell vehicles in control with a bidirectional DC/DC converter. First, establish a state-space average model for the converter, and then linearize the model near the stable point to obtain a suitable prediction model. According to the state quantity and input quantity, select a suitable objective function to ensure that the converter has a faster response process. Response speed and small voltage overshoot. Finally, through simulation verification, the model predictive control has achieved the expected effect in the control of the bidirectional DC/DC converter.

articleTitle: Research on Interference Identification and Compensation Method of Periodic Rotating Payload of Satellite
abstract: When a satellite equipped with large angular momentum rotational payload is in orbit for a long time, the angular momentum generated by the detection head of the rotational payload is mainly compensated by the attitude and orbit control system, the rotation characteristic will directly affect the satellite attitude stability. When the rotation characteristic of the detection head deviates greatly from the design index, it will affect the attitude stability of the satellite and cause the attitude of the satellite to be unstable. Based on the analysis of on-orbit data, in order to suppress the rotation characteristics of the payload detection head, the paper designed a method for feedforward compensation using reaction wheel. Finally, through on-orbit tests and data analysis, the validity and practicability of the design algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: A Method of Human Interaction based Semi-automatic Counting for Digital Microscope Image of Spore
abstract: The sporulation of plant pathogens is an essential index for epidemic prediction. Counting is a necessary and vital step for sporulation computation. However, it is still a challenge to achieve efficient and accurate counting under the view of a microscope. The traditional manual exam is costly and time-consuming. The most automatic counting program is fast, but most of them may have poor performance when the digital images are noisy due to some particles, such as agar block, mycelium, floating in the suspension of sporangia. Here, we proposed a method of human interaction based semi-automatic counting for digital microscope images of spore. The scheme includes the components of image input detection, image preprocessing, Hough transform-based automatic spore counting, and human interaction based rectification. Mainly, considering the complex background of the spore microscope image caused by impurities in sporangium suspension, the accuracy of spore detection is low when only using simple automatic counting, we added a human rectification step after the automatic counting into the new scheme. To verify the efficiency and performance of the proposed interactive spore counting method, we randomly selected 20 microscope images of spore in the experiments. The results show that the average accuracy of the spore number is 0.9031 by only using the automatic counting of our scheme. Furthermore, all spores are correctly rectified and counted when semi-automatic human interaction is applied. To explore the improvement of efficiency, we compared the time consumption of manual, automatic, and semi-automatic counting methods. The average time consumption of a single image process is 30.78s, which has over 60% time reducing compare with the 104.9s of manual examination. Our proposed method is slower than the automatic process but far faster than the manual process, and it can ensure the examiner gets satisfying results.

articleTitle: Distributed Large Signal Stabilization for Autonomous DC Microgrids Feeding Constant Power Loads
abstract: In this paper, a composite control method is proposed to solve the voltage instability of nonlinear systems in distributed DC microgrids (MGs). The electrical coupling of each distributed generators (DGs) and the load uncertainties are considered as a lumped disturbance in each subsystem. It can be effectively estimated by the nonlinear disturbance observer (NDO). Then, a domination controller is designed for stabilizing DC/DC boost converter feeding constant power loads (CPLs). The proposed controller can guarantee fast voltage convergence in the sense of large signal stability. Moreover, by a consensus algorithm, the internal voltage state of DGs can be dynamically updated, and the voltage deviation caused by the droop control can be compensated in secondary layer. Therefore, a distributed microgrid (MG) model is established by simulation. A variety of conditions are conducted in order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed distributed large signal stabilization algorithm.

articleTitle: Control System Design for Tiltable Quad-rotor with Propeller Failure
abstract: The traditional quad-rotor UAV is an under-driven system, and it is difficult to ensure stability when the actuator fails. In this paper, a new mechanical structure is adopted on the traditional quad-rotor to enable the rotors to tilt around the arm that the 4 additional actuated dofs are added and the full controllability over the quad-rotor attitude is obtained. The dynamics and kinematics models of the quad-rotor with the new structure are established and be linearized at a given equilibrium point. Based on the linearization model, the controller based on the linearized feedback method is designed to stabilize the system when the two opposing propellers failed. Numerical simulation and a quad-rotor prototype experiment are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed new mechanical structure and control algorithm.

articleTitle: Modeling of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Based on LSTM Neural Network
abstract: The proton exchange membrane fuel cell(PEMFC) is a complex nonlinear dynamic system coupled with multiple physical fields. To analyze the external characteristics of the fuel cell system, it is regarded as a black box and the neural network structure is used to identify the fuel cell model. This paper uses long and short-term memory(LSTM) neural network to model the PEMFC system, the model’s input is the cell current, and the model’s output is the cell voltage. First, fit the PEMFC voltage and current characteristic curve under certain operation conditions according to the empirical formula, and train the LSTM neural network through the data obtained above, then continuously optimize the relevant parameters of the LSTM neural network to make the LSTM neural network model output and experience after the training is completed the formula fitting output is the same, and the result shows that the LSTM neural network model can effectively reflect the output characteristics of PEMFC.

articleTitle: Inscription Detection and Style Identification in Chinese Painting
abstract: Chinese painting has a long history and enjoy a widespread reputation, the inscription plays an important role in the process of authenticating Chinese paintings, which includes the personal style. Previous approaches for scene text detection pursued the high accuracy based on the deep learning, but they rarely used calligraphy and painting works as the recognition target. It's necessary for us to adopt new methods because calligraphy and painting have their particularities. In our work, we use the deep neural network model to extract the inscription of the paintings, and combines the characteristics of Chinese paintings to improve it. In the established data set, the model has achieved a high accuracy of 89%. Furthermore, the existing models focus on the recognition of the detection area, but style identification of the detecting area is our research focus. We use the style loss function to compared different painter's style, and prove that the model has a promising performance for distinguishing styles. Our work not only meets the classification requirements for calligraphy and painting works, but also provides technical support for the identification.

articleTitle: Model predictive control of magneto-rheological damper semi-active suspension with preview
abstract: In this paper, the control problem of semi-active suspension is formulated as the disturbance attenuation problem with hard constraints. The vehicle body vertical acceleration, the suspension dynamic displacement and the tire dynamic deflection are selected as the constraint outputs. The hierarchial control method is adopted. The first-layer controller is designed by the road preview model predictive control (MPC) strategy which can optimize the performance of control system while meeting constraints dynamically. The disturbance can be known with the road preview. The second-layer controller can overcome the strong nonlinear characteristics of magneto-rheological damper by a neural network model. Simulation experiments show that the semi-active suspension with the road preview model predictive control strategy can improve ride comfort while meeting the output constraints compared with related passive suspension.

articleTitle: Research on Optimized M-estimate Arithmetic in INS/USBL Integrated Navigation System
abstract: This paper presents a method in order to promote the robustness of INS(Inertial Navigation System) / USBL(Ultra-short Baseline Positioning System) Integrated Navigation System applied to the AUV under the influence of non- Gaussian observationnoise outliers, especially mixed Gaussian. The main purpose of the paper is divided in to two parts: 1) reconstructing the pseudo-observation based on coordinate transformation. Combined with the position error and attitude error information provided by SINS in real time, the observation equation is established. 2) in view of the outliers of observationnoise when the interference appeared through sound wave propagation, multipath effect and other conditions in poor underwater environment. Analyze the feasibility of eliminating outliers in M-estimation, an Optimized generalized maximum likelihood estimation (OM- estimation) arithmetic is proposed to solve the heavy-tailed (impulsive) observationnoise outliers. The simulation results show the OM-estimation filter arithmetic has a better performance to ameliorate the robustness for the INS/USBL with the observationnoise outliers obeyed non- Gaussian, especially mixed Gaussian.

articleTitle: A Novel Low-Illumination Image Enhancement Method Based on Dual-Channel Prior
abstract: Low-illumination image enhancement is the important part of computer vision research, and defogging model is widely applied to image enhancement. However, there are still some problems in this model, such as the different depth of field of the window segmentation and blurring of edge details. In this paper, we propose a novel low-illumination image enhancement method based on dual-channel prior. First, the low-illumination image is divided into regions with the same depth of field in the local window using the superpixel segmentation method. Then the bright and dark channels of the image are obtained through the maximum/minimum filtering, and after the bright channel is introduced, the adaptive threshold method is used to obtain the atmospheric light value. The initial transmission rate is obtained by combining the dual-channel image with pixel-level image fusion and determining the optimal combination coefficient for mutual correction. The light map with clearer texture and brightness information is used as the guide map for multi-scale gradient domain guided filtering to refine the transmittance. Finally fast BM3D removes noise and obtains the final enhanced image. Experimental results prove that the method proposed in this paper has improved in removing halo artifacts and restoring detailed information.

articleTitle: On-line Upgrade Method of DSP Program Based on Controller Area Network Bus
abstract: The traditional online upgrade of the digital signal processor (DSP) program is realized through the serial communication interface (SCI) or the serial peripheral interface (SPI), it needs to solidify the pin level. When the upgrade is repeated, it must be powered off and restarted, which is difficult to meet all application scenarios. In view of this situation, a new method to upgrade DSP program online by using controller area network (CAN) bus is proposed. By pre-programming the boot program and adding a jump function, the upper computer can send binary file to update application program repeatedly. Experiments show that this method is simple, anti-interference and fast programming, which greatly improves the maintenance efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Ultra-wideband Signal Detection Method Based on Improved Stochastic Resonance
abstract: In order to improve the detection performance of ultra-wideband signals and obtain a higher detection signal-to-noise ratio, based on the traditional bistable stochastic resonance model, an improved stochastic resonance method is proposed to detect, analyze and compare pulse-modulated ultra-wideband signals. The simulation experiment proves that the improved stochastic resonance method has obvious effect on ultra-wideband signal detection, and is superior to traditional algorithms in terms of signal-to-noise ratio and cross-correlation coefficient.

articleTitle: A Monte Carlo and Kernel Density Estimation based virtual sample generation method for small data modeling problem
abstract: In early industrial production, due to the limited resources, enterprises need to use the limited data to analyze the production status and product quality in order to reduce the waste of resources and funds. This requires building a model with high accuracy. Due to the small amount of data, the accuracy of the model based on small samples is low. The technology of generating virtual sample is often used, according to the information interval between sample data to fill in it with an effective way to expand the amount of sample data. A novel kernel density estimation based on distribution with sample output variables is proposed. Monte Carlo sampling is used to fill the gap between sample distribution and realize the uniform distribution of samples. Combined with Bagging-RBF neural network and bat algorithm (BA), effective virtual samples are generated. Two experiments, MLCC and PTA, show that the virtual samples are more effective.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Current Control with Variable Control Period for PMSM
abstract: To reduce the switching loss and prolong the service life of the switch, the investigate on the control policy of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with low switching frequency has become a topical issues.Under the condition of low switching frequency, the operation performance of PMSM has some defects, such as high current harmonic ratio, large current waveform distortion and large output torque ripple, which cannot meet the requirements of industrial application.Aiming at the above problems, a model predictive current control (MPCC) method with variable control period (VCP) for PMSM is proposed.In this method, a link of steadystate performance judgment (SSPJ) is designed, and a variable pulse width modulation (VPWM) is applied to realize that the system control period can be adjusted with the steady-state performance.Simulation results demonstrate that, the proposed MPCC method with VCP compared with the conventional MPCC method with constant control period (CCP) reduces current harmonic distortion and torque ripple, and improves the steadystate performance of the system under equal low switching frequency.

articleTitle: Self-healing Control Method in Abnormal State of Distribution Network
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of the power grid, this paper proposes a self-healing control method based on the multi-agent self-healing control system framework under the abnormal state of the distribution network. The risk assessment of the equipment failure of the distribution network is carried out, and the self-healing control optimization scheme for the abnormal state of the distribution network is determined. This method can not only consider the faults with low equipment failure rate and serious fault consequences, but also consider the faults with high equipment failure rate and low fault consequences. Compared with traditional distribution network evaluation methods, the results obtained by proposed method are more precise. Through the analysis of a case study on the distribution network in Shenyang, an optimization plan about self-healing control with the goal of reducing equipment failure rate is presented, optimizing the equipment with a high failure rate in the distribution network, and preventing distribution network faults through active defense. The occurrence of above mentioned ensures the safe and stable power supply for users.

articleTitle: Handwritten Digital Recognition Optimization Method based on Deep Learning
abstract: At present, human handwritten digital recognition has become a research hotspot. For the MNIST dataset widely used in the field of handwriting recognition, based on the TensorFlow framework in deep learning, the Softmax model and the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model are introduced, and the activation function of the CNN model is analyzed. The ReLU function is selected to replace the traditional Sigmoid function and Tanh hyperbolic tangent function to improve the convergence speed in the recognition process. In order to prevent too many parameters from overfitting, Dropout regularization is added. In addition, the above two models are implemented to compare the recognition accuracy of the models, and the optimized CNN model has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: An Instance Segmentation Algorithm Based on Improved Mask R-CNN
abstract: Mask R-CNN has a high application value in the field of computer vision. However, the Mask R-CNN algorithm has the disadvantages of poor edge segmentation due to the blurred bounding box of the target image and poor segmentation of small targets, which greatly limits its wide application. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a multi-scale RPN(Region Proposal Network) network structure and adopts KL loss. By building the Tensorflow deep learning framework in the Ubuntu16.04 operating system, the improved algorithm was tested in the MS-COCO data set and the autonomous driving data set Cityscapes which verifies its applicability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Formation Control with Obstacle Avoidance via Complex Laplacian
abstract: This article handles the obstacle avoidance problem of formation using the complex Laplacian. We assume that only two agents named leaders can obtain information from the target due to the particularity of formation control via complex Laplacian. A strategy is proposed to handle the problem of obstacle avoidance, this control strategy consists of three parts: formation control, track control and obstacle avoidance. The formation is completed by complex Laplacian in which the final formation is determined by the two leaders with consistent speed. However, the speed of the leaders will definitely be affected by obstacles. we choose a target curve for leaders to track so that they can eventually reach the same velocity after avoiding obstacles. The problem of obstacle avoidance is completed by the artificial potential field (APF) method. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of multi-agent obstacle avoidance and formation under the proposed control protocol.

articleTitle: A universal numerical control system solution based on high speed network
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex technology, difficult development and cumbersome application for traditional numerical control systems. In this paper, a universal numerical control system solution based on high speed network is proposed. According to the functional requirements of the numerical control system, the logical structure design is established with the idea of modularization. The control function of the system is completed by the controller and the ring network servo. Each axis function is realized independently in the corresponding ring network servo, which reduces the coupling of the system and the CPU utilization of the controller. The number of axes is determined by actuator, and the processing method is determined by motion model. Axis and axis realize cooperative motion through Ethernet, which improves the communication rate of system. The system completes numerical control machining through G code. Other control functions required by the system are implemented in the controller. The control program is realized through graphical programming technology to simplify the difficulty of system development. Meanwhile, the control functions are divided into two parts: the single-axis control program and the axis group control program, which is convenient for the expansion of the control system function. The monitoring program is developed by man-machine interface configuration method, which is convenient for operators without programming basis to operate and modify. Finally, use engraving machine as actuator to complete the development and verification of system.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Modeling of a High Temperature Steam Heat Pump
abstract: In order to improve industrial energy efficiency, a high temperature heat pump using R245fa as refrigerant is investigated in this artical. The system model contains two cycles, i.e., vapor compression cycle and steam generation cycle. Seven sub-models representing two condensers, evaporator, flash tank, scroll compressor, water injected screw compressor and two thermal expansion valves (TEV) are included in this system. A moving boundary (MB) approach based on mass and energy balance principles is implemented for the heat-exchangers and flash evaporation dynamic models, while the compressors and TEVs adopt steady models because of their much smaller thermal inertia compared with the heat-exchangers. The system has three control variables, including the valve opening, scroll compressor operation frequency and rotation speed of screw compressor. Steady state performance of the system is first analyzed and then the dynamic characteristics of the system are simulated and analyzed in order to better control it.

articleTitle: Event-Trigger Extended Set-Membership Filter for Power Distribution Network Dynamic State Estimation
abstract: The dynamic state estimation of power distribution networks (PDNs) requires real-time accurate information provided by phasor measurement unit (PMU). However, the lots of data generated by PMU bring heavy burden to the limited communication bandwidth of PDNs, resulting in packet loss and communication delay, which reduce the accuracy of state estimation. This paper proposes an event-trigger extended set-membership filter (ET-ESMF) to solve these problems. An event-trigger strategy is established at first in which the measurement is transmitted to remote estimation center for the purpose of filtering only when the triggering condition is satisfied. By fully considering the unknown but bounded (UBB) noise and the nonlinearity of PDNs, an ET-ESMF algorithm is further proposed to enhance the performance of estimation. Finally, its feasibility and performance are demonstrated using the standard IEEE 33-bus system with PMUs.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for Attitude Sensors Based on Analytical Redundancy and Wavelet Transform
abstract: This paper presents a sensor fault diagnosis method for the satellite attitude determination system based on analytical redundancy and wavelet transform. Specifically, we design a full-order observer to achieve fault detection. After the fault is detected, wavelet transform is used to isolate the fault sensors. Moreover, the gyroscope faults are estimated by using the algebraic observability. The proposed fault diagnosis approach combines the analytical redundancy-based method and the signal processing technique, its major benefit is that the computational burden is effectively reduced by introducing the fault detection method based on the analytical redundancy. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Driving force allocation strategy of multi-cylinder hydraulic press machine considering operation phases
abstract: In order to improve the control accuracy of the multi-cylinder hydraulic press machine (MCHPM), a mathematical model considering the characteristics of MCHPM is established in this paper. A design method of MCHPM optimization controller considering the characteristics of different operation phases is proposed.
