Finally, a computation offloading based on dynamic programming (COBDP) algorithm is developed to find the optimal strategy. According to the simulation results, the COBDP algorithm can achieve better performance in terms of users’ energy cost.

articleTitle: Model predictive control of multi-terminal VSC-HVDC offshore wind power system
abstract: In order to enhance the operating performance of the multi-terminal HVDC system. A model predictive direct power control suitable for multi-terminal HVDC system is designed. Model predictive control (MPC) algorithm is used to replace the traditional PI controller in the inner power loop, the error of active power and reactive power is taken as the input of model predictive controller , at the same time, the internal model feedback correction link is introduced to correct the predicted set value of the power in each sampling period , so the high-precision tracking of instantaneous power is realized .This method does not need AC voltage sensor, cost savings, improved reliability,the active power and reactive power are compensated, the voltage fluctuation is reduced. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by establishing a three terminal HVDC flexible DC system in MATLAB/ SIMULINK.

articleTitle: UAV multi-dynamic target points path planning with obstacles based on SOM-DAPF
abstract: In this paper, the unmanned aerial velhicle (UAV) path planning problem with obstacles is disscussed for an air-ground collaborative system which is composed of a messenger UAV and multiple unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). The messenger UAV needs to visit each UGV to collect and share information. The aim of this problem is to achieve a shortest path which makes the UAV fly over all UGVs while avoiding obstacles. By the Dubins model, the path planning problem is formulated as a Dynamic Dubins Traveling Salesman Problem with Neighborhood (DDTSPN) under obstacle constraints. To adapt to the change of UGVs' locations and reduce the complexity of tuning global path for obstacle avoidance, a moving horizon optimization strategy is porposed. After the UAV visits a UGV, the rest of UGVs' access sequence and access locations are determined using SOM method according to the real-time locations of UGVs. Further, the DAPF algorithm is presented to replan the path which enters the obstacle regions. Simulation results show the advantages of the proposed path planning algorithm.

articleTitle: Gibbs Parameter Sampling Algorithm Based on Finite Mixture Model of Random Point Pattern
abstract: A parameter sampling algorithm for finite mixture model of random point pattern by using the Gibbs sampling is proposed. First, the random finite set theory is used to construct finite mixture model of random point pattern. Secondly, using Gibbs sampling algorithm to estimate the parameters of mixture model. Finally, using BIC criterion to judge the effect of algorithm model fitting real data. In the simulations Gaussian mixture distribution is used as the characteristic distribution of random point pattern, several groups of random point pattern distribution are considered and compared with the traditional finite mixed model algorithm. The results show that the RPPFMM algorithm proposed in this paper is more accurate than the traditional FMM algorithm.

articleTitle: Prediction model of the NOx emissions based on long short-time memory neural network
abstract: In this paper, the combustion process parameters of 330MW coal-fired boiler are taken as the research object. In view of the massive system data of thermal power plant, the multivariable mutual characteristics of the coal-fired boiler and the DCS stores a dynamic, high-dimensional and massive time series data. Time series forecasting method is introduced into NOx forecasting of thermal power plant in this paper. And a NOx emission forecasting model based on long short-time memory neural network is designed by using deep learning method. The research results show that LSTM can deal with NOx emissions of thermal power units very well.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Situation Awareness Approach for CBTC Systems based on Multi-dimensional Gaussian Hidden Markov Model
abstract: Communication-based train control (CBTC) is the main method of railway signaling systems applying wireless communication to improve capacity by realizing the moving block. Due to the large adoption of Commercial Off-The-Shelf and the multiple interconnections with other service systems of railways, CBTC systems are facing increasing and severe information security challenges. However, there have been few studies highlighting the situation awareness of CBTC systems. This paper is intended to achieve the information security situation of CBTC systems quantitatively based on mass audit data, where the four dynamic features are both considered with the Gaussian Hidden Markov Model, the dynamic performance of critical equipment of CBTC systems is described. Baum-Welch algorithm is applied to obtain the optimal parameter of the model. Then, the forward algorithm is adopted to determine the probability distribution of hidden states. Moreover, we develop a method for an integrated SA value of CBTC systems based on entropy weight. The simulation results show the availability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mission Supervisor Design for Null-space-based Behavioral Control System: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
abstract: In this paper, the intelligent mission supervisor for null-space-based behavioral control (NS- BC) is developed. A novel reinforcement learning (RL) based approach is proposed to overcome the lack ability of the mission priority adjustment in the classic NS- BC methodologies. The traditional mission supervisor design of NSBC rely on human's ability to determine every individual mission's priority in advance. By elaborately combining the NSBC concept and the Deep Q Network (DQN) method, we develops a new mission management approach which can adjust the agent's behavior priorities dynamically. This approach is implemented without manual design rules and avoiding online calculations after offline training. In order to achieve better learning effect and faster network convergence performance, the experience replay and network structure are optimized by applying priority replay and dueling structure, respectively. Finally, simulation results show that the proposed reinforcement learning mission supervisor (RLMS) can provide better mission priority adjustment performance than the traditional mission supervisor using a much lower sampling frequency and much fewer numbers of dynamic mission priority adjustment.

articleTitle: Improved Particle Swarm Optimization-based GRU Networks for Short-time Traffic Flow Prediction
abstract: Short time traffic flow forecasting is the heart of matter in intelligent transportation system (ITS). Accurate traffic flow prediction can help people to choose trip mode and trip time. Although gated recurrent unit (GRU) has outstanding performance in traffic flow forecasting, but determines the hyperparameters of the GRU rely by experience reduces the predictive effect of the model. This study uses the adaptive learning strategy improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm to optimize the hyperparameters of GRU model. The characteristics of traffic data with network topology are matched by this algorithm, so the accuracy of traffic flow prediction can be improved. To verify the reliability of this algorithm, this study construct IPSO-GRU model by the traffic flow data from California department of transportation and compare IPSO-GRU model with other traffic flow forecasting models. The experimental results shows that, the IPSO-GRU model achieves the lowest mean square error (MSE), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) compared to conventional GRU model.

articleTitle: A Novel Data-Driven Control Method for Shape Memory Alloy Actuated Robot Joint
abstract: For robot joints actuated by Shape Memory Alloy (SMA), the traditional control methods need to establish a complex mechanism model of the plant and need to re-model when replacing the controlled plant. A novel and improved method based on Data-Driven Control (DDC) is proposed to control the robot joint driven by SMA. The proposed method is a pure online data-driven control method since the controller is independent of the model of the controlled plant, and the idea of speed tracking is introduced into the control criterion function of the DDC prototype. The stability of the proposed method is guaranteed by rigorous theoretical analysis, and the effectiveness is evaluated on simulation examples and SMA-driven wrist control experiments. The result of experiments shows that, compared with traditional DDC, the proposed method has a lower steady-state system error and faster system response speed.

articleTitle: UAV Path Planning Based on The Fusion Algorithm of Genetic and Improved Ant Colony
abstract: A track planning method for UAV based on the fusion algorithm(GIACO) of genetic algorithm(GA) and improved ant colony algorithm (IACO) is introduced. The optimal solution that obtained by GA initializes the pheromone matrix of ant colony to improve the convergence speed. To save from a trouble of local extremum, the state transition rule of ant colony algorithm is changed and the feasible potential number of grids is considered. The method of smoothing the path uses the gradient descent. And the step size can be adjusted for evading sudden threats. Simulation experiment analysis results show that the fusion algorithm can not only evade threat safely, but also plan the trajectory quickly, safely and effectively.

articleTitle: Modeling and Trajectory Generation of Bird-like Flapping-wing Micro Air Vehicle
abstract: Based on the modeling of bird-like flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle (FWMAV), this paper makes detailed analysis of the trajectory generation of FWMAV, and gives the parameter calculation under different constraint conditions. Firstly, the kinematics and dynamics model of bird-like FWMAV that considered aerodynamic force caused by flapping wings and tail wing are built. After that, a smooth trajectory incorporating with the initial constraints is proposed. The algorithm can satisfy the kinematics characteristic of FWMAV, which can make the bird-like FWMAV achieve to a target circular trajectory smoothly for hovering motion from any start point. Then PD controllers are used to track the trajectory in 3D space. At last, simulation results are carried out to prove the rationality of the model and trajectory.

articleTitle: Attentional Dilated Convolution Neural Network for Nuclei Segmentation in Histopathology Images
abstract: The foundational task of pathological diagnosis is to accurately segment the nuclei in pathology images. Deep learning has become a well-validated method of nuclei segmentation, but the touching or overlapping nuclei are difficult to segment. In this research, we bring forward a new strategy for nuclei segmentation. The channel attention module is utilized for reweighting channel-wise features and further improving segmentation performance. Moreover, dilated convolution is used for collecting multi-scale contextual information and preserving original resolution. We name our method as Attentional Dilated Convolution Neural Network (ACDNN). Experiments on a large tissue image dataset show that our strategy is superior to other advanced methods.

articleTitle: Design of Active-Passive Composite Vibration Isolation System of Magnetic Levitation and Spring Based on Fuzzy PID Control
abstract: External vibration is a major problem affecting the use of precision instruments. In order to solve this problem, based on mechanical passive vibration isolation, this paper designs an active-passive composite vibration isolation model of magnetic suspension and spring with active magnetic suspension control technology, and proposes a differential position-current double closed-loop fuzzy PID vibration isolation control strategy. Then, the control law of the maglev -spring system is brought into the nonlinear model under different excitation conditions, and the experimental results are obtained. Finally, the experimental results show that the designed active-passive composite vibration isolation control technology can effectively attenuate the external vibration, indicating that the design scheme is reasonable and feasible.

articleTitle: Actuator fault detection and isolation for multi-agent systems by an observer approach
abstract: This note addresses actuator fault detection and isolation of multi-agent systems. A general actuator fault model is presented beforehand. Via the constructed virtual model, observer at each agent can be designed utilizing relative output information with neighbours. We then propose a fault detection and isolation algorithm by the generated residuals and a threshold logic. A numerical simulation is proposed to illustrate validity of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Current Sharing Control of Non-isolated High Power Modular Bi-directional DC/DC Converter for HVDC-Flexible System in Offshore Wind Farm
abstract: The flexible HVDC power transmission system (HVDC-Flexible) will be a kind of important power transmission modes for offshore wind farms in the future. In this paper, a novel multi-terminal HVDC-Flexible power transmission system for offshore wind farms is introduced, and its DC grid side converter (GSC) is mainly studied. In order to achieve high power and high gain, GSC adopts the topology structure of non-isolated cascaded DC/DC converter modules in parallel. The causes of currents imbalance in the parallel topology structure are analyzed based on the mathematical modeling of GSC, and the current-sharing control strategy which is independent of the parameters of the devices in the modules is proposed. Finally, the simulation experiments are carried out. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can realize the current-sharing control of the parallel system under the premise of realizing the voltage stability control of the low voltage side of GSC and bidirectional energy transmission, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed currentsharing control strategy.

articleTitle: Layout Design of Warehouse Based on Systematic Layout Planning and GA-ACO Algorithm
abstract: In the modern logistics process, the warehouse is responsible for storage, processing, and order management. Therefore, the number of functional areas inside the warehouse increases. Using the systematic layout planning (SLP) cannot obtain the optimal layout plan. The combination of genetic algorithm and SLP has become a commonly used method to obtain a layout plan. Genetic algorithm has local optimization, making the obtained layout not the optimum solution. Aiming at this problem, a fusion scheme of ant colony genetic algorithm is proposed. The experimental results show that the layout plan obtained by the method proposed in this paper has a higher comprehensive relationship.

articleTitle: Overview of Robot Force Control Algorithms Based on Neural Network
abstract: This article briefly explains the advantages and disadvantages of traditional control methods and the main reasons why they cannot be used directly in the field of robot force control. Then explained the basic principles of classic neural networks and deep reinforcement learning, sorted out the development process of various algorithms in the field of hybrid control methods based on them, conducted an in-depth analysis of the basic principles of these control algorithms, and compared them with applications in the field of robot force control.

articleTitle: Collaborative Learning Network for Scene Text Detection
abstract: Text detection in the wild has been a popular research topic, and previous approaches to scene text detection have achieved promising performances across various benchmarks. In general, these methods use a large number of labels with precise character positions as training data. However, accurate annotation of large amounts of training data is a challenge. On the other hand, image-level annotation can be quickly obtained from rich media in a tag retrieval manner. Therefore it is essential to investigate how to improve the performance of strongly supervised text detection models through image-level annotation data. In this work, we propose a training framework for collaborative learning of a weakly supervised text classification network and a strongly supervised text detection network. The collaborative learning of the two sub-task networks is achieved by constraining the consistency of the two networks at the perceptual level. Experiments on standard data set ICDAR2015 show that the framework can significantly improve the performance of the strongly supervised text detection network by training using image-level annotation data.

articleTitle: Attention Based Encoder-decoder Network for Cardiac Semantic Segmentation
abstract: The heart is one of the most important organs of humans. Accurate cardiac segmentation can improve the efficiency of cardiac diagnosis, and thus boost the clinical applications in the future. Although deep learning has enormous success in recent years, medical cardiac segmentation is still an unsolved problem due to the unique characteristics of medical images obtained by computerized tomography or magnetic resonance imaging. In this paper, we propose a new cardiac segmentation method for CT images. Our key idea is to introduce attention mechanisms, both in the spatial domain and channels, to improve the recent UNet++ network structure for medical images. The spatial and channel attention mechanisms can guide the network to focus on important information, which is effective for medical images, thereby improving segmentation details and accuracy. We evaluated our method on our own four-chamber heart dataset, and experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can obtain encouraging segmentation performance, and higher accuracy results compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Stochastic Model Predictive Control for Linear Systems with Bounded Additive Uncertainties
abstract: This paper presents two stochastic model predictive control methods for linear time-invariant systems subject to truncated normal distributed additive uncertainties. The new methods are developed by transforming the chance constraints into deterministic constraints via re-building the robust tube-based model predictive control (RTMPC) framework with flexible initialization. Utilizing the one-step-ahead constraint, the ahead-step tube-based stochastic model predictive control (ATSMPC) algorithm is designed by applying the constantly tightened constraints in all prediction horizons. To further enhance the reliability, the cumulative-step tube-based stochastic model predictive control (CTSMPC) algorithm is developed by computing the tightened constraints based on the propagation of uncertainties along the prediction horizons. The effectiveness of the proposed methods are demonstrated via simulations.

articleTitle: Extraction Method and Application of Traveling Wave Natural Frequencies Based on PSO and VMD
abstract: The realization of fault location method based on traveling wave natural frequency depends on the extraction of traveling wave natural frequency. When the fault occurs on the power system with one or more nodes, there will be multiple reflections at the discontinuous wave impedance, which makes it difficult to extract the natural frequency principal component that represents the fault distance in the spectrum. Upon this foundation, a traveling wave natural frequency extraction method based on PSO and VMD is proposed in this paper. Firstly, PSO algorithm was used to calculate the envelope entropy of VMD at different parameters, and to select the optimal parameter combination corresponding to the minimum envelope entropy. Then, the fault traveling wave is decomposed by VMD based on the optimal parameter combination, and to extract principal components of natural frequency by analyzing spectrum. Finally, the simulation model of T-type transmission line is built to verify the reliability of this method. The simulation results show that this method can effectively suppress the influence of spectrum aliasing, accurately extract the natural frequency principal component including fault information, and the ranging error is small.

articleTitle: Joint detection of smoke and flame in Photovoltaic System based on deep learning
abstract: In recent years, the photovoltaic industry has developed vigorously where fire occurs frequently at photovoltaic power plants. This paper proposes an image defogging method based on parallel convolutional neural networks and a combined detection method for smoke and flame based on improved Faster R-CNN. Firstly, fire datasets used in the photovoltaic power plant scene are collected and produced, including two categories of smoke and flame. Then, one deep learning method is used to suppress the haze interference in the photovoltaic power plant scene. Finally, we use ResNet instead of VGG16 network, and integrate feature pyramid network(FPN) into regional candidate networks(RPN) to improve the original Faster R-CNN structure. A large number of experimental results show that our improved model has better effects on joint detection of smoke and flame.

articleTitle: Spatial-aware Network using Wasserstein Distance for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
abstract: In a general scenario, the purpose of Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) is to classify unlabeled target domain data as much as possible, but the source domain data has a large number of labels. To address this situation, this paper introduces the optimal transport theory into the transfer learning, and proposes a deep adaptation network based on the second-order Wasserstein distance, which can measure the discrepancy between the two distributions. In addition, in order to retain the spatial structure information of features, the network is combined with convolutional auto-encoder. Experiments show that our method has achieved good results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Consensus Control Protocol for First-order Linear Multi-agent Systems based on FPGA Hardware
abstract: In this paper, an efficient design hardware scheme for consensus algorithm for first-order linear multi-agent systems using Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) technology is presented. As the basis of collaboration and coordination between multi-agent, consensus algorithm is a protocol adopted by multi-agent to reach consensus on the state of agents based on local information. The algorithm is implemented in Altera's Cyclone IV E series FPGA chip using Verilog HDL language. Finally, the implemented algorithm is simulated through the Modelsim simulation platform and compared with the Matlab processing results, the consensus algorithm based on FPGA has achieved the expected results.

articleTitle: A slope-based fast satellite selection algorithm for multi-constellation RAIM
abstract: The gradual improvement of global navigation satellite systems in recent decades and their combination greatly increase the visible satellite number for positioning and integrity monitoring process. This enhances the positioning accuracy and availability of the navigation system but at the cost of the large growth in computation load and function failure rate. Satellite selection is a useful way to relieve the side effect of superabundant measurements in use and has been developed for geometric dilution of precision (GDOP) optimization, but it has scarcely been studied in the integrity monitoring field. This paper proposes a slope-based fast satellite selection algorithm with the motivation to optimize the horizontal protection level (HPL) of subset while maintaining an acceptable positioning accuracy. The basis of this algorithm is a cost function which illustrates the relationship between satellite geometry and the slope effect. While the principle is to find the max slope satellite in the subset and introduce a new satellite which can significantly reduce the max slope by the cost function so the HPL decreases. Comparison simulations show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in HPL reduction, positioning accuracy maintenance and computation load mitigation, which means it is more suitable for real-time multi-constellation navigation applications.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Function Linked Neural Network Based on Error Compensation
abstract: In the process of chemical production, some key process variables need be measured accurately. Soft sensor is of great importance. Due to the increasing difficulties of modern processes, it is harder and harder to develop accurate soft sensor. FLNN (Function linked Neural network is a promising model for building soft sensor. The industrial data tend to be high-dimensional and highly nonlinear. The accuracy of the developed soft sensor cannot meet the requirement by the traditional FLNN. To solve this problem, this paper put forward a novel model to improve the accuracy of the FLNN. The main idea of this proposed method is error compensation. The proposed method is called as error compensation based FLNN (EC-FLNN) where two FLNN models are established. The first one is to predict the output value, and the second one is to predict the error value. The sum of the results of the two models is obtained as the final outputs. The UCI standard data set and PTA production data set are used to verify the performance of the proposed method. Simulation result shows that EC-FLNN has better precision than the traditional FLNN.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm of Simulation Robotic Fish Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: In order to realize fast obstacle avoidance and tracking of robotic fish in the competition situation, and realize the rapid and accurate adjustment of robotic fish in the water environment without special intervention, a motion strategy of obstacle avoidance and tracking based on ant colony algorithm is proposed. And, the method is verified by 2D simulation platform. The results show that the simulation robotic fish can find the optimal path according to the algorithm, achieve the combination optimization of speed and direction under the premise of obstacle avoidance, and find the target point with the shortest time and distance. This shows that the obstacle avoidance and tracking method based on ant colony algorithm has strong adaptability, and can meet the requirements of motion strategy of simulation robotic fish.

articleTitle: Multi-motion Target Recognition and Perception Method Based on Information Fusion
abstract: In order to solve the problem that Faster-RCNN cannot distinguish moving and stationary targets in the image, and the recognition rate is low when there are small targets and overlapping targets in the image, this paper proposes a multi-moving target recognition and perception method based on information fusion. In this study, the extraction of moving targets and the integration of millimeter-wave radar(MWR) information are used to realize the recognition and perception of moving targets by Faster-RCNN, and improve the recognition accuracy of Faster-RCNN to small targets and overlapping targets in the image. It is verified that the algorithm can realize high accuracy and high accuracy identification and perception of moving pedestrians and vehicles through the verification of moving pedestrian and moving vehicle data sets.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of DMS Control System for Dam Defects Inspection and Identification
Research on Knowledge Reasoning in Transformer Partial Discharge Fault Diagnosis
abstract: The partial discharge fault detection in power system equipment is mainly to determine the defect location and discharge categories in its high-voltage insulation devices. Therefore, accurately analyzing partial discharge signals from the original fault data and extracting effective feature information have become the main challenge. This paper proposed a technique for detecting partial discharge faults in transformers based on knowledge reasoning. A phase three-dimensional map is composed, based on which the type and location of the partial discharge is determined. Finally, a set of unknown mixed discharge signals are tested, results show that the proposed method performs a higher diagnostic accuracy than traditional technologies.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Combined Cooling, heating and power system coupled with heat pump based on EnergyPLAN
abstract: In recent years, the technology of combined cooling, heating and Power System (CCHP) has been promoted and used. However, economic challenges such as high operating cost, still exit. In order to further improve the economy of the combined cooling, heating and Power integrated energy system, this paper proposed a regional integrated energy system consisting of the CCHP system. wind farm and heat pump in northeast China, which aims to maximize the synergies between the three technologies. The effect of different heat pnmp capacity on the system economy is analyzed by nsing simulation software EnergyPLAN, while taking into account wind power curtailment within the system. Based on the premise of satisfying the load demand of end users, and with the lowest operation cost as the optimization objective function, the simulation results showed that the economic efficiency of the "electric-thermal hybrid" operation mode was quite competitive in comparison with other passive operation modes. In a certain capacity range, the heat pump could also effectively reduce energy system cost and the amount of abandoned wind power.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Multi-Manifold Classifier for One-sample Face Identification
abstract: With the continuous development of image recognition technology, various classification algorithms have been proposed, which makes the accuracy of prediction increasingly improved. However, in many practical applications, there is only ’one sample per person (OSPP)’ that can be obtained. Thus, many popular methods fail to work well. To address this problem, we explore a Fuzzy Multi-Manifold Classifier (FMMC) method which transforms OSPP into the manifold matching problem. First, we construct the sub-manifold by partitioning each enrolled image of several non-overlapping patches. Then, in order to specify the class-membership degree of each patch, we introduce the theory of fuzzy set to define the membership matrix. Such that each patch has a big enough membership degree, even if it is surrounded by the inter-class neighbors. Lastly, the classification is turned into a problem of finding a category with a maximum decision membership degree of manifold. Experimental results on the YALE and AR face databases show that our method outperforms some other classifiers.

articleTitle: Short-term Elevator Traffic Flow Estimation with Hybrid Long Short-Term Memory Network
abstract: In modern life, elevator plays an important role in our daily life. It transports citizens and goods in the high buildings and shopping malls. However, sometimes there is some tiny malfunction with the elevator, which means the maintenance worker will fix it in the next hours. During the repair, citizens cannot use the elevator. Thus, estimating the elevator traffic flow in the next hours to choose a suitable time for repairing is important, which means it will make less trouble to the citizens. Up to now, there are some researches about elevator traffic flow monitoring. However, few of them make an estimation of the future flow. This paper presents an elevator traffic flow estimation method by designing a hybrid long short-term memory neural network. Firstly, the traffic flow is denoted by the running frequency of the elevator per hour. Then, a hybrid long short-term memory neural network is designed which comprehensively considered the trend, period and fusion of the data. Finally, experiments on several elevators show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel RGB-D SLAM for Recognizing Features on Static Objects
abstract: This paper proposes a novel RGB-D SLAM algorithm which can recognize the features on static objects and estimate the ego-motion of RGB-D camera in dynamic scenes. Besides, a static score is established for each feature, which is used to indicate the static level of the feature. The static score consists of static density and static count. Static density represents the proportion of features of static objects around each feature, and static count represents the number of times each feature is recognized as a static feature. In the experimental section, we compare the proposed method with ORB-SLAM2 through the TUM RGB-D dataset. The results show that in dynamic scenes, the proposed method effectively improves the performance of the ego-motion of RGB-D camera.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of a class of networked evolutionary games with random entrance and time delays
abstract: In this paper, a class of networked evolutionary games(NEGs) with both random entrance and time delays is studied. First, under some proper assumptions, the algebraic expressions for the given NEGs are obtained via the semi-tensor product(STP) method. Furthermore, using receding horizon control method, the maximun possible expected payoff of the major player is calculated, in which the major player's τ-step strategy is considered as a free-type control. Finally, an illustrate example is given to support our new results.

articleTitle: Research on kinematics simulation and testing of the modular dual-arm cooperative robot
abstract: This paper deals with the kinematics simulation and experiment of a dual-arm robot that has six rotational DOFs of each arm. Based on the solution and division of the single-arm operation space and the dual-arm collaborative space, the coordinated action indicators of the dual-arm robot are quantitatively analyzed. The dual-arm trajectory planning is carried out by using the target task layer-by-layer decomposition mode. For the orientation interpolation planning and joint trajectory planning, the quaternion method and the fifth-order polynomial interpolation method are combined respectively to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of the trajectory planning. Finally, MATLAB is used to simulate the dual-arm coordinated and used EtherCAT bus and TwinCAT master station to establish a robot system. The testing results show that the kinematics analysis and trajectory planning of the dual-arm coordinated robot are correct and feasible.

articleTitle: Open-Circuit Fault Diagnosis of Z-Source Inverter via Deep Neural Network
abstract: In this paper, issues of open-circuit fault diagnosis are solved for Z-source-inverter via the deep-sparse-autoencoder, which is one type of the various deep neural networks. Firstly, the preliminary of Z-source-inverter is introduced briefly. On the basis of the introduction of Z-source inverter, MATLAB/Simulink is utilized for the development of the open-circuit fault model of the Z-source inverter, and the output voltages of diverse fault cases are recorded for the training and test of the deep neural network based fault diagnosis. In the end, the superiority and effectiveness of the presented fault diagnosis approach can be verified by several comparisons with other methods on simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Local Motion Planning and Tracking of Autonomous Driving Vehicles
abstract: This paper improved and designed a method based on model predictive control algorithm for motion planning and tracking control in the reference of previous studies. Based on the model predictive control algorithm, the vehicle's lateral tracking algorithm is designed. Based on the dual-PID closed-loop algorithm, the vehicle's longitudinal control algorithm is designed. Combining the dangerous potential field method with the model predictive control algorithm, the vehicle's local obstacle avoidance and the local motion planning algorithm are designed. These algorithms were simulated in the simulation environment as well as deployed and verified on the real vehicle. The results of the real vehicle performance are fed back to the simulation platform for parameter re-optimization.

articleTitle: Tool Wear Prediction with External Signals Based on Lightweight Deep Learning Model
abstract: The discontinuity in the milling process makes the tool wear rapidly, which will affect the workpieces' precision and quality. But it is difficult to predict tool wear status with traditional signal processing methods due to inevitable interfering signals. Recently, deep learning algorithms have been widely used because its superiority in solving nonlinear problems. This paper proposes a lightweight convolutional neural network model, which is utilized to enable automatic learning of hierarchical tool wear representation in a short time. Two kinds of external signals and an internal signal are used for experiments. The results show that the classification accuracy of the model based on sound and vibration signals is 98.28% and 97.07%, the prediction from both models have high coefficient with the actual tool wear. Comparisons with related works highlight the effectiveness of our prediction method.

articleTitle: ESO-based Finite Set Model Predictive Current Control PMSM Delay Compensation
abstract: MPC generally needs a digital control system to implement in practical. It is a typical digital control method, and digital control systems generally have the problem of one-step delay. In motor control, the existence of a one-step delay in the system lead to undesirable consequences such as current ripple, increased oscillation, and weakened stability. In this paper, aiming at the one-step delay problem of the permanent magnet synchronous motor MPC control system, the extended state observer (ESO) is used for closed-loop delay compensation. This method can improve the anti-interference ability of the system, and has obvious suppression effect on parameter perturbation and unknown disturbance that appear during system operation. Finally, it was verified by Simulink, and compared with non-compensation and commonly used compensation methods based on the actual model of the motor. The results show that the proposed method has good one-step delay compensation characteristics and can effectively improve the control effect of finite set model predictive current control (FCS-MPCC).

articleTitle: Application of automation technology in the maintenance of navigation marks in navigation channels
abstract: Because water buoy is often wound by floating objects and its performance is affected, the original solution requires a large investment of manpower and resources. This paper designs an early warning system for pressure detection and WiFi communication via chip STM32F407. The system can detect the pressure of the beacon in real time, judge the current status of the beacon, and transmit it to the monitoring system through WiFi communication technology. Pass maintenance information to relevant personnel when pressure exceeds standard value.

articleTitle: Cooperative Control for Stochastic Upper-Triangular Nonlinear Systems with Time-Varying Delay
abstract: This paper studies cooperative control problem for upper-triangular nonlinear multi-agent systems (MASs) with time delay. We first introduce a coordinate transformation so that we get a MASs with a low-gain. Then, we build a distributed controller for nominal system of the MASs with a low-gain. With the help of the distributed controller, we choose the appropriate Lyapunov function and use stochastic analysis tool to solve the control problem.

articleTitle: Research on short-term offshore wind power prediction based on sodar wind measurement
abstract: The anemometer tower cannot be well adapted to wind measurement needs due to its inherent limitations in areas with low wind speeds and complicated offshore terrain, but the advantages of sodar can well meet the prediction research of offshore wind power. In this paper, the results of measuring the wind speed and wind direction by the sodar and the anemometer tower are compared and analyzed while the specific power model is verified using the sodar measurement data. The test results show that the sodar can replace the anemometer tower to complete the preliminary work of power prediction in specific environments.

articleTitle: Pattern-based State Feedback Stabilization for a Class of Processes
abstract: For a class of production processes, a modeling method based on pattern recognition is introduced, and state feedback stabilization of the system is studied in a pattern-moving state space. At the first part of the article, the modeling method of the system is introduced, which is based on pattern moving, and the system dynamics are presented by using the so-named pattern class variable(PCV) instead of a system output or state variable. A discrete-time and discrete-state nonlinear state-space model (DNSM) is given in Euclidean space based on the modeling method. And soon a new control and stability analysis method is put forward. Finally, validity of the stabilization method is demonstrated by using data of an actual production process.

articleTitle: SFSSD: A Select Feature Single-shot Detector for Real-time Target detection
abstract: We present Select Feature Single-shot Detection (SFSSD), a lightweight object detector framework that can optimize feature fusion. State-of-the-art extract features rely heavily on a very deep or large network structure, so it's difficult to apply to miniaturized embedded devices. Designing a good lightweight network instead of a large network can solve this problem. Lightweight networks using shallow features to detect small targets do not work well, so needs fuse deep semantic information to shallow layers, we design a feature fusion selector to determine the optimal network structure. In the case of guaranteed speed, compared with Tiny-SSD, the mean Average Precision (mAP) increases 3%, and the speed is 3 times faster than DSOD. At 512*512 inputs, mAP was achieved 67.4% without pre-training. After using the feature fusion selector improved the network structure, mAP rise 0.6%. Our code and models are available at: https://github.com/976912560/SFSSD.

articleTitle: Model-Free Semi-Active Structural Control of Floating Wind Turbines
abstract: This paper addresses the load/vibration reduction problem of offshore floating wind turbines (FWTs). Based on the tuned mass damper (TMD), a novel semi-active control method is designed to mitigate the floating platform's structural vibration. Different from existing results, the proposed control method is model-free and insensitive to system uncertainties and unmodelled dynamics. We base our design on the model-free adaptive control (MFAC) method. A data-based surrogate model is developed to approximate the unknown FWT dynamical system through the dynamic linearization technique. In addition, a quadratic programming (QP) module is embedded in our MFAC-based semi-active structural controller for constraint handling and control allocation purposes. High-fidelity simulations of FWTs show that our model-free semi-active structural controller can address the limitations of existing results and significantly reduce the platform's vibration.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Diode Clamped Three-Level 12-Phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: Based on the mathematical model of multiphase permanent magnet synchronous motor, it can be summarized as single winding model and multi winding models in MT coordinate system. On this basis, this paper studies the speed regulation method of diode neutral point clamped (NPC) three-level twelve-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), and designs and implements multi-phase vector and multi-phase multi-vector speed control strategies. Three-level converter adopts space voltage vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) technology; a diode clamped three-level twelve phase inverter is constructed, and a multi-phase vector control strategy of air gap flux-oriented control of twelve-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor is realized by using the linear auto disturbance rejection control (ADRC) method. On this basis, the operation of the motor under phase failure is analyzed and verified. The simulation results show that the system can achieve good control and operation performance by adopting the speed regulation strategy described in this paper.

articleTitle: A fatigue driving detection algorithm based on weighted D-S evidence theory
abstract: Fatigue driving detection is of great significance to public traffic safety. Traditional fatigue driving detection algorithm pursues the minimum classification error rate and ignores the loss caused by different misclassification. However, fatigue driving detection algorithm should pay more attention to the high cost misclassification samples to minimize the overall loss of the learning model. In order to solve this problem, the cost-sensitive learning and Dempster-Shafer evidence theory (D-S evidence theory) are combined to obtain a robust and good performance ensemble classifier.

articleTitle: Lag Consensus of Discrete-time Nonlinear Leader-Following Multi-agent Systems
abstract: This paper sought to a lag consensus issue of discrete-time nonlinear leader-following multiagent system. Firstly, a second-order discrete-time leader-following multiagent systems model has been established. Secondly, a protocol is designed for considered systems, based on the graph theory and general Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional method. Thirdly, one sufficient condition based on linear matrices inequalities (LMIs) is provided to realize the lag consensus of considered systems.

articleTitle: A CoAP-based OPC UA Transmission Scheme for Resource-Constrained Devices
abstract: The Industrial Internet continuously covers all aspects of smart manufacturing. As an enabling technology for Industrial Internet, OPC UA protocol realizes the information modeling and unified description of industry devices. Furthermore, OPC UA supports data access through Web services based on HTTP. However, the high resource cost of HTTP for resource-constrained devices is hard to afford. The CoAP protocol is specially designed for resource-constrained devices, and it has better suitability in the IoT environment than HTTP. Therefore, an efficient and lightweight transmission scheme, which is applied to realize the transfer of OPC UA messages over the CoAP protocol, is proposed in this paper. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed scheme realizes the effective transmission of resource-constrained device data through the Web service interface via OPC UA.

articleTitle: Simulation method of semi-physical wind power generation based on combined wind speed and tip speed ratio
abstract: In order to research wind power generation technology in the laboratory, a feasible scheme based on modeling and simulation was proposed to simulate wind turbines operating characteristics. The characteristics of wind turbine and the method of optimum leaf tip speed ratio are analyzed, the wind turbine simulation model is constructed, the wind speed model combined with four wind speeds characteristics is established to simulate natural wind speed, and the semi-physical wind power simulation system is built by combining software and hardware. The correctness of the program is verified through simulation experiments of the wind turbine operation state under instantaneous wind speed and natural wind speed, which can accurately reflect the operating characteristics of the wind turbine under the actual wind speed, and provide a reference for the future research of wind power technology.

Author Keywords: Optimum leaf tip speed ratio method

articleTitle: Maneuver Planning of Geostationary Satellites Using Mean Orbital Elements
abstract: On the one hand, the satellite will deviate from its current orbit gradually, on the other hand, it will cause the satellite's motion to oscillate periodically. Generally speaking, the orbit maneuver of satellite is to adjust the average trend of its space motion to make its space position meet the requirements of load application at least for a period of time. The oscillation of satellite orbit elements changes in real time. Therefore, in order to realize precise maneuver planning, the amplitude of orbital elements oscillation before and after maneuver must be considered. The calculation of this amplitude is not simple and accurate. There are usually two methods, numerical method and analytical method. The cost of numerical method is very high, especially in the planning of complex maneuvering process, large-scale optimization solution requires multiple calculation of amplitude. Aiming at geostationary satellite (one of the most widely used satellite types), this paper uses an analytical method to calculate the amplitude of the satellite to realize the high-precision planning of the average motion of the satellite. The complex satellite maneuver planning problem is transformed into the boundary constraint optimization problem, and then solved by a simple and universal method. The simulation results verify the feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method for geostationary satellite maneuver planning.

articleTitle: Spoofing mitigation for GPS receiver based on array antenna using cross-correlation of received signals of each element
abstract: A low-complexity and practical blind adaptive suppression technique against GPS spoofing attack is proposed using cross-correlation characteristics of received signals of each array element. It can effectively suppress the spoofing signals which are transmitted from the same direction. Simulation results show that when the power of each spoofing PRN codes is 2dB relative to that of each authentic PRN, the proposed method can apply approximately 20dB of attenuation to each spoofing PRN, for ternary array antenna without the need of array calibration and orientation.

articleTitle: Combined Unipolar and Bipolar PWM for Braking Control of Brushless DC Motor
abstract: This paper proposes a novel hybrid PWM mode for braking control of the brushless dc motor in the electric vehicle drive applications. To simplify the hardware circuit topology and reconstruct the real-time motor currents, a single dc-link current sensor sampling method is employed. However, in small duty ratio applications, the current signals cannot be sampled accurately under the conventional unipolar PWM mode due to the limitation of amplifier bandwidth and analog to digital converter sampling time. Therefore, a hybrid PWM mode based on unipolar-bipolar switching is used to obtain the current signals in a wide duty ratio range. The method proposed in this paper combines the advantages of unipolar and bipolar PWM, and realizes the real-time current control of brushless dc motor in the braking process. Simulation and experimental results verify the feasibility of the proposed control mode.

articleTitle: Classification of Imbalanced Tumor Gene Expression Data Based on Weighted Gaussian Process
abstract: Tumor gene expression data is characterized with high dimension, small samples and imbalance. Gaussian Process Classification presents good applicability to high-dimensional and small sample data, but class-imbalanced problem will cause the low classification accuracy on the samples of minority classes. In this paper, a weighted likelihood function is introduced to balance the importance of positive and negative samples during the training of Gaussian Process Classifier, and further extended to multi-class classification tasks. The experimental results on real tumor gene expression data sets show that this method could effectively deal with the class-imbalanced problem caused by One-Against-Rest strategy in multi-class classification, meanwhile, achieve better classification accuracy on both the minority classes and overall data sets.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Train Braking System Based on Gauss-Newton Iteration Method
abstract: This paper presents an identification algorithm with Gauss-Newton iteration method for train braking system parameter estimate. A nonlinear system model with parametric uncertainties is built through the analysis of the flow process of the train braking signal as the command and the characteristics of the braking system. Gauss-Newton method is employed to improve the convergence speed of the identification algorithm, which can reduce calculation time. In the end, the simulation analysis is conducted based on the actual data of Beijing-Guangzhou Railway. Simulations are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed identification algorithm, which has anti-interference performance to deal with the external noise disturbance and estimates the braking system parameters quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: A novel fractional-order charge-pump PLL with the fractional-order loop filter
abstract: In this paper, a novel fractional-order charge-pump-phase-locked-loop (FO-CPPLL) using a fractional-order loop filter (FO-LF) is proposed to improve the overall system performance. The FO-CPPLL is obtained by extending the traditional CPPLL order from integer domain to real domain by using the FO-LF. Specifically, a fractional-order capacitor is applied to replace the integer-order capacitor in the traditional second-order LF, and the constructed FO-LF is inserted between PFD/CP and VCO to form the FO-CPPLL. The FO-LF actualizes fine tuning accuracy in seeking the orders between [0,1] for FO-CPPLL to improve the tracking speed and reducing the system phase loss. Also, the proposed FO-CPPLL can obtain lower jitter and better stability. Finally, simulation results verify the analysis and effectiveness of the proposed FO-CPPLL.

articleTitle: Research on the modeling method of NPC three-phase three-level inverter
abstract: In the actual operation of the system, due to the interference of external environment or uncertain things, the accuracy of system modeling will be affected, so it is difficult to accurately analyze the operation performance of the system. In this paper, the NPC three-phase three-level inverter is taken as the object and its basic principle and topology are analyzed. Based on the current flow path, the mathematical model of the inverter is established by using mixed logical dynamic systems (MLD). Finally, the simulation model using MATLAB/Simulink is built, and four operation conditions of inverter are set, namely normal operation, single power switch open-circuit fault operation, simultaneous open-circuit fault operation of two power switch tubes in the same phase and different phase two power switch tubes, to carry out numerical simulation and result analysis. The simulation results show that the accuracy of the model is proved, and the output current has different waveform characteristics when different switches failure.

articleTitle: Damage Evaluation Method of CFRP Structures Based on PCA and Random Forest Algorithm
abstract: The accurate and timely assessment of carbon fiber reinforced plastics (CFRP) structure damage is very important for ensuring the safety of aviation and aerospace composite structures. This paper studied the CFRP damage evaluation method by using principal component analysis (PCA) and random forest algorithm. First, the structure was excited to obtain the dynamic response signal. Thus, the frequency characteristics were obtained. Then, PCA was used to extract the damage feature. On this basis, the structural damage evaluation model based on random forest was established. Finally, the damage assessment experiment system of composite structures was established and experimentally verified. The testing result showed that the proposed method by using principal component analysis and random forest algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Corner Detection based on Contour
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low positioning accuracy and long detection time in the corner point extraction of workpiece in the current industry, this paper combines the advantages of fast corner detection algorithm based on contour curve and high positioning accuracy of corner detection algorithm based on gray image, a new corner detection algorithm based on contour is proposed. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has high anti-interference, accurate positioning and fast speed.

articleTitle: Actuator Fault Reconstruction for PEM Fuel Cell Air-Feed System Using Adaptive Sliding Mode Observer
abstract: In this paper, the actuator fault reconstruction problem of PEMFC systems is of concern. Drawn upon the robust second-order sliding mode observer, the improved super-twisting (ST) sliding mode algorithm is put forward in terms of adaptive estimation laws on the uncertain parameters. The proposed fault reconstruction method is of high accurancy, fast response and strong robustness to uncertainties, which poses fundamental basis on the fault-tolerant control. Experimental simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: Smooth Switching Control of PMSM Based on LADRC and Backstepping Integral Sliding Mode
abstract: In order to make permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) control system have good dynamic and steady performances and improve the anti-interference ability of the system, the smooth switching control method based on linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) and backstepping integral sliding mode control(BISMC) was designed. Firstly, proposed the LADRC controller to promote anti-disturbance and reduce the steady-state error of system. Secondly, proposed BISMC controller to accelerate dynamic response of PMSM system. Finally, the strategy of smooth switching control was designed to coordinate the LADRC controller with the back-stepping integral sliding mode controller, this strategy fully combined the advantages of two controllers. Aiming at the unknown load torque, an observer is designed to track the load torque accurately. Simulation results by using MATLAB show that smooth switching strategy based on LADRC and BISMC meet high requirements of PMSM control system when compared with the single controller,it has good application prospects.

articleTitle: Fixed-Time Synchronization of Fifth-Order Memristor Chaotic Systems
abstract: Based on the classical Chua's circuit, a chaotic circuit is constructed including double magnetron memristors. To study the fixed-time synchronization problem about the fifth-order memristor chaotic systems, a sliding-mode surface is proposed firstly. Then, a suitable controller is devised by using the sliding-mode control method. The sliding-mode surface is reached, then the stability on the surface also can be achieved within a fixed time thereafter. Moreover, the settling time for system synchronization is estimated, and numerical simulations confirm the correctness of the theory.

articleTitle: The New Paste Backfill Model and Control Based on The Centrifugal Pump and Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: The paste backfill mining becomes more important since the urgency of the reducing pollution, saving energy and improving technology in the mining. Most researches focus on the paste material itself but are not interested in the paste backfill process model. Considering of the importance for the paste backfill mining, the paste backfill process model is developed based on the centrifugal pump model and the permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) model in this paper. In the real paste backfill process, the centrifugal pump is driven by the PMSM as a holistic system. Then, the unitary paste backfill process model is proposed including the PMSM driving the pump and a PID controller is designed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed paste backfill process model. Simulations demonstrate the proposed paste backfill model feasible.

articleTitle: An Underactuated AUV Tracking Algorithm Based on Backstepping Adaptive Sliding Mode Control
abstract: Underactuated autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) is a kind of AUV with independent control inputs less than the number of degrees of freedom of motion. Its trajectory tracking problem has increasingly become a research hotspot. This paper proposes a backstepping adaptive sliding mode control algorithm, which realizes the trajectory tracking of underactuated AUV under external environmental interference, and derives it to prove the stability. The algorithm introduces a position error margin, uses the backstepping method to design the desired speed of underactuated AUV, and proposes an antiinterference adaptive sliding mode control, which achieves the convergence of the tracking position error by speed control. Finally, through simulation, the trajectory tracking problem of helix is solved and analyzed by using this method, which shows the timeliness, stability and robustness.

articleTitle: A pipeline of stereo vision based visual odometer for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: Autonomous navigation is of critical importance for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). The navigation system of UAV is usually constructed based on Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and vision subsystem. The accumulative error in IMU is an inevitable issue. The application of visual information could assist to correct the localization error and make a more robust navigation system. However, the influence from the environment like the illumination variation, lack of textures, occlusion and so on makes it difficult to build a visual odometer. In this study, a pipeline of stereo vision based visual odometer for UAV navigation has been developed. A modified stereo matching method is proposed which used octree to store the map. The edge features in the stereo images have been enhanced which could provide informative clue for stereo matching. The low texture regions which may lead to inaccurate depth measurement have been detected and removed. Constraints like smoothness, consistency and uniqueness are imposed to refine the disparity map. Based on ORB-SLAM2 architecture, a modified stereo visual odometer with quad match is developed. The stereo matching method is used in the stereo VO for correspondence computation and place reidentification. Extensive experiments have verified the efficiency of the stereo VO pipeline.

articleTitle: Research on Manipulator Trajectory Tracking Based on Adaptive Fuzzy Sliding Mode Control
abstract: Manipulator has the characteristics of high nonlinearity and strong coupling, which is easily affected by external factors, making the system instability. Based on the above problems, an adaptive fuzzy sliding mode control method is designed to study the trajectory tracking problem of manipulator in the paper. Firstly, a two-degree-of-freedom dynamic model of the manipulator is established according to the Lagrangian equation, and then an adaptive fuzzy sliding mode control algorithm for the manipulator is proposed and the Lyapunov function is used to prove the convergence and stability of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the adaptive fuzzy sliding mode control can make each joint of the manipulator respond to the desired trajectory quickly, and the tracking error converges to zero within a certain time, which has achieved excellent control effect and verified the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: IoT USN system and hybrid architecture application
abstract: Based on the "Ministry of Industry and Information Technology-Research on the Internet of Things Technology in the Shipbuilding Process of Waigaoqiao", this article analyzes three IoT systems: USN, SWE, and RFID, and three IoT architectures: REST, centralized, and distributed, integrating centralized architecture and distributed architecture, and propose an IoT network architecture of hybrid manufacturing plant equipment nodes. Combined with the ship segment manufacturing workshop of Shanghai Waigaoqiao Shipbuilding Co., Ltd., the overall topology of the workshop IoT that integrates three network forms such as WSN, and the three-dimensional and hierarchical four-layer IoT architecture of the workshop under the USN system are designed.At the same time, in conjunction with the "China Intelligent Manufacturing 2025" strategy, shipbuilding will be improved to a more advanced level, and it will better support the national marine development strategy.

articleTitle: An intra-day rolling dynamic dispatch for isolated microgrid with MPC method
abstract: Common microgrid dispatches are mainly based on static model and ignore the dynamic characteristic of the micro-turbine system when dispatching on a short time scale. In this paper, based on an isolated microgrid, an intra-day rolling dynamic dispatch problem considering the dynamic characteristic of micro-turbine on a short dispatch time scale is formulated under the framework of model predictive control (MPC), and then solved by the mixed integer linear programming (MILP) algorithm. In addition, the actual output of the micro-turbine is obtained and compared with its setpoint given by the dispatch results. The simulation results show that the dynamic dispatch strategy has less output power deviation and can make full use of the micro-turbine to formulate a more reasonable dispatch plan compared with the static one.

articleTitle: Cascade Control for Spacecraft Formation about Libration Points
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic model for leader- follower spacecraft formation under the circular restricted three-body problem is established, and the attitude control algorithm of the leader spacecraft and the relative position control algorithm of the leader-follower spacecraft are given based on the stability theory of cascade system.

articleTitle: Voice-controlled Tea Pouring Robot Based on Machine Vision and Artificial Potential Field Method
abstract: In this paper, according to the living standard of Chinese people, combined with artificial intelligence which is the frontier of modern Robotics, on the basis of machine vision and artificial potential field obstacle avoidance method, a tea serving robot is proposed. It has strong learning ability, high cost performance, high efficiency, high reliability, and can listen to commands and execute quickly. This project focuses on binocular recognition algorithm and artificial potential field algorithm, combined with the control of the mechanical arm, power source management, voice control, etc., and finally realize a complete set of voice-controlled tea robot system. It can not only meet the needs of people's life, but also liberate labor force and improve work efficiency. In the future, the robot can not only be used in daily life to provide special services for each family, but also be used in beverage shops, restaurants and other places to promote the development of China's service industry.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of wind power gearbox based on IPSO-FNN
abstract: Wind power gearbox (WPG) is an important component of wind turbines, which is prone to faults due to factors such as working environment and complex structure. Furthermore, the causality of faults is difficult to be expressed by the mathematical model. A fault diagnosis method of WPG is proposed based on the improved particle swarm optimization combined with fuzzy neural network (IPSO-FNN). In order to improve the efficiency of network learning algorithm, IPSO is used to learn network parameters. Fitness variance is introduced to characterize the state of particles, and differential evolution is applied to premature particles to improve the diversity of particle swarm. Simulation results show that the proposed method has higher diagnostic accuracy and faster convergence speed than FNN and PSO-FNN methods.

articleTitle: Gas Leakage Segmentation in Industrial Plants
abstract: Industrial gas leakage in chemical plants presents a high risk to health and safety, also makes a huge waste of production materials. In this paper, we propose an automatic gas segmentation method for optical gas imaging (OGI) videos, which can not only indicate the existence of leakage in frames but also show the precise locations and shapes of gas plumes. Specifically, we propose a novel video segmentation network that stacks 2D spatial convolutions, 1D temporal convolutions and 3D spatial-temporal convolutions together within an encoder-decoder structure, termed 2.5D-Unet. Stacking mixed convolutions increases the representation ability of network for leakage's appearance and motion. More importantly, stacking mixed convolutions facilitates pre-training of model using still images of smoke, which is especially useful when lacking of labeled videos of leaked gas. Experimental results show, for OGI video-based gas leakage segmentation, our method outperforms existing video segmentation methods.

articleTitle: Transfer Function Model Identification Based on Improved Least Square Method
abstract: The thermal system of nuclear power units is complicated and difficult to control. The simulation system plays an important role in the design of the control system. The model of the equipment is the basis of the simulation system. It is a difficult task to model a large number of equipment. In order to improve the modeling efficiency, this paper proposes a modeling method based on the actual operating data of the devices, which can identify the transfer function model of the devices through the data. Conventional least squares can identify the order of the model, but there are deficiencies in parameter optimization, which leads to poor identification accuracy. The particle swarm optimization algorithm has a better parameter optimization function, which can make up for the shortcomings of the least square method. Therefore, this paper combines the least square method and the improved PSO, and proposes a new transfer function model identification method, which effectively improves the accuracy of model identification.

articleTitle: Multi-target GM-PHD trackers based on strong tracking cubature Kalman filter
abstract: Multi-target tracking technology based on probability hypothesis density (PHD) filter has become a hot research topic due to the feature that it does not require measurement-to-track association. Aiming at the problem that the Gaussian mixture probability hypothesis density (GM-PHD) cannot update the mean and covariance in a nonlinear system, a cubature integration method is used to numerically compute multivariate moment integrals and a suboptimal fading factor of strong tracking filter is introduced to enhance the filter performance in this paper. The proposed algorithm is referred as STCKF-GM-PHD, which combines strong tracking cubature Kalman filter with GM-PHD and realizes the application of GM-PHD in a nonlinear situation. Simulation results support that the proposed approach STCKF-GM-PHD has obvious performance improvement over EKF-GM-PHD and UKF-GM-PHD in numerical stability and filtering accuracy.

articleTitle: Weighted Multiple Model Adaptive Dynamic Surface Control for a Flexible-Joint Manipulator
abstract: Operation performance of a flexible-joint manipulator is measured by the accurate tracking of angular position, which is especially significant for the plant with largely uncertain parameters. In this paper, a weighted multiple model adaptive dynamic surface control (WMMADSC) method is proposed for a flexible-joint manipulator with largely jumping parameters. The present WMMADSC approximates the largely uncertain parameters with a finite local constant parameter models. And, a local dynamic surface controller is designed to deal with the angle tracking problem, based on the local flexible-joint manipulator model with constant parameters. Furthermore, a weighting algorithm is designed for fusing the local controllers to generate global control law. Simulation example and comparisons are shown to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed WMMADSC method.

articleTitle: Application of optical fiber digital transmission technology in ship monitoring system
Fault Diagnosis based on Improved Piecewise Linear Representation for Three-Capacity Water Tank
abstract: In this paper, a fault diagnosis method based on improved piecewise linear representation (PLR) for Three-capacity water tank system is proposed. Compared to conventional PLR algorithm, trend operations including trend judgement and trend merger are introduced and conducted on all segments. From trend judgement, every segment is labeled with '-2', '-1', '0', '1' and '2', representing the rapid decreasing, decreasing, steady, increasing and rapid increasing, respectively. After trend judgement, trend merger is utilized to correct segmentation, resulting in new segmentation reflecting data characteristics better. Then the K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the segments, the number of segments in each cluster is an important feature, which is used to complete fault detection. The label value differences of all measurable variables form a table, which can be used to achieve fault isolation. Finally, simulations are conducted to prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Delay-dependent criteria for stability analysis and stabilization problems of discrete impulsive switched systems with average dwell time
abstract: The stability and stabilization problems of discrete impulsive switched systems by using average dwell time method is investigated in this paper. The switching is designed with average dwell time method. The systems are with time invariant delays and norm-bounded parameter uncertainty. Using linear matrix inequality techniques (LMI) and Lyapunov- Krasovskii function method, a few delay-dependent conditions confining to the given average dwell time for ensuring robustly asymptotic stability and stabilization are derived. Finally, we give Some numerical examples in order to Verify the conclusions.

articleTitle: A Self-learning Control Strategy for Vibration Isolated Control Moment Gyroscope
abstract: In order to improve the imaging resolution of remote sensing satellites, one effective method is to isolate the vibration generated by the onboard Control Moment Gyroscope (CMG). However, vibration isolators have severe impact on the system model of CMGs, which significantly degrade its performance on attitude control. In this paper, a nonlinear virtual control object model based on neural network and a selflearning compensation controller are integrated in the original control scheme to achieve strong robust control for the system. The control performance of this strategy is verified by experiments on a real CMG system.

articleTitle: Fault Estimation and Fault Tolerant Control for Network Connected Systems via Observer Design
abstract: This paper focuses on fault estimation and fault tolerent control for network connected systems with sensor fault. First, disturbance observer are used for distubrance isolation for single linear system with sensor faults. Then, leaderless network connected systems are considered and consensus protocols are designed for the systems based on the disturbance and state estimations. The stability conditions are derived with the aid of Lyapunov functions. In addition, based on our design, no matter how big the sensor fault is, the consensus can still be achieved and the consensus errors are ultimatedly bounded. Finally, simulations are provided and the simulation results prove the effectiveness of the design in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Rolling Bearing Condition Monitoring Method Based on Deep Learning
abstract: Facing the background that traditional condition monitoring algorithms fail to fully tap the potential of equipment operation data, a convolutional neural network (CNN) based rolling bearing condition monitoring algorithm is proposed, combining with the advantages of deep learning methods and big data processing. The model designed by the algorithm uses two-layer convolution to complete feature extraction and high-level feature expression. The activation function uses ReLU and cooperates with the maximum pooling layer to reduce the feature dimension. Adding the dropout layer effectively improves overfitting. Batch normalization layer is added to accelerate the network convergence; The output layer uses softmax classification. The algorithm is verified on the bearing database of Case Western Reserve University(CWRU), and the overall recognition rate is above 99.4%, which is higher than other traditional methods. The result indicates that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Design of Non-fragile Tracking Controller Based on LMI
abstract: A tracking controller construction method based on linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) is designed for linear system. The output variables of the reference model are tracked by the output variables of the controlled system via the tracking controller. Different from the existing research results, this paper assumed that the tracking controller has uncertain perturbation, that is, non-fragile problem, so that the designed tracking controller has the ability to resist internal interference. Stability analysis is carried out by H ∞ control theory and Lyapunov stability theory. Then the solution condition of the tracking controller is obtained in the form of LMIs, which could directly solve the gain parameters of the tracking controller through the LMI toolbox of Matlab software. Finally, a simulation experiment is carried out to verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: 3D Printing Intelligent Soccer Robot Match System
abstract: A desktop intelligent soccer robot match system based on 3D printing technology is designed.we use 3D printing technology to make soccer robot body, and open-source hardware like Arduino to make soccer robot control system. The four-wheel soccer robot controlled by Bluetooth is designed by using 3D printing technology. In an internet of things smart arena, the robot is controlled by mobile phone via Bluetooth, catch the football and shoot into the opponent's goal. The children in the game scan the QR code and install the APP, choose the team to join, participate in the game, and the score more goals to win. We also designed an intelligent table football field based on the Internet of Things technology with automatic referring and scoring, which combines desktop game and the innovation of robot game. It has the advantages of low cost and strong interest.

articleTitle: Simulation and Parameters Intelligent Optimization of Soft Recoil System
abstract: Soft recoil launching technology is an efficient method to reduce the recoil resistance of various artillery and guns. Different from traditional artillery, soft recoil artillery with soft recoil systems has rather complex launching process. By applying BP neural network in Simulink, the recoil resistance can be predicted and optimized for reducing the maximum force in a launching circle. In this study, a critical analytic equation model for a soft recoil system is established. BP neural network and particle swarm optimization (PSO) are used to optimize the size of flow port in recoil mechanism under typical launching condition. The maximum value of recoil resistance decreases to 136642N, 22% lower than the normal design.
